ec7980bc.title: Implementation/ Solution Consultant
ec7980bc.description:
**OVERVIEW**


Solutions Engineers collaborate with internal teams crafting and implementing enterprise\-level solutions for TransPerfect´s international portfolio of clients using the GlobalLink suite of products. They act as the clients main technical point of contact, working closely with Solutions Architects and Developers on the technical aspects of implementation.

**DESCRIPTION**

* Work in conjunction with the Solutions Architects team to gather and analyze configuration requirements from clients
* Draft project plans containing the implementation details and timelines, including risk analysis
* Ensure the deadlines for implementation are met
* Coordinate the installation, set\-up and upgrade of GlobalLink connectors with internal teams and client system integrators Coordinate and verify the configuration tasks in GlobalLink tools based on client requirements
* Act as the primary technical point of contact and point of technical escalation for both internal teams and external clients
* Assist the support team with any client configuration issues
* Be involved in the lifecycle of GlobalLink products by working closely with the Product Management team, reporting client technical issues and requesting new functionalities for products based on direct client exposure
* Assist clients with the coordination of GlobalLink connectors upgrades Become the spokesperson of the team for one or more of the GlobalLink products if desired
* Deploy, troubleshoot and upgrade the GlobalLink suite of products
* Create custom reports for clients in MySQL
* Mentor new team members as needed
* Prepare trainings and procedures to contribute to the continuous improvement of the team's work
* Provide trainings as needed to clients
* Contribute to internal projects
* Complete all other tasks that are deemed appropriate for this role and assigned by the supervisor.

 **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Minimum Bachelors degree or its equivalent
* Minimum of 1\-2 years of experience in a client\-facing role
* Project management and client solution implementation experience. Experience troubleshooting technical issues and reading logs Experience working with web technologies (web servers, application servers, Tomcat, etc.)
* Experience with Linux
* Understanding of and/or exposure to Web Content Management Systems (Adobe Experience Manager, Sitecore, Drupal, etc.), eCommerce platforms (Salesforce Commerce Cloud, SAP \[Hybris], Magento, etc.) and other Content Management Systems (Veeva, Contentful, etc.)

9481d0fe.title: Delivery Lead - CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management)
9481d0fe.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
   

  

 The Position
   

  

**Job Description**
**The Delivery Management Professional (SE6\) leads moderately complex deliveries, proactively identifies improvements, manages diverse stakeholders, and contributes to strategic implementation. In this role, you will independently define and control the scope of medium to large initiatives, utilizing effective facilitation and analytical skills to drive value delivery. While navigating intricate stakeholder environments, you will connect team development with broader business objectives. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as Project Manager, Service (Delivery) Manager, ITSM Process SME, Scrum Master, RTE, or Agile Coach.**
**In DIA ComOps you are responsible to deliver best in class solutions for Roche’s sales affiliates supporting them to manage their commercial contracts throughout its complete lifecycle. This includes rollout and implementation projects as well as application maintenance and support. You work in a virtual global team of internal and external colleagues.**
****Description of the area****
****Job Responsibilities****
* Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently defines, manages, and controls the scope of medium to large initiatives or significant workstreams with moderate complexity. Leads and facilitates the scope definition process, aligning with strategic objectives, stakeholder expectations, and team dependencies. Proactively identifies, analyzes, and mitigates scope\-related risks, manages scope changes, and champions the adoption of scope management best practices within the Chapter
* Accountability/Problem Solving: Independently leads the analysis of moderate to complex delivery problems, driving root cause analysis and eliciting complex stakeholder needs. Accountable for comprehensive improvement plans and contributes to solution design and validation. Champions accountability, deals pragmatically with ambiguity, and uses effective facilitation techniques to guide teams while mentoring colleagues and building team spirit
* Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of stakeholders across functional areas and develops comprehensive stakeholder communication plans. Effectively manages relationships to act as a trusted advisor, proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives, and navigates intricate stakeholder environments by resolving conflicts to ensure alignment
* Impact/Strategy: Demonstrates consistent performance with an impact that typically extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster. Contributes to achieving product or domain goals by ensuring value delivery, takes a proactive role in shaping team processes, and contributes to the implementation of strategic objectives for Informatics, the Chapter, and/or Domains
* Complexity / (Product Size): Manages moderately complex initiatives or workstreams extending across a product or service. Manages the delivery of complex features, services, or projects (e.g., a service transition, a product release, or an Agile Release Train (ART) increment). Selects and tailors delivery methodologies while managing dependencies between activities
* Business/Technical ability: Demonstrates strong business acumen by analyzing business needs and translating them into effective delivery strategies. Selects and adapts delivery methodologies to optimize results, manages complex delivery processes, and utilizes advanced delivery tools and techniques to address business challenges and contribute to planning


**Qualifications**
****Education / Experience****
* Proven track record operating in a Delivery Management archetype (e.g., Project Manager, Service Manager, Scrum Master, RTE, Agile Coach) managing medium to large initiatives or significant workstreams
* Experience managing the delivery of complex features or projects (such as service transitions or ART increments) across functional areas
* Demonstrated experience translating requirements into strategic implementation plans and contributing to business planning and forecasting
* Experience working in and managing a virtual global team


****Technical Skills****
* Strong ability to select, adapt, and apply appropriate delivery methodologies to optimize results
* Proficiency in utilizing advanced delivery tools and techniques to manage complex processes and dependencies
* Strong analytical skills to drive root cause analysis and propose comprehensive improvement plans
* 5\+ years experience in the commercial area, especially with contract Lifecycle management (CLM) systems. Agiloft experience is considered a plus


**Additional Qualifications**
* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to facilitate workshops, resolve conflicts, and act as a trusted advisor to diverse stakeholders
* Strong coaching and mentoring mindset, capable of championing accountability, connecting team development with business objectives, and building chapter team spirit


 Who we are
   

  

 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
   

  

 Let’s build a healthier future, together.
   

  

**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

9063d1b1.title: Associate Program Manager II
9063d1b1.description:
**Associate Program Manager ll (CTO Office)** 




  





**About Navi** 




 At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology\-first products built at scale.
 



 Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.
 



 Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low\-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest\-growing UPI platforms.
 



**What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.** 




  





**Why Explore a Career at Navi?** 




  





**Where Ownership Creates Real Impact** 




 At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day.
 



  





**Where Careers Accelerate** 




 Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you’ll find the space to grow quickly here.
 



  





**Where Great Talent Builds Together** 




 We take pride in building high talent\-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high\-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Program Manager to join the Engineering Office at Navi. This is a high\-visibility, cross\-functional role responsible for driving strategic and operational programs across the organization..
 



 You will work closely with the Head of Engineering and Engineering Leadership Team to manage initiatives that span multiple charters—ranging from process excellence and delivery governance to regulatory preparedness and organizational effectiveness.
 



 The role requires strong program management skills, structured thinking, and the ability to work with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 




  





**Strategic Program Management** 



* Drive key initiatives under the Engineering Office — spanning product delivery, process improvement, and tech governance.
* Build program plans, define success metrics, identify dependencies, and ensure timely delivery across multiple teams.
* Act as the central coordination point between Product, Engineering, and other cross\-functional teams for execution of org\-wide programs.
* Support leadership reviews with dashboards, summaries, and action tracking.



  





**Engineering Operations \& Governance** 



* Manage Engineering\-wide processes such as execution reviews, roadmap reviews, sprint reporting, and operational metrics tracking.
* Track initiatives like SLA compliance, RCA closure, tech debt management, hiring and other process adherence.
* Prepare high\-quality documentation for governance forums and leadership updates.



  





**Audit \& Compliance Coordination** 



* Coordinate ongoing internal and external engagements such as audits, reviews, and regulatory assessments.
* Ensure timely evidence collection, progress tracking, and closure of action items.
* Partner with Product, Tech, and Infosec to ensure that technology systems and documentation are audit\-ready at all times.
* Maintain a single source of truth for all review and compliance\-related deliverables.



  





**Governance \& Committee Reporting** 



* Prepare and maintain high\-quality documentation for key governance forums (ITSC, IT Steering, RMC, TPRMC, and Board presentations).
* Consolidate and report key metrics such as outsourcing SLA performance and incident analysis across entities.
* Manage the full governance rhythm — scheduling reviews, circulating pre\-reads, and publishing formal MoMs.
* Ensure all action items and follow\-ups from committee reviews are tracked to closure.



  





**Process \& Documentation Excellence** 



* Establish and maintain efficient operational frameworks, SOPs, and trackers to improve program governance.
* Partner with teams to standardize reporting and documentation practices.
* Proactively identify inefficiencies and propose structural improvements across programs.



  





**What Makes You a Great Fit** 



* 1–3 years of experience in
 **Program Management** 
 or
 **Technical Program Management** 
 within Product or Technology teams.
* Experience in regulated environments (FinTech, Banking, BFSI) is a plus, but not mandatory.



  





**Soft Skills \& Traits** 



* Excellent stakeholder management — ability to work across technical and non\-technical functions.
* High ownership, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Extremely proactive in identifying and communicating risks to the right stakeholders and leadership.
* Strong written and verbal communication — especially for executive updates and documentation.
* Analytical mindset with structured problem\-solving skills.
* Mindset to learn and engage in new domains pro actively.



  





**The Navi OS** 




  





 The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values.
 


* **Start with the Customer**
* Master the Details
* Act with Urgency
* Own the Outcome
* Build for a Decade \- Not a Day
* Win as One



 We hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation.
 



 To read more about the Navi OS, visit
 
 navi.com/our\-values
 




  





**Life at Navi** 




 Life at Navi is fast\-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.
 



  





 We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well\-being.
 



 Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.
 



 If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page:
 
 navi.com/careers/life\-at\-navi
 




  





  





 If solving meaningful problems, building at scale and growing alongside ambitious teams excites you,
 



**Navi could be the place for you.**

357033d4.title: Private Sector Engagement Manager - Women's Economic Empowerment
357033d4.description:
**Position Summary** 




  





 IPE Global’s Social and Economic Empowerment practice works towards building girl capital, empowering women and nurturing resilient communities by creating inclusive and sustainable solutions, including but not limited to policy development, capacity building, adaptive management, community mobilisation, behavioural change communication, deepening social safety nets, beneficiary feedback analysis, poverty assessment, and evidence\-based monitoring.
 



 Our She Works programme is a five\-year (2025\-2030\) initiative to enable 3 million young women (in the age group of 18\-29 years) to access aspirational jobs by addressing the social, economic, and institutional barriers that limit their participation in paid work. The design draws on proven models – including the Manzil programme in Rajasthan (which supported over 15,000 young women), the NSDC Skill Impact Bond, and FSG’s GLOW gender diversity roadmaps. The initiative will partner with state governments in Rajasthan, Gujarat, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Madhya Pradesh, and Uttar Pradesh to create scalable solutions.
 



  





 The State Mission aims to increase women's participation in paid work by improving hiring, retention, workplace safety, and gender\-inclusive practices across high\-growth sectors. IPE is hiring a
 **Private Sector Engagement Manager** 
 who will anchor all
 **state\-level industry engagement** 
 in
 **Rajasthan,** 
 working directly with employers, industrial associations, district officials, and state departments to increase women’s employment opportunities and improve workplace conditions across the state.
 



  





 This role will design and implement a
 **state\-specific strategy** 
 to onboard companies, secure diversity pledges, strengthen gender\-responsive practices at the firm level, and build long\-term partnerships with industry networks.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead the development and execution of a
 **state\-specific private\-sector strategy** 
 to increase women’s employment across priority industries and clusters.
* Coordinate with the state
 **Employment Department, Industries Department, State Skill Development Mission (SSDM), District Skill Committees (DSCs), and other relevant industry bodies** 
 to align employer engagement with the State Action Plan.
* Support the state government in
 **organising job fairs** 
 to increase women’s access to employment opportunities.
* Build and manage partnerships with
 **state and sector\-specific industry bodies** 
 to onboard employers and drive gender\-inclusive practices.
* Roll out the
 **state diversity pledges** 
 , track company progress, and support the creation of
 **state\-level recognition mechanisms** 
 for gender\-inclusive employers.
* Promote
 **gender\-friendly certifications and diversity indices** 
 among private employers to drive widespread recognition and compliance.
* Facilitate state\-level industry roundtables and district/cluster policy dialogues – with
 **Employment Department, Industries Department, SSDM, and state industry associations –** 
 to drive sector\-wide adoption of gender\-inclusive practices across the state.
* Design a
 **state\-level recognition mechanism** 
 , in partnership with the state government and state industry bodies, to acknowledge companies that achieve or exceed their diversity pledge commitments.
* Capture field insights, document
 **best practices** 
 , and support
 **state\-level monitoring and reporting mechanisms** 
 for adaptive programme learning.
* Document
 **state\-specific case studies of companies** 
 and clusters that successfully adopt gender\-inclusive hiring and workplace practices, and share them through state review meetings and industry platforms.



  





 As job descriptions cannot be exhaustive, the professional may be required to undertake other duties that are broadly in line with the above key responsibilities, as determined by the senior leadership.
 



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 




  





**Educational Background**




 Master’s degree or higher in Business Administration, Gender/ Development Studies, Human Resource Management, Economics or a related field.
 



  





**Work Experience:**



* At least 8 years of professional work experience in engaging with corporates, government departments, and donor agencies on economic empowerment or infrastructure delivery.
* Track record of engaging with senior industry leaders and influencing organisational change.
* Strong understanding of gender and labour market dynamics in India.



  





**Technical Expertise:**



* Deep knowledge of gender\-responsive approaches to private sector development and employment.
* Familiarity with government schemes, ESG principles, and inclusive value chains.



  





**Key Skills and Competencies**



* **Strategic Thinking and Innovation:** 
 Ability to design and drive complex partnership models for social impact.
* **Negotiation and Influence** 
 : Skilled in leading high\-level engagement with government officials and private players.
* **Gender and Inclusion Lens** 
 : Experience integrating gender\-transformative approaches into public\-private programs.



  





**Our commitments** 



* We offer competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package.
* We are committed to diversity in our workforce and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
* You will work with sector experts and understand how people\-centered policies can be created and effectively implemented.
* With us, you will master framing narratives and counterpoints and pace storytelling for internal and external stakeholders.
* We offer a space for you to grow, think innovatively, and shed unconscious biases while learning more about diverse cultures.

40019895.title: Customer Experience Program Manager, Customer Recovery & Acceleration
40019895.description:
Job Title
   

  

 Customer Experience Program Manager, Customer Recovery \& Acceleration
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 The Customer Experience (CX) Program Manager is a strategic, customer\-facing leader within the Product Success Organization, responsible for stabilizing, recovering, and accelerating high\-risk or stalled customers.
   

  

 This role operates as a rapid\-response, outcome\-oriented engagement leader, partnering with customers who are blocked in adoption, at risk of churn, or struggling to realize value. The CX Program Manager orchestrates cross\-functional intervention plans to diagnose root causes, align stakeholders, and drive measurable turnaround outcomes.
   

  

 This role focuses on systemic adoption, value realization, and operational recovery. Engagements are structured as approximately 90\-day coordinated recovery cycles, primarily serving High Touch and Upper Growth customers. The position plays a critical role in protecting revenue, improving customer health, and building repeatable recovery playbooks across the customer base.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Customer Recovery \& Stabilization
   

  

* Lead targeted intervention engagements (approximately 90 days) for high\-risk, stalled, or underperforming customers
* Rapidly assess customer health across product usage, workflows, data quality, and organizational alignment
* Define and execute a structured Customer Recovery Plan with clear milestones and measurable success criteria


 Cross\-Functional Orchestration
   

  

* Mobilize and coordinate the right internal resources based on the customer’s specific recovery needs
* Ensure all teams are aligned to a single recovery strategy, timeline, and accountable owner
* Remove blockers, manage dependencies, and maintain execution momentum across workstreams


 Executive Alignment \& Communication
   

  

* Engage customer executives and senior stakeholders to align on recovery goals, reset accountability, and communicate progress
* Serve as the primary point of contact throughout the duration of the ICU engagement
* Deliver structured updates and executive\-level summaries on a regular cadence


 Playbook Development \& Scaling
   

  

* Build and refine CX playbooks, intervention frameworks, and engagement models
* Partner with Product Success and Insights teams to scale learnings and improve early risk detection
* Contribute to the broader Customer Success strategy through repeatable, data\-backed recovery frameworks


 Data\-Driven Insights
   

  

* Leverage usage data, health scores, and engagement signals to diagnose issues and track recovery progress
* Identify leading indicators of churn risk and recovery success to improve future intervention models
* Validate success outcomes against customer\-defined goals at engagement close


 Cross\-Functional Partnerships
   

  

* Customer Success: Handoff coordination, health monitoring, and post\-ICU continuity
* Functional Experts: Subject matter depth and product best\-practice guidance
* Product \& Engineering: Issue escalation, roadmap alignment, and product gap feedback
* Data \& Analytics / Insights: Usage analysis, health scoring, and performance insights
* Services \& Implementation: Re\-implementation support, configuration guidance, and workflow redesign


 Success Measures
   

  

* Reduction in churn risk and improvement in health scores across ICU\-managed accounts
* Measurable increase in product adoption and depth of usage
* Increased retention confidence and renewal rates
* Scalable recovery playbooks and repeatable intervention patterns


**Qualifications Required**
* 5\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Program Management, Consulting, or Services within SaaS
* Proven ability to turn around at\-risk customer situations and drive measurable outcomes
* Strong cross\-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills
* Experience working with enterprise or high\-touch customers in complex, multi\-stakeholder environments
* Excellent communication skills with demonstrated executive presence


**Preferred**
* Experience in renewal risk mitigation or churn prevention strategies
* Background in nonprofit, fundraising, or comparable mission\-driven verticals
* Familiarity with change management and adoption frameworks
* Experience leveraging data and product usage insights to drive decision\-making


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Outcome\-obsessed and relentlessly action\-oriented
* Strong problem\-solving and root cause analysis skills
* Ability to influence and lead without direct authority in complex environments
* Ability to simplify complexity into clear, executable plans


 Why This Role Matters
   

  

 The ICU Program Manager serves as a critical safeguard for customer success and retention. By stepping in at pivotal moments of risk, this role ensures customers are not lost due to misalignment, stalled adoption, or unrealized value.
   

  

 Through structured recovery, cross\-functional coordination, and relentless focus on outcomes, the ICU Program Manager transforms vulnerable customers into stable, successful, and growing advocates—while strengthening the organization’s overall customer success strategy.
   

  

 This is not a support role. It is not a break/fix function. It is a high\-impact, outcomes\-driven leadership engagement that directly protects revenue, accelerates adoption, and builds the repeatable systems that make every future customer engagement stronger.
   

  

 Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, X, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube
   

  

 Blackbaud powers social impact through purpose‑driven technology and responsible AI. Guided by our
 *Intelligence for Good®* 
 vision, we’re building a culture where innovation, trust, and human expertise come together to help organizations make a greater difference in the world.
   

  

 Blackbaud is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining an inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

37009e7c.title: AI&E - SM - Operate Solutions Hub
37009e7c.description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Deloitte is seeking a Senior Manager/AVP to support complex pursuits and solutioning efforts across technology\-led services. This role will lead solution design, commercial modeling, and stakeholder collaboration to help shape differentiated client proposals. The ideal candidate will bring strong delivery and solutioning experience, analytical rigor, and the ability to lead cross\-functional teams through pursuit activities.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Senior Manager/AVP on the Technology Solutioning team, you will be responsible for…
   

  

* Develop solution storyboards, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis, and review pricing model inputs.
* Create differentiated deal structures and commercial models, embedding multitower synergies during solutioning; create estimation frameworks and pricing model frameworks.
* Review and provide feedback on key contracting terms and Service Level Agreements (SLAs); articulate integrated solutions with clients by leading solution presentations and creating value propositions for client requirements.
* Lead the solution team during client discussions, orals, and due diligence; collaborate closely with all stakeholders of the pursuit and lead and run solution review meetings with internal stakeholders.
* Work closely with Transition and delivery teams on delivery feedback loop; provide leadership and work closely with other industry Subject Matter Experts to develop business\-aligned metrics, such as Business Level Agreements (BLAs) and Experience Level Agreements (XLAs).


**The team**
 You will be part of a team focused on integrated solutioning for technology\-led pursuits across application management and application development environments. The team works across stakeholders to shape commercial models, define solution approaches, and support pursuit activities from qualification through due diligence. This is generated placeholder content for your review and can be replaced with practice\-specific team language.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad/Chennai/Bengaluru/Gurgaon/Pune
   

  

**Shift Timings:** 
 As per business need
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or Master of Computer Applications
* 10\-15 years of experience
* Strong delivery and solutioning experience across any of the following technologies: Java stack, .Net stack, front end technologies like React JS, Database technologies
* Multi\-tower experience with solutioning and commercial models
* Knowledge of AMS/IMS/CMS/BPaas solution tenets, estimation approaches, and solution integration
* Advanced Excel skills
* Ability to travel as needed, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience leveraging Gen AI and agentic AI across the delivery streams in AMS and AD
* Strong analytical and consulting skills, including experience in business case development and analyzing data to drive decisions
* Able to lead a matrixed team during deal pursuits
* Experience reviewing key contracting terms and Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
* Experience developing business\-aligned metrics, such as Business Level Agreements (BLAs) and Experience Level Agreements (XLAs)
* Top\-notch written and oral communication/presentation skills with the ability to put together cohesive decks


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. 8bd8e073.title: Technical Program Manager
8bd8e073.description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
   

  

 Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
   

  

 Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
   

  

 Cloud Data Technoloigies (CDT) builds and operates on\-premise cloud\-native data platforms and services that power eBay. The CDT PMO provides governance, planning, and delivery rigor.
   

  

 The Sr. Program Manager owns delivery of complex, multi\-team CDT initiatives, typically within a single platform or product area. You will plan and execute workstreams, coordinate cross\-functional teams, manage risks and dependencies, and establish reliable delivery mechanisms. The role requires strong program execution, stakeholder communication, and practical technical fluency in modern cloud and data technologies.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Program planning and execution
+ Translate product/platform goals into scoped plans, milestones, and success metrics.
+ Break down epics into clear workstreams and track progress; manage dependencies and sequencing.
+ Run program ceremonies (kickoffs, standups, weekly status, risk/dependency reviews).

* Risk and issue management
+ Identify technical and delivery risks early; maintain risk registers; drive mitigations.
+ Escalate issues with clear context, options, and impacts; facilitate trade\-off decisions.

* Cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder communication
+ Align requirements with Product, Engineering, and partner/customer teams.
+ Provide clear, concise status updates, dashboards, and narratives; represent the program in reviews.

* Process improvement and PMO governance
+ Apply PMO frameworks for intake, prioritization, and benefits tracking; maintain auditable plans and reporting.
+ Lead retrospectives for the program; implement tooling/process improvements; share playbooks.

* Team leadership and culture
+ Mentor project managers/analysts and partner engineers on estimation, planning, and risk practices.
+ Model ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement; foster respectful, collaborative dynamics.


**Required Qualifications**
* 5–8\+ years of project/program management in cloud, data platforms, or enterprise software; delivered multi\-team initiatives.
* Technical fluency in relevant and modern cloud and data technologies.
* Experience translating requirements into executable technical plans.
* Strong planning, estimation, dependency management, and risk mitigation within agile/hybrid delivery frameworks.
* Excellent communication skills: clear status/risk reporting and stakeholder alignment across product and engineering.
* Familiarity with relevant security, compliance, and data governance processes (e.g., GDPR).


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working within a PMO\-led environment, including portfolio governance and benefits realization.
* Hands\-on familiarity with major cloud providers and data services (AWS/Azure/GCP; e.g., S3/ADLS/GCS, BigQuery/Snowflake/Redshift, Databricks).
* Relevant certifications (PMP, PgMP, SAFe, CSM, ITIL) or equivalent experience.
* Experience with geographically distributed teams and data privacy requirements.


 Core leadership behaviors
   

  

* Outcome\-focused planning and delivery oversight within a defined domain.
* Systems thinking and architectural stewardship in partnership with tech leads.
* Transparent coordination, crisp narratives, and executive\-ready status at the program level.
* Risk identification, mitigation, and timely escalation.
* Expectation management with product and engineering stakeholders.
* Technical coaching and a culture of learning within the program team.
* Continuous improvement and retrospective leadership.
* Compliance alignment and operational excellence for owned scope.
* Ownership and accountability.


 Success metrics
   

  

* Program scope, timeline, and budget met; defined benefits realized (reliability, performance, cost, compliance).
* Improved delivery predictability and velocity; reduced carryover and unplanned work.
* Adoption of CDT standards, tooling, and governance within the program.
* Positive stakeholder feedback and sustained communication cadence.


**Additional Details**
 eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. View our accessibility statement to learn more about eBay's commitment to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities.
   

  

 We use cookies to enhance your experience and may use AI tools for administrative tasks in the hiring process. To learn how we handle your personal data and use AI responsibly, please visit our Talent Privacy Notice, Privacy Center, and AI Hiring Guidelines.

This role involves managing project teams, resources, and timelines, ensuring that programs are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
   

  

 As the Precision Electronics Program Manager with Vehicle Electronics \& Precision Applications team, you will be responsible to plan, manage, and direct all development activities of Multiple programs, to meet customer needs and fit within the capabilities of the Precision Electronics team. The team works across component and platform programs to ensure that on time launch of products to meet the customer needs, thereby having a positive impact on the business

* Manage end to end execution of Precision Electronics deliverables for platform integration programs
* Ensure the programs meet their quality / delivery (timing) / scope / financial objectives
* Work closely with internal and external teams (Business platform, Technical Product Managers, Engineering/Development, Architecture, Security, Product Validation, quality etc.) to develop and execute short\-term and long\-term plans, policies, procedures, resources, and initiatives.
* Work with leadership and program teams to maintain accountability to budgets, plans, and initiatives.
* Gain knowledge of the customer and business needs; thereby contributing to strategic decisions.
* Measure and monitor project performance; Create, maintain and review project status reports to support close surveillance over Solutions development and support events to assure proper allocation of resources.
* Ensure project plans and timelines are met by internal and external resources through Program Increment (PI) team plans and commitments.
* Understand and manage the program risk throughout the life cycle; initiate mitigations, or corrective actions as necessary.
* Serve as a liaison and mentor to assist with and expedite product related issues.

* Knowledge of product development and procedures, including general finance exposure; both Waterfall Methodology and Agile Framework \- such as SCRUM, SAFe
* Experience managing budgets and increasing efficiencies

* Demonstrated leadership, organizational, documentation, analytical, and decision\-making skills

83ec7602.description:
**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced and strategic Bid Manager to join the Response/Presales team at Virtusa. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end bid management process for the Technology vertical, driving complex, multi\-million dollar deals to success. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring internal compliance, managing tollgates, and collaborating with cross\-functional teams to develop and submit high\-quality, differentiated proposals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Full Lifecycle Bid Management: Oversee the entire bid process, from initial opportunity identification and qualification to final contract award for large\-scale IT projects.
* Strategic Deal Leadership: Partner with sales teams and senior leadership to define win themes, commercial strategies, pricing, and compelling value propositions.
* Collaboration: Assemble and lead high\-performing, cross\-functional "flying formation" deal teams, ensuring all specialists are aligned with the bid strategy.
* Quality Assurance: Manage the preparation of compliant, high\-quality proposal documents that align with solution tenets and win themes.
* Compliance Oversight: Ensure all technical, commercial, and legal documents adhere to client requirements, regulatory standards, and internal company policies.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the primary point of contact for the Business Unit (BU) throughout the bid cycle, providing accurate, timely updates and addressing inquiries.
* Global Scope: This role involves working with teams across global time zones (APAC, Americas, and EMEA). However, on a daily basis the role won’t require you to work completely in the US time zone.


**Qualifications**
* Experience: 10–15 years of proven experience in bid management, specifically within the IT services industry, with a track record of managing complex deals exceeding $10M.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; an MBA or PGDM is highly preferred.
* Process Expertise: Strong mastery of the full bid lifecycle, including opportunity qualification, proposal development, and contract negotiation.
* Leadership \& Communication: Exceptional leadership and program management abilities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all organizational levels.
* Tooling Proficiency: Google Workspace Suite (preferred) and Microsoft Product Suite


****Why Virtusa?****

We do this by working collaboratively in an innovative environment, helping each other succeed. We take great pride in being trusted advisers to our customers, offering the best solutions for their interests. If our mission and culture excite you, we would love to talk to you!

90a11e76.title: Technical Architect
90a11e76.description:
**About the Company** 




  





**Straive is a global analytics and AI operationalization company that helps enterprises embed data\-driven intelligence into their core workflows.** 
 It specializes in turning complex data into actionable insights, enabling faster decision\-making, improved customer experiences, and measurable ROI across industries.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 The role covers the full journey — from a one\-liner from the business to technical direction, architecture, building the platform, and keeping it running in production. The person we are looking for is who the team comes to when the integration is hard and the answer isn't obvious.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Start from the business ask. Usually a one\-liner. Turn that into a technical direction, get senior stakeholders aligned, and give the engineering team something they can actually build from.
* Own the integration architecture. API contracts, data flow, failure modes, retry behaviour, observability — define these upfront and own them through to production.
* Build platforms other teams build on. Developer\-facing API platforms — access tiers, OKTA / OAuth / long\-lived credential auth, gateway config, quota management. Needs to be solid, not just working.
* Wire the AI stack into real systems. FastAPI orchestration connecting Bedrock, vector search, document pipelines, analytics — with proper contracts, runbooks, and operational thinking, not just a working demo.
* Build for when things go wrong. Event\-driven pipelines on AWS (Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, Kafka) — dead letter queues, retry logic, structured logging, distributed tracing. Not added later, designed in from the start.
* Own production. When something breaks, lead the triage, get to root cause, fix it properly, write the runbook so the next person is faster.
* Set the standard. API contracts, integration patterns, reusable assets — the kind other teams adopt because they are better, not because they are told to.
* Guide frontend and infra. Enough React and Terraform/CI/CD awareness to review and guide delivery — not expected to write production frontend code.



  





  





**Qualifications** 




  





  




* 10\+ years in engineering with real time in architecture or technical leadership — not just the title, actual ownership of how systems are designed and delivered.



  





  





**Required Skills** 




  





  




* Integration is the core skill here, not a side of the role. Years of making AI, data, cloud, and enterprise systems work together reliably — and knowing exactly where they fall apart.
* Python / FastAPI at depth. Can design, build, and review production FastAPI services without gaps being caught by someone else.
* AWS is the cloud. Lambda, EKS, Bedrock, SageMaker, Step Functions, EventBridge, IAM, VPC — right tool for the problem, and aware of the cost implications of the choice.
* Has shipped infrastructure, not just described it. Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD — part of actual deliveries.
* Security and observability are built in. OAuth, SSO, structured logging, distributed tracing, zero\-trust — part of how this person builds, not things added at the end.
* Can read and review a React codebase well enough to guide delivery — writing production frontend code is not expected.



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 




  





  




* No data science needed. But needs to understand the AI stack well enough to make integration and architecture decisions that hold — LLM lifecycles, embedding pipelines, RAG, multi\-agent patterns, inference latency, and where each piece fits.
* Vector databases are part of the toolkit. Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, Qdrant — knows when to use one and which fits the use\-case and scale.
* Can connect an AI system into a production platform — ingestion pipeline, enrichment, post\-processing, observability, failure modes. Not just a working API call.
* Responsible AI is an architecture concern. Monitoring pipelines, bias detection, explainability — needs to be designed in, not added later. Should have a clear point of view on how.



  





  





**How You Work** 




  





  




* Comfortable starting from ambiguity, rigorous by the time it ships. The gap between a vague business ask and a well\-designed system is where the best work happens.
* Writes things down. API contracts, architecture decisions, runbooks — not because a process says to, but because it saves everyone time later, including themselves.
* Does not wait for someone to define the standard. If there is no consistent pattern across teams, creates one — good enough that others actually adopt it.
* Collaborates to solve. When something cuts across network, infra, product, or business teams — finds the right people and drives it to a resolution.



  





*“Straive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Our policy is clear: there shall be no discrimination based on age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender reassignment, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation.* 




*We are an inclusive organization and actively promote equality of opportunity for all with the right mix of talent, skills and potential. We welcome all applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.”*

19de97c2.title: Senior Solutions Architect
19de97c2.description:
Cohesity is the leader in AI\-powered data security. Over 13,600 enterprise customers, including over 85 of the Fortune 100 and nearly 70% of the Global 500, rely on Cohesity to strengthen their resilience while providing Gen AI insights into their vast amounts of data. Formed from the combination of Cohesity with Veritas’ enterprise data protection business, the company’s solutions secure and protect data on\-premises, in the cloud, and at the edge. Backed by NVIDIA, IBM, HPE, Cisco, AWS, Google Cloud, and others, Cohesity is headquartered in Santa Clara, CA, with offices around the globe.
   

  

 We’ve been named a Leader by multiple analyst firms and have been globally recognized for Innovation, Product Strength, and Simplicity in Design , and our culture.
   

  

**Want to join the leader in AI\-powered data security?**
 An increasing share of Cohesity's growth runs through service providers and integrators. Through the Cohesity Aspire Partner Program and a portfolio that spans Cohesity Data Cloud, DataProtect, and NetBackup, our Managed Service Provider (MSP), Cloud Service Provider (CSP), and Global System Integrator (GSI) partners build differentiated, profitable, as\-a\-service offerings on top of our platform.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Solutions Architect** 
 , Multi\-tenancy, MSP \& GSI to be the deep technical lead for partners who deliver Cohesity\-powered services at scale. You will design secure multi\-tenant architectures, enable partners to build repeatable service catalogs such as Backup\-as\-a\-Service and Disaster\-Recovery\-as\-a\-Service, and act as the trusted technical advisor across the service provider and global system integrator ecosystem.
   

  

**HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME HERE** 
 :
   

  

* Architect secure, scalable multi\-tenant deployments using Cohesity Helios and Data Cloud, including namespace isolation, per\-tenant encryption of data at rest and in flight, network and VLAN segmentation, role\-based access control, tenant self\-service, chargeback and showback reporting, and cross\-tenant deduplication.
* Multi\-tenant Architecture and Design
* Design Backup\-as\-a\-Service (BaaS) and Disaster\-Recovery\-as\-a\-Service (DRaaS) offerings that partners can productize and scale across many downstream customers.
* Guide partners on deployment topologies across on\-premises, colocation, partner\-owned data centers, and public cloud, in any combination.
* MSP, CSP and GSI Enablement
* Serve as the technical lead for MSPs, CSPs, and GSIs within the Cohesity Aspire Partner Program, enabling them to build, launch, and grow managed services practices.
* Help GSIs integrate Cohesity into their solution frameworks to deliver repeatable, market\-aligned offerings, and help MSPs and CSPs differentiate their service catalogs and customer experience.
* Support partner onboarding, codesign workshops, reference architectures, and operational readiness reviews.
* Customer and Field Engagement
* Support strategic partner\-led engagements, proof of concept, and executive briefings, representing Cohesity credibly across technical and business stakeholders.
* Partner with channel, alliances, and field teams to drive multi\-tenant and partner\-focused solution plays.
* Product and Cross\-Functional Collaboration
* Bring partner and service provider requirements back to product and engineering, influencing the multi\-tenancy, scale, and automation roadmap.


**WE’D LOVE TO TALK TO YOU IF YOU HAVE MANY OF THE FOLLOWING:**
* 10\+ years in solution architecture, systems engineering, or service provider and partner\-facing roles.
* Experience with Cohesity, NetBackup, or comparable data protection platforms in a multi\-tenant or managed services setting.
* Direct background working with or within an MSP, CSP, or GSI.
* Relevant cloud or architecture certifications.
* Exceptional storytelling and evangelism skills to engage both technical and executive stakeholders
* Experience with data protection platforms such as Cohesity DataProtect, NetBackup, or comparable solutions is a strong plus.
* Technical Expertise
* Strong hands\-on experience designing and operating multi\-tenant environments, ideally within or for a service provider, MSP, CSP, or GSI.
* Solid knowledge of data protection, backup and recovery, and disaster recovery at scale.
* A clear grasp of multi\-tenancy fundamentals, including isolation, segmentation, role\-based access control, encryption and key management, chargeback, and tenant self\-service.
* API\-first and automation skills (REST APIs, orchestration, infrastructure as code), with familiarity across VMware Cloud Director, ServiceNow, and related tooling.
* Familiarity with public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and with as\-a\-service, consumption\-based commercial models.
* Evangelism \& Enablement
* Relevant, demonstrated experience managing or architecting for MSP, CSP, or GSI relationships and multi\-tenant service delivery.
* Strong customer\-facing and partner\-facing skills, with composure and credibility in complex, multi\-stakeholder engagements.
* Commercial awareness, including the ability to connect technical design to partner profitability, consumption economics, and faster time to value.
* A compelling communicator across both technical and executive audiences.
* Collaboration \& Leadership
* Ability to influence and lead across multiple teams—engineering, product, sales, and marketing.
* Strategic thinker who can balance deep technical expertise with business outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support decision making

 For information on personal data processing, please see our* 
*Privacy Policy*

 Cohesity is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin or nationality, ancestry, age, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, veteran status or any other category protected by law.
   

  

 If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us at 1\-855\-9COHESITY or* 
*recruiting@cohesity.com* 
*for assistance.*
*In\-Office Expectations
   

  

 Cohesity employees who are within a reasonable commute (e.g. within a forty\-five (45\) minute average travel time) work out of our core offices 2\-3 days a week of their choosing.*
*Interested candidates based outside of the designated areas are welcome to apply, provided they have the right to work in the job location.*

aa765c72.title: Principal Architecture Consultant
aa765c72.description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  

Your day at NTT DATA
  
The Principal Architecture Consultant is a highly skilled expert who identifies areas of improvement for clients with complex information technology environments.
  
  

This role guides and oversees the implementation strategies and solutions for all aspects of infrastructure and related technology components.
  
  

The Principal Architecture Consultant oversees the delivery of multi\-technology consulting services to clients and takes ownership of the development of the architectural approach for more than one layer of a complex solution.
  
  

This role is responsible for reviewing the information technology infrastructure to identify areas of improvement.
  
  

**Key responsibilities:**  

* Guides the development of a roadmap and business case based on the client’s requirements.
* Takes ownership of architecting next generation platforms based on capabilities.
* Guides change management strategies that enable the migration from current to future architectures.
* Takes responsibility for the roadmap of change programs designed to help the client’s organization transformation.
* Evaluates relevant information technology architecture in order to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Oversees the development of new and / or existing strategies and solutions.
* Guides and oversees continuous improvement of internal tools and methods.
* Guide the pre\-sales process by translating opportunities into solutions.
* Oversees the sale of complex solutions and services.
* Takes ownership of the consulting engagements, to guide the roadmap and business case development for architecture services.
* May guide and mentor less experience consultants.
* Acts as subject matter expert by guiding internal stakeholders in the proposal development and other business development activities.
* Maintains subject matter expertise by researching the emerging enterprise architecture methodologies and the best practices associated with them.
* Oversees the development of new practices that differentiate, compliment, and augment the organization's existing offerings in the information technology infrastructure arena.
* Acts as a subject matter expert on multi\-technology design best practices.
* Oversees the development of business plans for the organization’s consulting practices.


**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**  

* In\-depth knowledge and understanding of IT industry environment and business needs.
* Excellent understanding of multi\-technology infrastructure design couple with strategic thinking ability.
* Knowledge on multi\-technology infrastructure design best practice which enables them to act as trusted advisors to clients on optimal infrastructure designs.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Interpersonal skills with the ability to develop and maintain strong stakeholder relationships.
* Extensive knowledge of systems, software and programing languages.
* Ability to focus on detail with an understanding of how it impacts the business strategically
* Excellent client service orientation.
* Ability to work in high\-pressure situations.
* Ability to establish and manage processes and practices through collaboration and the understanding of business.
* Ability to contribute information on relevant vertical markets.
* Able to contribute to the improvement of internal effectiveness by contributing to the improvement of current methodologies, processes and tools.


**Academic qualifications and certifications:**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology and/or Business Management or a related field.
* Scaled Agile certification desirable.
* Relevant consulting and technical certifications preferred, for example TOGAF.


**Required experience:**  

* Extended technical experience in a similar role within a large scale (preferably multi\- national) technology services environment.
* Extended multi\-technology infrastructure design experience.
* Extended subject matter expertise coupled with consulting and client engagement experience, demonstrating good experience in client needs assessment and change management.


**Workplace type:** Hybrid Working
  
  

About NTT DATA
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
  
  

Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  

unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  

confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  

than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
  
  

established and start\-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
  
  

year in RD.
  
  

Equal Opportunity Employer
  
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
  
  

Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters
  
  

NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an nttdata.com email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please contact us.

9c93c364.title: Cloud Engineer II
9c93c364.description:
ICON plc is a world\-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.
   

  

 ICON plc is a world\-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation. From molecule to medicine, we advance clinical research providing outsourced services to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device and government and public health organisations.
   

  

 With our patients at the centre of all that we do, we help to accelerate the development of drugs and devices that save lives and improve quality of life.
   

  

 Our people are our greatest strength, are at the core of our culture, and the driving force behind our success. ICON people have a mission to succeed and a passion that ensures what we do, we do well.
   

  

**The Role**
 As a Cloud Governance Engineer you will be designing and implementing policies and working practices to ensure common standards across a multi\-cloud environment.
   

  

 You will also be driving cost optimization initiatives and review architecture and deployment topologies to ensure optimal cost management, Setup appropriate tools to monitor and enforce compliance to the agreed standards
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Continuously drive cloud cost optimization by rightsizing, Optimizing, and use of reserved instance\\Saving Plans.
* Continuously review and monitor cloud costs. Setup alerting when costs are exceeding expected thresholds. Analyze and make recommendations around costs saving measures. Develop metrics to report on costs and work with stakeholders on budgeting
* Assist with the development and creation of policies and architectural standards to set minimum and repeatable standards in the following areas across a given cloud platform: Account Creation, Identity and access management, Cost management, Security, Tagging, Backups, S3 /Storage account policies and Logging policies
* Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) and working procedures (WPs). Training materials, and documentation adhering to industry best practices for AWS, Azure and GCP
* Roll out and development of tools across the cloud platforms (AWS, Azure \& GCP) to apply policies and monitor compliance across a wide range of accounts and tenants. These tools must be centralized with a view to giving a single pane of glass for ease of use. Setup enforcement mechanisms for policies where necessary
* Develop reporting mechanisms to easily demonstrate adherence to cloud policies
* Work with the ServiceNow team to implement workflows as appropriate to facilitate automation wherever applicable
* Continuously review and update standards according to latest best practice across our multi cloud environment.
* On\-board and continuously improve upon existing cost and control dashboards and alerting (performance, usage, compliance, etc.)
* Collaborate closely with Cloud Delivery Team and other stakeholders to ensure smooth delivery of cloud projects while maintaining compliance with standards.


**To Succeed You Will Need**
* Bachelor’s Degree in related field or equivalent relevant work experience; Industry standard certifications preferred.
* 6\+ years of related experience in a technical position supporting cloud based infrastructure in Cloud providers AWS, GCP, or Azure required.
* Strong working knowledge of various cloud technologies in at least one of the three major cloud platforms AWS\\Azure\\GCP. Including items such as: SCPs, landing zones, Control tower, AWS config, Cloudwatch, Cloudtrail AWS cost explorer, Azure Policy, Azure Security Centre, Azure monitor, Azure Advisor. GCP logging, GCP monitoring. Any third party cost monitoring tool.
* Strong experience in cloud cost optimization including, rightsizing, Optimizing, and use of reserved instance\\Saving
* General knowledge of cloud technologies, cloud architecture and cloud deployment
* Due to the nature of this position it may be required for the employee to travel.


**Benefits Of Working In ICON**
 Our success depends on the knowledge, capabilities and quality of our people. That’s why we are committed to developing our employees in a continuous learning culture – one where we challenge you with engaging work and where every experience adds to your professional development.
   

  

 At ICON, our focus is to provide you with a comprehensive and competitive total reward package that comprises, not only an excellent level of base pay, but also a wide range of variable pay and recognition programs. In addition, our best in class employee benefits, supportive policies and wellbeing initiatives are tailored to support you and your family at all stages of your career \- both now, and into the future.
   

  

 ICON, including subsidiaries, is an equal opportunity and inclusive employer and is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
   

  

 If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know through the form below.
   

  

**What ICON Can Offer You**
 Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.
   

  

 In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well\-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.
   

  

**Our Benefits Examples Include**
* Various annual leave entitlements
* A range of health insurance offerings to suit you and your family’s needs.
* Competitive retirement planning offerings to maximize savings and plan with confidence for the years ahead.
* Global Employee Assistance Programme, LifeWorks, offering 24\-hour access to a global network of over 80,000 independent specialized professionals who are there to support you and your family’s well\-being.
* Life assurance
* Flexible country\-specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.


 Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.
   

  

 At ICON, inclusion \& belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
   

  

 If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know or submit a request here
   

  

 Interested in the role, but unsure if you meet all of the requirements? We would encourage you to apply regardless – there’s every chance you’re exactly what we’re looking for here at ICON whether it is for this or other roles.

375be109.title: Cloud Architect
375be109.description:
**About Us**
 Gnapi Technologies., is an Information Technology Company established in 2016 with registered offices in India, Canada and United States. Gnapi provides end\-to\-end IT services and solutions to help and support clients succeed. Gnapi fosters a deep understanding of clients’ businesses and builds strong relationships to best\-fit IT solutions, supported by our technology expertise. Gnapi has a strong expertise in GIS applications working closely with multiple customers across North America.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are an IT services and solutions company looking for an experienced Cloud Architect to lead our cloud strategy. In this role, you will design secure, scalable, and high\-performance cloud environments. You will bridge the gap between complex business requirements and technical solutions, ensuring our infrastructure is reliable, cost\-effective, and future\-proof.
   

  

**Requirements**
**What You’ll Do**
* Architect Solutions: Design and implement cloud architectures that meet business needs, focusing on security, scalability, and performance.
* Lead Migrations: Direct the migration of legacy on\-premise applications and workloads to the cloud.
* Ensure Best Practices: Define and enforce standards for cloud governance, compliance, and security.
* Optimize \& Monitor: Continuously improve infrastructure for cost efficiency and reliability using monitoring and observability tools.
* Automate Everything: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and manage infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Mentor \& Lead: Provide technical leadership to development and DevOps teams, fostering a culture of engineering excellence.
* Innovate: Evaluate new tools, managed services, and emerging technologies to keep our capabilities cutting\-edge.


**What We’re Looking For**
* Cloud Expertise: Deep expertise in at least one major provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP) with a strong understanding of a second.
* Architecture Experience: Proven track record in designing cloud solutions, migrations, and modernization projects.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Advanced proficiency with Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi.
* Containerization: Strong knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, or GKE).
* DevSecOps: Experience building CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integrating security best practices.
* Networking \& Security: Solid understanding of VPCs, load balancers, firewalls, IAM, OAuth2, and VPNs.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.


**Good To Have**
* AWS: EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, EKS, CloudFormation, IAM.
* Azure: Virtual Machines, AKS, Azure DevOps, ARM Templates.
* GCP: Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Storage, Cloud Build.
* Observability: Experience with tools like CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK.


**Benefits**
 We believe our people are our greatest strength. We offer a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package to support your growth and well\-being:
   

  

* Health Insurance
* Vacation \& Sick Leaves

aa439fec.description:
ACA is seeking a
 **Managed Services Director \- Pune** 
 \- to lead and scale Managed Services delivery in Pune in alignment with ACA’s global Managed Services strategy, operating model, and governance. This is a critical leadership role that combines regional delivery leadership with end\-to\-end execution accountability, partnering closely with global Managed Services leadership to operationalize priorities, integrate seamlessly with US and UK delivery teams, and continuously improve delivery performance, quality, and scalability. This role operates within globally established strategy and decision\-making frameworks, with accountability focused on execution excellence, delivery outcomes, and regional operational maturity.
   

  

**Job Duties**
 Will serve as the regional execution lead for Managed Services delivery in Pune, accountable for delivery outcomes, operational performance, and integration with global Managed Services, to include:
   

  

  

* Scaling billable Managed Services delivery from India
* Embedding global ‑ standard processes, quality, and governance
* Integrating India seamlessly with US/UK delivery teams
* Building durable, institutional capabilities (not person ‑ dependent delivery)


**Regional Leadership \& Global Alignment**
* Serve as the regional execution lead for Managed Services delivery in adherence with global standards.
* Translate ACA’s global Managed Services Strategy and roadmap into executable regional delivery plans.
* Act as the primary interface between Pune delivery leadership and US/UK leadership, ensuring alignment, transparency, and effective feedback loops.
* Support the migration and scaling of globally aligned workstreams into Pune in coordination with global leadership.


**Regional Delivery Execution**
* Own the execution of the delivery lifecycle for Managed Services, including intake, prioritization, capacity planning, execution, and follow the sun handoffs.
* Drive a material increase in billable utilization, throughput, and billable delivery responsibility from Pune while maintaining quality and SLA performance.
* Ensure delivery workflows are location\-agnostic and aligned with global queue\-based, pulled\-work, or follow\-the\-sun models.
* Partner with global leaders on prioritization, sequencing, and workload balancing decision impacting global delivery.


**Quality, Risk \& Governance**
* Implement, enforce, and continuously improve globally defined quality frameworks, including acceptance criteria, rework standards, turnaround times, and stakeholder satisfaction measures.
* Ensure all India delivery is audit ready, with documented SOPs, controls, and escalation paths aligned to global governance requirements.
* Lead root cause analysis and remediation for quality issues or delivery failures.
* Serve as the primary Pune\-based escalation point for delivery risks, partnering with global Managed Services leadership on material issues and decisions.


**Process, Technology \& AI Enablement**
* Institutionalize knowledge by converting SME visits and rotations into documented global SOPs, playbooks, and certification paths.
* Champion adoption of AI\-enabled workflows (e.g., Alpha Hub) within Pune delivery
* Drive measurable improvements in productivity, quality, and scalability gains through disciplined process execution and technology adoption.


**People Leadership \& Talent Strategy**
* Own the regional workforce strategy for Pune Managed Services delivery, including capacity planning, role design, leadership bench strength, and succession planning.
* Build durable, process\-led delivery capabilities that reduce dependency on individual contributors.
* Champion ACA’s culture, values, and employee value proposition


**Metrics, Reporting \& Executive Confidence**
* Leverage delivery dashboards covering utilization, quality, SLAs, capacity, and operational health.
* Provide transparent reporting, execution\-level insights, and action plans to global Managed Services leadership.
* Reinforce executive confidence in Pune’s ability to reliably scale complex, high quality Managed Services delivery within the global model


**Required Education And Experience**
* 18\+ years in Managed Services, professional services, GCC/offshore delivery, or scaled operations
* Proven track record leading complex, multi ‑ service delivery teams in India
* Strong exposure to global operating models, quality governance, and utilization management
* Experience leveraging technology and AI to scale service delivery preferred
* Operate comfortably with global senior leadership Strong knowledge of project management methodologies, tools, and software; familiarity with Certinia (PSA) will be added advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor project teams effectively.
* Excellent problem\-solving, organizational, and decision\-making skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
* Attention to detail and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Familiar with Salesforce, Conga CLM, Salesforce CPQ.


**Preferred Education And Experience**
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective coordination across teams and external partners.


**Required Skills And Attributes**
* Have scaled large, billable delivery organizations in India serving global clients
* Be equally credible in strategy discussions and operational execution
* Build process ‑ led, audit ‑ ready operations
* Demonstrate strong US/UK stakeholder management and follow ‑ the ‑ sun delivery experience


**What working at ACA offers:**
 We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. Our Total Rewards package includes medical coverage fully funded by ACA for employees and their family as well as access to Maternity \& Fertility and Wellness programs. ACA also provides Personal Accident Insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Employee Discount programs and Employee Resource Groups. You’ll be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Privilege Leave, Casual/Sick Leave, and other leaves of absence to support your physical, financial and emotional well\-being.
   

  

**What we commit to:**
 ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

**Job Post: Delivery Head** 
 oss multiple client and internal initiatives.
