b9ec8d5c.description:
**Job Description** – Manager (CL\-7\)

**Job Title**: Workplace Service Delivery Manager (CL\-7\)

**Management Level**: CL – 7

**Work Location**: Noida

**Must have Skills**: Experience in Integrated Facility Management and Administration

**Good to have Skills**: Microsoft Excel, Power BI, PMP Certification

**Department**: Accenture Workplace Solutions, Corporate Function

**Experience**: 15\-20 years of experience in Facility management and administration with IT/ITES Sectors.

**Educational Qualification**: Graduate/Postgraduate in any discipline. An engineering degree in Electrical/Mechanical or a full\-time MBA or both would be an added advantage.

**Job Summary**


Workplace Operations is responsible for overseeing the day\-to\-day management of integrated facilities across assigned locations, ensuring seamless delivery of services aligned with business needs, compliance requirements, and corporate standards. The role involves managing vendor performance, engineering services, statutory compliance, real estate coordination, audits, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate will also lead workplace experience initiatives, support sustainability and EHS goals, drive team development, and ensure smooth operations during business continuity or crisis situations. The role is instrumental in creating a productive, safe, and engaging workplace environment that enhances employee experience and supports business continuity. A strong focus on service quality, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction is essential.

**Role and Responsibilities**

**Integrated Facility management**

* Plan, manage, and oversee day\-to\-day workplace operations for assigned locations.
* Conduct daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly service reviews with service partner teams. Ensure delivery of daily onsite facility management services including asset management, engineering, building maintenance, cleaning, office services, mail delivery, logistics and storage services.
* Ensure workplace operations meet or exceed service delivery and corporate standards in line with global/local policies.
* Drive the Service Partner to execute the deliverables as per the agreed scope of works and review the performance as per schedule.
* Manage operating and capital budgets in coordination with site operations and commercial teams for geography or location.
* Govern Service delivery partner and vendor performance using SLAs, KPIs, OLAs, and other tracking mechanisms.
* Maintain high service quality by identifying weak areas and implementing corrective actions.
* Monitor and document MIS/reporting processes, including weekly/fortnightly/monthly/ quarterly calendars.
* Deploy global changes to policies, operating models, and best practices.
* Maintain a healthy working environment, and foster employee productivity by ensuring a functional, safe, and engaging workplace.

**Engineering and Technical Services**

* Oversee engineering infrastructure and keep a track of service partners performance by reviewing the uptime of all engineering assets and performance as per agreed OLA’s.
* Collaborate on R\&M planning, and drive OPEX/CAPEX initiatives aligned with sustainability and safety. Leverage tools to improve quality of services, including office meters, sensors and SLA tracking.
* Track and manage M \& E Opex and Capex budgets for engineering services efficiently.
* Support implementation of sustainability and energy efficiency initiatives.

**Statutory Compliance and Risks**

* Ensure compliance with all statutory norms and third\-party vendor (TPV) legal requirements.
* Liaise with all stakeholders/teams who are part of the process: Legal, HR, TPV, AEE, Contract Management, and Commercial teams to fulfil obligations.
* Track license renewals (e.g. lifts, fire NOCs, building safety, water quality, etc.).
* Maintain documentation for health, safety, and environment\-related regulations.
* Lead responses to all audits—internal, external, client, statutory, and process audits covering the workplace operations.

**Corporate Real Estate (CRE)**

* Engage with landlords on all operational issues and lease terms on a monthly basis.
* Ensure all contractual obligations are being fulfilled by both parties.
* Escalate RE MSA or CAM related issues or violations to CRE leads.
* Support site selection and site disposition and extend all necessary support to Workplace leads , CRE POC, Controllership and Procurement, including risk\-free handovers and formal process closure.
* Coordinate with CRE, procurement, and finance during acquisition/disposition.

**Workplace Governance and Client Relationship Management**

* Conduct structured CRM connects with key business stakeholders (DU Leads, MDs, SDLs, etc.).
* Present KPI delivery metrics and track escalation resolution within a reasonable time frame (SNOW, M \& E, Events, Travel, etc.).
* Monitor and drive monthly client engagement activities (townhalls, bay walks, FGDs).
* Maintain strong client satisfaction by acting on feedback and enabling resolution of workplace issues.

**Security, EHS, and Business Continuity**

* Oversee physical and electronic security controls, including CCTV, access controls, and fire safety.
* Lead response efforts during BCP or crisis events and participate in LMT calls.
* Ensure site compliance with EHS protocols and wellness standards.
* Supervise wellness facilities such as gyms, wellness rooms, ambulance support, etc.

**Cafeteria Management**

* Oversee aggregator managed cafeteria operations and ensure compliance to the SLAs. Oversee vendor selection, hygiene and sanitation standards, and quality of food and ensure adherence to EHS and GAP standards, and other statutory compliance.
* Lead Food Committee Reviews and ensure feedback is acted upon by the vendor .
* Oversee licenses and documentation for food services.

**Team Management**

* Right\-size direct and extended vendor teams; ensure role clarity and workload balance.
* Ensure timely completion of mandatory training programs for all personnel, both direct and TPV service partner teams.
* Deliver feedback and performance reviews to the team members and drive team engagement activities.
* Promote a culture of innovation and employee well\-being.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Special Events**

* Extend support for high\-profile visits, including global leaders and clients.
* Participate in showcasing workplace capabilities during such events.
* Liaise with SMT, P\+ teams, and central/managed services (Events, CPSM, Travel) to ensure operational harmony.

**Projects and Transitions**

* Oversee seamless handover of newly completed WP projects into operations.
* Actively contribute during transition stages to ensure business readiness.

**Professional \& Technical Skills**

* Strong leadership and team management skills with a track record of driving operational excellence.
* Strong organisational and planning skills with attention to detail.
* Proven experience in managing multi\-disciplinary teams and external stakeholders.
* Effective communication (English, Hindi, and preferably Marathi) and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent problem\-solving, decision\-making, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and reporting abilities (MIS, KPIs, OLAs).
* Crisis management and business continuity planning (BCP) experience.
* Change management and adaptability to global process changes.
* Strong presentation and documentation skills.
* Proficient in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, word), working knowledge of Power BI and Power Apps preferred.

**Additional Information:**

* The ideal candidate should be a person of high integrity and moral values with strong leadership skills.
* This position is based out of NCR offices.

  

To be filled by recruiter

13490116.title: Engagement Manager (Finance Advisory)
13490116.description:
**About Client \- Fast Growing Financial Advisory Firm. 25\+ Members already with 20\+ clients being serviced.** 




  





 We are hiring an Engagement Manager with 3–5 years of experience in finance, consulting, transaction advisory, business finance, or CFO advisory.
 



  





 This role suits a qualified CA or CFA who can independently manage client engagements, lead financial analysis, provide strategic insight, and act as a trusted advisor to founders and business leaders.
 



  





 You will work directly with the leadership team and client stakeholders, helping businesses improve financial performance, strengthen controls, enhance governance, and build scalable finance functions.
 



 You are expected to lead multiple client engagements across industries, owning financial reporting, business analysis, budgeting, cash flow management, strategic projects, compliance oversight, and stakeholder management, balancing strong technical finance capability with business acumen, project management, and senior\-stakeholder communication.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 1\. CFO Advisory \& Business Partnering
 


* Act as the primary day\-to\-day finance advisor for assigned clients.
* Work closely with founders, CEOs, and business leaders on strategic decision\-making.
* Identify opportunities to improve profitability, working capital, and cash flow.
* Drive finance transformation and process improvement initiatives.



  





 2\. Financial Reporting \& MIS
 


* Review and present monthly MIS, management reports, and performance analysis.
* Monitor key business metrics, profitability, cash flows, and operational KPIs.
* Analyze business trends and translate them into actionable recommendations.
* Present insights and performance updates to client leadership teams.



  





 3\. Budgeting, Forecasting \& FP\&A
 


* Lead annual budgeting and forecasting exercises.
* Develop financial models and scenario analyses.
* Track performance against budget and identify key variances.
* Support business planning and strategic growth initiatives.



  





 4\. Cash Flow and Working Capital Management
 


* Monitor cash flow performance and liquidity.
* Develop rolling cash flow forecasts.
* Improve receivables, payables, inventory, and working capital management.
* Support funding and capital allocation decisions.



  





 5\. Compliance, Governance \& Risk Management
 


* Oversee compliance with accounting, tax, and regulatory requirements.
* Support clients on FEMA, RBI regulations, ODI/FDI compliance, and corporate governance.
* Help strengthen internal controls and financial governance frameworks.
* Coordinate with auditors, consultants, and external advisors.



  





 6\. ESG and Sustainability Advisory Support
 


* Support clients in understanding evolving ESG and sustainability requirements.
* Assist with ESG\-related data collection, governance reviews, and reporting.
* Stay current on BRSR, sustainability reporting, governance, and global ESG trends.
* Support ESG\-related due diligence and investor reporting where applicable.



  





 7\. Stakeholder and; Team Management
 


* Manage client relationships and ensure high\-quality service delivery.
* Mentor and review the work of Analysts and Associates.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams and project deliverables.
* Drive accountability and execution across engagements.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS and SKILLS** 




 1\. Education
 


* Chartered Accountant (CA) OR CFA Level II or III Candidate
* Master’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field



  





 2\. Experience
 


* 3–5 years across Finance and Accounting, FPnA, Transaction Advisory, Consulting, Corporate Finance, CFO Advisory, or Business Finance.



  





 3\. Technical Skills
 


* Strong financial reporting and accounting knowledge.
* Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills.
* Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS, Companies Act, FEMA, and RBI regulations.
* Exposure to ESG frameworks, BRSR reporting, governance, or sustainability initiatives is a plus.



  





 4\. Leadership \& Communication
 


* Strong stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to independently manage client engagements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment.



  





**WHAT WE OFFER** 



* Direct exposure to founders, CEOs, and investors.
* The opportunity to lead multiple client engagements across industries.
* Hands\-on experience in fractional CFO and strategic finance advisory.
* Exposure to fundraising, business transformation, ESG, governance, and growth\-strategy projects.
* A high\-learning environment with real ownership and career progression.
* Competitive compensation aligned with experience and performance.

**Designation:** Delivery Lead Manager  

**Qualifications:**Graduate \- Diploma in Any Discipline
  

**Years of Experience:**13 to 18 years
  

**About Accenture**  

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  

**What would you do?** Operations Account technology Lead (OATL) acts as the single point of contact for the BPS account for technology related scope \& drive tech transformation. They are accountable for ensuring high\-quality, issue free Technology delivery. The OATL is also responsible for helping to expand the technology footprint on the account, working with the BPS Lead to identify opportunities and proactively up\-sell and cross\-sell Technology services to increase efficiency. Also perform client facing role as far as the deal is concerned on all questions/issues related to technology. The OATL is also expected to position him/herself as a Technology expert with the BPO account, presenting the BPS Technology offerings/latest thinking to the Account Lead, and to bring the relevant TGP experts to the account as need be to drive automation. The Tech for Operations (TFO) team provides innovative and secure technologies to help clients build an intelligent operating model, driving exceptional results. Works closely with the sales, offering and delivery teams to identify and build innovative solution. Tech for Operations involves using technology to improve and streamline business operations. This role includes implementing software solutions automating processes and managing IT systems that supports operational activities. it also involves analyzing data to optimize performance and ensure efficiency. the goal is to enhance productivity and operational effectiveness through the effectiveness use of technology. Major sub deals include AHO (Application Hosting Operations), ISMT (Infrastructure Management), Intelligent Automation. Relationships \& Collaboration: Client Account Lead, TGP Technology Account Lead, BPS Account Lead, TGPforBPO Factory leadership. BPS Client Technical experience: Program, Project and service management (PPSM), Delivery excellence. Domain Knowledge (\=1\) – F\&A, HR, Procurement, Marketing, Supply Chain, Sales et al. Technology Expertise (\=1\) – Infrastructure Management (Network \& Voice Technology) , Automation (RPA technologies), OCR/Workflow Technologies, Analytics, Cloud computing, Operations business process excellence, Block Chain technologies, ServiceNow etc..  

**What are we looking for?** •Negotiation skills •Risk management •Process\-Orientation •Problem\-solving skills •Results orientation •program/Transformation Management experience •Automation, GenAI, Agentic AI or RPA •Ability to drive productivity and technology\- led efficiencies across client accounts
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** •Single point of contact for the BPS account lead for all technology work and offerings. •Oversight for all technology delivery at a client account related to BPO services. •Single point of contact for the escalation and resolution of technology delivery issues. •Bring TGP experts to the account to showcase our capabilities and/or ensure the right solutions for the client (Delivery center, offering, industry or Solution architects) •Develop the connections for integrated account delivery management at the client (TAL, CAL, BPO Account leads Etc). identifying the synergies and ensuring clear accountabilities and no duplication of responsibilities. •Work collaboratively with the BPS Account lead to identify and help efficiently originate new sales opportunities with our client senior executives across the C\-suite \- focusing not only on improving the way we run IT, But also on how IT can help enable their business •Responsible for efficiently driving TGP sales offering to extend the Technology footprint at the account (up\-sell/ cross\-sell) •Ensure a high\-performing, highly engaged technology team at the account. •Sustain Accenture s culture and values, ensure these are visible to our people, set the tone at the top.

bc0c244b.title: Staff Program Manager
bc0c244b.description:
**Work Schedule**
 Standard (Mon\-Fri)
   

  

**Environmental Conditions**
 Office
   

  

**Job Title:** 
 Staff Program Manager
   

  

**Job Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India
   

  

**About Company:**
 Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the world leader in serving science, with revenues of more than $24 billion and approximately 70,000 employees globally. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We help our customers accelerate life sciences research, solve complex analytical challenges, improve patient diagnostics, deliver medicines to market and increase laboratory productivity.
   

  

 Through our premier brands – Thermo Scientific, Applied Biosystems, Invitrogen, Fisher Scientific and Unity Lab Services – we offer an unmatched combination of innovative technologies, purchasing convenience and comprehensive services.
   

  

**About Team**
 Providing best\-in\-class product development services to Thermo Fisher Scientific Global Business Units, is one of the core functions of the India Engineering Centre (IEC)\- a Global Research and Development Centre, established in 2009\. We are a team committed to developing innovative and cutting edge technologically advanced products ranging from laboratory equipment, analytical instruments, remote monitoring solutions, chromatography and mass spectrometry. We are proud of the work that we do at the India Engineering Centre thereby fulfilling our mission of making the world a healthier, cleaner and safer place.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The Staff Program Manager is a senior individual contributor who leads complex, cross\-functional programs, ensuring strategic alignment between business objectives and execution. The role drives high\-impact initiatives from concept through delivery by partnering with business leaders, product, engineering, operations, and other stakeholders to deliver programs on time, within scope, and aligned with organizational priorities.
   

  

 The Staff Program Manager leads the Product Commercialization Process (PCP)/New Product Development process through the phase\-gate process, managing scope, schedule, risks, issues, trade\-offs, communications, and stakeholder expectations. The role ensures adherence to product development best practices, design controls, and regulatory requirements while delivering high\-quality products that meet agreed\-upon schedule, budget, resource, scope, and long\-term supportability objectives.
   

  

 Top of Form
   

  

 Bottom of Form
   

  

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**
* Lead end\-to\-end execution of complex, cross\-functional programs from customer engagement through product launch and program closure.
* Manage multiple concurrent programs of varying scope and complexity, ensuring delivery on schedule, within budget, and aligned with business objectives.
* Define program scope, objectives, success metrics, execution plans, and governance frameworks.
* Translate strategic priorities into executable programs, supporting leadership on prioritization, resource allocation, and trade\-off decisions.
* Build, manage, and influence relationships with senior stakeholders, serving as the primary point of engagement to align expectations, facilitate decision\-making, and drive program success.
* Drive program planning, execution tracking, risk management, issue resolution, and dependency management across projects.
* Serve as the primary liaison between cross\-functional teams and senior leadership, providing clear program status, risks, insights, and recommendations.
* Lead cross\-functional collaboration across Product Management, R\&D, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, Manufacturing, Service, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with product development processes, regulatory requirements, and organizational governance standards.
* Develop integrated program plans, facilitate core team meetings, monitor progress, and resolve execution gaps.
* Proactively identify, assess, mitigate, and escalate program risks and critical issues.
* Drive operational excellence by standardizing program management practices, improving execution efficiency, and tracking performance through metrics and dashboards.
* Capture, document, and communicate lessons learned to enable continuous improvement across programs.


**Requirements**
**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Life Sciences, Business, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
* 8\+ years of product development experience in Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or Medical Devices; IVD and instrument/hardware integration experience preferred.
* 5\+ years of program management experience leading complex cross\-functional programs.
* Experience with phase\-gate product development processes; Voice of Customer (VOC) experience preferred.
* PMP certification preferred; Agile certifications are an advantage.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Project and Microsoft Office Suite.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Competencies**
* Demonstrated accountability and ability to influence and lead in complex matrix organizations.
* Strong knowledge of regulated product development processes, quality systems, and program management best practices.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to lead without direct authority.
* Strong critical thinking, analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills with a data\-driven approach.
* Ability to prioritize, manage ambiguity, balance strategic and detailed execution, and deliver results under tight timelines.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across cross\-functional, global, and culturally diverse teams.


**Additional Qualifications**
* Understanding of KPIs, performance management systems, and strategic business metrics.
* Knowledge of market dynamics, customer workflows, business operations, and product lifecycle management.
* PPI (Practical Process Improvement) certification or experience preferred.
* Proficiency with program management tools (e.g., Jira, Smartsheet, MS Project, Asana).
* Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid project delivery methodologies.


**Benefits**
 We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward\-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

bf922996.title: Materials Program Manager
bf922996.description:
**Summary**
 Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other’s ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It’s the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you’ll do more than join something — you’ll add something.
   

  

 As a Materials Program Manager you will play a critical role in ensuring operational success for the Procurement organization. In this role, you will be responsible for materials readiness, availability, and visibility. This is a strategic supply chain role, interacting with our Contract Manufacturers (CMs) and internal core teams, encompassing critical component planning, allocation direction, supply flexibility modeling, and materials liability management. Do you have a passion for complex supply chain operations?
   

  

**Description**
 Do you enjoy seeing products come to life? You will be responsible for developing the strategic direction, goals, objectives and key measurement systems to ensure the business goals are met. Specific responsibilities include, but not limited to:
   

  

 Clear to build: Handle the CTB process, ensure the process is working smoothly and we have clear visibility on materials over a 26\-week horizon. Partner with the CM’s and the GSMs (Global Supply Managers) on all identified material issues (including sub\-tier supply chain) until issues are closed/resolved.
   

  

 Logistics: Ensure the smooth flow of materials necessary to meet the production schedules, inventory control requirements, and on\-going production line support. Make sure that we clearly understand the logistics requirements by commodity to enable an uninterrupted flow of materials.
   

  

**Excess \& Obsolete**
* Lead phase\-out of obsolete parts and the transition to new production materials.
* Identify and mitigate E\&O in advance to ensure we make the correct company decisions regarding build plan changes, cut\-in vs. roll\-in requirements, post ramp qualification opportunities, etc.
* Highlight parts with liability and propose solutions to management. \- Upon Engineering Change Notice (ECN) or End of Production (EOP) events, track \& audit E\&O claims, report to Finance for financial reserves, and ensure timely resolution and closure of such claims/reserves.


**New Product Materials Readiness**
* During New Product Introduction (NPI) phase, lead material readiness meetings with the GSMs to ensure that we understand the supply base and related challenges (i.e. supplier location and logistics, sole sourced modules, component lead\-time, supplier share of business, order lead time and order cancellation window).
* Identify critical engineering release breakthroughs; assess necessity for risk ramp and associated liabilities, to ensure material supply for product ramp is protected.

**Company Description** 




  





 Kuiq Technologies builds workspace management and communication software paired with IoT hardware to deliver strong total cost of ownership and seamless integration with existing systems. The company focuses on closing the gap between powerful but costly workplace solutions and affordable tools that lack scalability or compatibility. Kuiq provides facilities, IT, and operations teams with real\-time visibility into space utilization across Enterprise, Education, Healthcare, and Hospitality environments. Founded in 2025 and based in Atlanta, Georgia, Kuiq partners with organizations seeking reliable, cost\-effective workplace technology that fits into current infrastructure. Core specialties include workspace management software, space utilization analytics, IoT hardware integration, and multi\-vendor system integration.
 



  





**Role Description** 




  





 The Pre\-Sales and Implementation Specialist is a full\-time, remote role based in Bengaluru, India. This role involves working closely with prospective customers to understand their workspace, communication, and integration needs, and demonstrating how Kuiq’s solutions address those needs through tailored product presentations and technical consultations. The specialist will support sales cycles by preparing proposals, configuring solution demos, and coordinating proof\-of\-concept or pilot deployments. Post\-sale, this role leads implementation activities, including requirements gathering, system configuration, integration coordination with IT and facilities teams, and end\-user training. Day\-to\-day responsibilities also include documenting customer workflows, providing responsive support during go\-live, collecting feedback for product improvement, and collaborating with product and engineering teams to ensure successful solution delivery.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills to engage stakeholders, build trust, and support users through pre\-sales and implementation activities.
* Candidates should possess Training skills to develop and deliver clear onboarding sessions, user guides, and best\-practice content for diverse audiences.
* Experience in pre\-sales engineering, implementation consulting, or solutions deployment in SaaS, workplace technology, or IoT environments is beneficial.
* Ability to translate technical requirements into practical solutions, with familiarity in system integration, APIs, or enterprise IT environments considered an advantage.
* Strong organizational and project coordination abilities, including managing timelines, stakeholder expectations, and implementation milestones.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (such as Business, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline), or equivalent practical experience.
* Comfort working remotely and occasionally traveling to other customer locations as needed.

292c4da4.description:
**Company Description**  

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.  

  

Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

 **Job Description** **Job Summay:**


As the Principal Firmware Architect for UALink Switch Products, you will serve as the technical visionary responsible for defining, designing, and driving the end\-to\-end embedded software and firmware architecture for our next\-generation AI cluster scale\-up switches.


In this high\-impact role, you will bridge the gap between cutting\-edge silicon (ASICs) and upper\-layer cluster orchestration software. You will define how firmware manages complex scale\-up topologies, ensures raw hardware performance (maximizing bandwidth and minimizing latency), and maintains absolute reliability across thousands of connected AI accelerators.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\. Architectural Definition \& Design**

* Fabric Firmware Architecture: Architect and specify the low\-level firmware running on internal microcontrollers within the UALink Switch ASIC.
* Hardware\-Software Co\-Design: Collaborate heavily with ASIC design, logic design (RTL), and verification teams to define hardware\-software interfaces, registers, scratchpads, and memory maps.
* Protocol Implementation: Define the firmware stack to support UALink physical, link, and transport layers, managing credits, routing tables, and flow control.

**2\. Initialization, Boot, \& Fabric Management**

* Link Initialization \& Training: Design deterministic, fast link\-training state machines to bring up ultra\-high\-speed die\-to\-die and chassis\-to\-chassis UALink connections.
* Topology Discovery \& Routing: Architect efficient algorithms for runtime topology discovery, dynamic routing, and credit management to prevent fabric congestion.
* Platform Orchestration: Lead the design of SDKs and APIs that expose switch functionality to baseboard management controllers (BMCs) using OpenBMC and Redfish APIs.

**3\. Performance, RAS, \& Security:**

* Latency \& Bandwidth Optimization: Fine\-tune bare\-metal execution paths to guarantee deterministic low latency for collective communication primitives (e.g., All\-Reduce, All\-to\-All).
* Advanced RAS (Reliability, Availability, Serviceability): Design robust error\-handling, telemetry, and fault\-isolation micro\-architectures (e.g., link degradation fallback, FEC, and error containment).
* Security \& Root of Trust: Implement secure boot, cryptographic firmware authentication, and runtime attestation to ensure fabric integrity.

  

**Qualifications** **Education \& Experience:**

* Degree: Bachelor’s or Master’s/Ph.D. in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Experience: 15\+ years of hands\-on experience in embedded systems, server platform architecture, or low\-level silicon firmware development.

**Technical Skill Set:**

* Language Masteries: Expert\-level proficiency in C for bare\-metal and RTOS environments (e.g., ThreadX, FreeRTOS, Zephyr) and Python for hardware automation and modeling.
* Protocol Expertise: Deep technical understanding of high\-speed scale\-up/scale\-out interconnect protocols (UALink, NVLink, CXL, or PCIe Gen5/Gen6\).
* Network Switching Concepts: Comprehensive knowledge of credit\-based flow control, packet routing, physical layer (PHY) equalization, and SerDes management.
* Tooling: Strong familiarity with hardware debuggers (JTAG, Lauterbach Lauterbach/TRACE32\) and lab equipment (Oscilloscopes, PCIe/Protocol Analyzers).

 **Additional Information**  

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.


At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.


We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.


Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us?


Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity \& Inclusion Statement.


Renesas Electronics deals with dual\-use technology that is subject to U.S. export controls regulations. Under these regulations it may be necessary for Renesas to obtain U.S. government export license prior to release of technology to certain persons. The decision whether or not to file or pursue an export license application is at the sole discretion of Renesas.

06e5d933.description:
**Job Description – Technical Program Manager \- Software** 




**Department:** 
 Software
 



**Reports To:** 
 VP of Engineering
 



**Location:** 
 Pune / Bangalore
 



  





**About Spiro** 
 Spiro is building the operating system for electric mobility across Africa \- spanning battery swapping infrastructure, fleet operations, energy commerce, and CRM \- live across nine markets (Nigeria, Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda, Tanzania, Morocco, Benin, Togo, and Cameroon). Backed by $200\+M in funding, we're working on top\-notch, cutting\-edge technology to solve problems at genuine IoT, fintech, and mobility scale \- real\-time data pipelines, connected hardware, and platforms that run physical infrastructure, not just dashboards. We build systems designed to scale to billions of events a day and over 1 million transactions a day, and engineered for 99\.999% uptime.
 



 We're looking for exceptional engineers and leaders to join us in Pune or Bangalore to help build this platform. This isn't a "big company problems, big company headcount" environment \- you'll own systems end\-to\-end, with a bar for technical rigor set by experience at top product tech companies, but a working style built for a company still being built.
 



  





**The Role** 




 We need a Technical Program Manager who can hold together cross\-team delivery across a genuinely complex platform \- many engineering teams, nine markets, hardware and software dependencies colliding constantly, building toward systems designed to scale to billions of events a day and over 1 million transactions a day, engineered for 99\.999% uptime. This isn't status\-update TPM work; you need enough technical depth to spot risk in a design doc, not just a Gantt chart.
 



**What You'll Do** 



* Own end\-to\-end program management for cross\-cutting initiatives (e.g., new market launches, security frameworks, platform migrations) that touch multiple engineering teams and external partners (telecom carriers, hardware vendors, regulators).
* Translate FY OKRs into sequenced, dependency\-aware execution plans across our CRM, Energy Commerce, Battery Swapping, Fleet Operations, and Platform Services domains.
* Identify and de\-risk technical dependencies before they become blockers \- you understand enough about our modern, top\-notch technology stack and cloud infrastructure to ask the right questions in design reviews, not just track ticket status.
* Run rigorous but lightweight program rituals: no bureaucracy for its own sake, but enough structure that nothing falls through the cracks across nine markets and multiple time zones.
* Drive DORA\-style delivery metrics and CI/CD health reviews in partnership with Engineering Managers and DevOps.
* Manage vendor and partner coordination where programs depend on external parties (e.g., connectivity providers, hardware manufacturers).
* Escalate early and clearly \- your job is to surface risk before it's a crisis, not to protect a green status report.



**What You Bring** 



* 8\+ years in technical program management, ideally with experience at a top product tech company running complex, multi\-team programs, followed by startup or scale\-up experience.
* Strong enough technical background (former engineer, or long TPM tenure in distributed systems environments) to evaluate technical risk directly rather than relying entirely on engineering leads.
* Proven track record running programs with hardware/software dependencies, multi\-region rollouts, or regulated\-market complexity.
* Excellent structured communication \- you can write a one\-page plan that a CTO and a field operations lead both understand.
* Comfort with startup\-level ambiguity: no dedicated PMO, no army of coordinators \- you build the process you need as you go.



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience in IoT, mobility, fintech, or energy sectors.
* Experience coordinating multi\-country regulatory or telecom partner dependencies (e.g., eSIM/M2M connectivity rollouts).
* Familiarity with Jira/Confluence\-based program tracking at scale.



  





**Why Spiro** 



* Real infrastructure, real stakes: your systems run physical battery swap stations and vehicle fleets, not just dashboards.
* We're looking for exceptional engineers and leaders \- the technical bar of a top product tech company, without the bureaucracy \- you'll make decisions and see them shipped in weeks, not quarters.
* A genuinely hard, genuinely interesting problem space: distributed IoT, real\-time data at scale, multi\-market operations, and emerging\-market infrastructure constraints all at once, built on top\-notch, modern technology.



  





**Our Footprint:** 
 Nigeria, Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda, Tanzania, Morocco, Benin, Togo, Cameroon.
 



  





*Spiro is an equal opportunity employer.* 




*We evaluate all candidates based on merit, without regard to race, gender, religion, nationality, or any other protected status.*

A leader in Enterprise MCP and trusted by 50% of the Fortune 500, Workato’s cloud\-native architecture connects every application, data source, and process to power real\-time orchestration at scale. With enterprise\-grade security and continuous innovation at its core, Workato provides the trusted foundation for organizations to automate with confidence and operationalize AI across the business.  . We are driven by
 **innovation** 
 and looking for
 **team players** 
 who want to actively build our company.
   

  

 But, we also believe in
 **balancing productivity with self\-care**

 If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!
   

  

**Also, Feel Free To Check Out Why**
* Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”
* Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
* Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
* Quartz ranked us the \#1 best company for remote workers


**Responsibilities**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Program Manager** 
 to join our AI Apps BU in the Product Engineering division. It is an engineering governance and oversight function that sits above delivery execution, focused on ensuring architectural integrity, scope alignment, and continuous feedback loops across our largest enterprise programs and early access product releases.
   

  

**The Program Manager Will Oversee Two Parallel Program Tracks**
* Top 10 accounts — ensuring engineering\-level oversight across large, complex implementation engagements with multiple parallel workstreams.
* Early Access Product Releases — governing the rollout of new product capabilities to early access customers, ensuring adoption milestones are met and structured feedback is routed back to product engineering.


**Program Strategy \& Governance**
* Own the program charter, OKRs, roadmap, and success metrics for all Workato Agentic AI Apps BU initiatives for TECS department delivery and product tracks.
* Establish governance frameworks — RAID logs, steering cadences, escalation paths, and program decision rights — aligned to Workato's delivery standards.
* Maintain a consolidated program view across concurrent workstreams: Packaged Genies cycles and customer deployments
* Lead weekly/monthly/quarterly business reviews and executive reporting for Workato leadership for strategic enterprise clients.
* Drive cross\-team dependency management and risk mitigation across TECS and Product \& Engineering
* Coordinate and facilitate design review checkpoints with the Architecture Board, ensuring solutions meet Workato's standards before build begins.
* Surface cross\-account patterns, blockers, and friction points, feeding structured learnings back to engineering leads and architecture groups to improve platform patterns and packaged applications.
* Produce executive\-level dashboards, program status reports, and decision briefs using Workato's delivery metrics framework.
* Maintain program dashboards that track status, risks, and key decisions across the enterprise portfolio.


**Cross\-Functional Planning with TECS**
* Facilitate Program planning, sprint reviews, dependency syncs, and retrospectives across FDE delivery pods.
* Maintain alignment between Workato's product release calendar and FDE delivery timelines to leverage new AI platform capabilities immediately.
* Coordinate, maintain and track a priority list of customer issues and enhancement requests and timelines with the platform team.


**Delivery Excellence \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and enforce Workato delivery standards — Definition of Ready/Done, quality gates, and release governance for AI\-powered automation.
* Implement program\-level metrics (velocity, cycle time, integration success rate, agent accuracy, CSAT) and drive improvement actions.
* Lead post\-program retrospectives; codify learnings into Workato FDE playbooks, recipe templates, and delivery runbooks.


**Requirements**
**Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills**
* 10\+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program management, or a closely related discipline.
* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-workstream programs in a product engineering or enterprise software environment.
* Experience working across large enterprise accounts with multiple parallel delivery teams.
* Background in iPaaS, integration platforms, or enterprise automation strongly preferred.
* Experience identifying opportunities to leverage existing products/capabilities within delivery programs, and ensuring fitment evaluation checkpoints are built into the delivery lifecycle — feeding gaps and improvement opportunities back to the engineering team building packaged offerings


**Technical Domain**
* Understands the importance of architecture and engineering governance checkpoints and can ensure they are scheduled, attended, and actioned — without needing deep technical expertise.
* Familiarity with architecture review processes, design governance, and technical milestone frameworks.
* Experience with both packaged software delivery and custom implementation contexts — able to evaluate fitment vs. customization tradeoffs.
* Comfort working across Agile and structured delivery methodologies.


**Stakeholder \& Communication**
* Demonstrated ability to manage director and VP\-level relationships — both internally and with enterprise customers.
* Strong ability to set expectations clearly, communicate program status accurately, and escalate risks effectively.
* Skilled at facilitating alignment across engineering, product, and customer technical stakeholders.
* Experience synthesizing customer and delivery feedback into structured, actionable input for product and engineering teams.


**Mindset**
* Operates effectively in a fast\-paced, high\-growth, and often ambiguous environment.
* Brings a product engineering mindset — focused on quality, patterns, and scalable solutions.
* Committed to continuous improvement: uses every program as an opportunity to strengthen Workato's delivery model and product offering.


**What Success Looks Like**
* The post\-sales processes and KPIs for customer on\-boarding, implementation, quality and CSAT are defined and meet the KPIs.
* Architecture Board reviews are scheduled, completed, and actioned — with no programs bypassing engineering governance checkpoints.
* Engineering learnings from enterprise delivery are feeding back into improved platform patterns and packaged application offerings on a recurring cadence.
* Early access product releases have structured adoption milestones, and customer feedback is systematically routed to product engineering within defined SLAs.
* All top 10 enterprise programs have clear, tracked engineering milestones with architecture review and UAT gates enforced consistently

fb469353.title: Solutions Engineer
fb469353.description:
**Introduction**
 At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you’ll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co\-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You’ll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world\-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that’s passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 Solutions Engineers are the technical spearhead in the acquisition sales cycle, specializing in landing new customers and accelerating pipeline velocity. You will be the primary technical advisor to the sales team, partnering closely with them to position the Confluent platform's capabilities to new prospects.
   

  

 Your mission is to secure the technical win by adeptly uncovering a prospect's implicit or stated Business Needs and designing a validated Technical Solution to meet them. From inspiring prospects with "Art of the Possible" demonstrations and storytelling to navigating complex technical roadblocks and Proofs of Concept (POCs), you are instrumental in ensuring the successful acquisition and initial deployment of Confluent technology. This role is a critical component of our strategy to expand our global customer base and will report into the Global Scale organization.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Own the Technical Sale:
   

  

 Conduct deep\-dive discovery and whiteboard sessions to identify and refine innovative Data Streaming use cases , translating them into validated solution architectures and paths to Go\-Live,
   

  

 Lead and execute Technical Proofs of Concept (POCs) to secure new customer logos and drive deal closure velocity.
   

  

**Technical Triage \& Qualification**
 Exceptional skill in rapidly qualifying technical fit early in the process. The SE must quickly identify if the prospect is a good fit for the standard offering and, crucially, know when to disqualify a deal that requires too much customization or post\-sales effort.
   

  

 Consultative approach to value selling : ability to connect business objectives with technical solutions and present in a value\-centric approach.
   

  

 Be an Evangelist: Deliver compelling Technical Talks and Workshops to prospects, acting as a trusted advisor and demonstrating Thought Leadership in event\-driven architecture.
   

  

 Accelerate Onboarding: Forge strong relationships with key prospective customer stakeholders and serve as a dependable technical partner throughout the evaluation and initial onboarding process.
   

  

 Develop and maintain reusable technical assets: contribute toward scaling efforts by developing and maintaining assets that address the most common use cases.
   

  

 Product Advocacy: Serve as a critical feedback loop to Product and Engineering teams, ensuring the voice of the prospect is clearly articulated, and acting as a key advocate for the Confluent platform across the ecosystem.
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Experience in Solutions Engineering or similar work experience in a technical pre\-sales capacity. Process \& Efficiency, a “scale” mindset. An ability to quickly leverage standardized demo environments, template proposals, and documented Proof of Concept (PoC) scopes to minimize preparation time.
* Experience with Event\-Driven architecture, Data Integration \& Processing Techniques, Database \& Data Warehouse technologies.
* First\-Hand exposure to Cloud Architecture, Migrations, Deployment \& Application Development.
* Experience with Automation, GitOps and Kubernetes.
* Proficiency in Java, Python or SQL.
* Development or implementation experience in a cloud\-based environment, along with Technical certifications (e.g., Cloud Developer/Architect, Data Engineering \& Integration).


 Clear, consistent demonstration of self\-starter behavior, a desire to learn new things and tackle hard technical problems.
   

  

* Managing multiple evaluation processes across various industry verticals and use cases, ability to be nimble and organized is a must.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Additional Technical Integration Knowledge: Exposure to various technical integration methodologies and tools, enhancing ability to address complex integration challenges.
* Advanced Agreement Management Skills: Experience with managing multiple agreements simultaneously, prioritizing tasks to meet competing deadlines and stakeholder expectations.
* Enhanced Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Exposure to working with diverse teams, fostering strong relationships and leveraging technical expertise to drive project success.

f304352a.title: Solution Engineer / Product Lead track — GxP (Hyderabad)
f304352a.description:
**The one\-line version:** 
 Be the founder’s second\-in\-room: run the demos, map the workflows, and walk Heads of Quality through the evidence — with a defined track to Product Lead as our first design partnerships convert.
 



  





**About Verixa** 




 Verixa is a governed\-AI workflow platform for regulated life sciences, built by Navira Quality Systems. We apply bounded AI assistance inside regulated quality workflows — deviation investigation, RCA, CAPA, audit preparation — with human review, source traceability, controlled approvals and workflow\-level audit records on every AI\-assisted step. AI can propose; qualified humans determine and approve the regulated decision.
 



 The product is built and internally tested, and we are entering paid design\-partner engagements with emerging pharma, biotech and CDMO quality teams — India first, US in parallel. The founder spent 20\+ years in pharma quality (Genentech/Roche, BMS, Arcellx, Alumis) and leads every sale personally. You would be hire \#1 in the Hyderabad market team.
 



  





**The role** 




 Every buyer conversation we have is with a Head of Quality, VP Quality, or QA/CSV leader — people who detect hand\-waving instantly. Your job is to make Verixa concrete in those rooms:
 


* **Run the demo.** 
 Own the demo environment, demo scripts and scenario data. Show a deviation→RCA→CAPA workflow credibly to people who live it daily.
* **Map workflows live.** 
 Sit with a customer’s QA team, take their SOP/process reality, and map it to a bounded Verixa workflow — scope, roles, review gates, exclusions.
* **Walk the evidence.** 
 Present AI output provenance, supporting sources, reviewer history, system records and validation\-support documentation — and answer “how would this hold up in an inspection?” without overclaiming.
* **Be the founder’s second\-in\-room.** 
 Join design\-partner meetings, capture what was actually said and agreed, challenge our own optimism, and own same\-day follow\-ups.
* **Feed the product.** 
 Turn what buyers say into precise input for the product and engineering team — workflow scope, priorities and honest claims. This is where the Product Lead track begins.



  





**The Product Lead track** 




 This role is deliberately built to grow. Prove the solution\-engineering seat through our first paid design partnerships, and the product\-definition mandate — workflow roadmap, scope decisions, the bridge to our engineering team — formalizes into a Product Lead title. We would rather promote the person who has sat in fifty buyer meetings than hire a product leader who hasn’t.
 



  





**What we need from you** 



* **4–10 years in pharma/biotech quality reality:** 
 plant or clinical QA, CSV/CSA, QMS/eQMS implementation, or quality consulting. You can read a deviation SOP and find the pain in it.
* **You can demo software.** 
 Vendor solution\-engineering, implementation consulting, or having led an eQMS/LIMS rollout from the customer side all count.
* **You speak both languages —** 
 QA (“root cause, impact assessment, Part 11”) and product (“workflow, config, role model”) — and translate between them.
* **Startup pace, regulatory discipline.** 
 You move quickly without compromising evidence, accuracy or claim discipline.
* **Claim discipline.** 
 Verixa is internally tested and provides validation\-support documentation; each regulated customer remains responsible for validating the system for its intended use within its quality system. If stating that plainly resonates rather than frustrates, you’ll fit.
* Based in Hyderabad or ready to relocate.



*Bonus: exposure to AI/ML tools in a regulated context; Annex 11 / Part 11 working knowledge; CDMO or sterile\-manufacturing background; existing Hyderabad pharma network.* 




  





**What this role is not** 




 Not a pure sales quota role (the founder leads sales). Not remote. Not a support desk. It is the most customer\-facing technical seat in the company.
 



  





**What you get** 



* Ground\-floor seat in one of India’s largest life\-sciences and pharma hubs, as the market team’s first hire — employed by Navira Quality Systems with meaningful early\-employee ESOP.
* Direct daily work with a domain\-expert founder; your fingerprints on the product, the demo and the first reference customers — and a defined Product Lead growth track.
* A front\-row seat to the evolving AI and computerized\-systems regulatory landscape — including draft EU Annex 22, Annex 11 developments, FDA Part 11 expectations and, for medical\-device applications, FDA CSA.



 Compensation: competitive salary \+ ESOP, calibrated to experience.
 



  





**How to apply** 




 Email
 **vimalv@verixa.ai** 
 with subject “Solution Engineer — Hyderabad”: your CV/LinkedIn plus 5–10 lines on
 **one quality workflow you know deeply and what breaks in it today** 
 . No cover letter needed — that paragraph is the first screen.
 



*Verixa product · Navira Quality Systems Pvt Ltd (employer of record). We hire on merit; quality people know evidence beats narrative.*

**About The Company**
 HCLTech is a leading global technology services company renowned for its innovative solutions and comprehensive IT services. With a rich history of delivering digital transformation, cloud computing, and enterprise modernization, HCLTech serves a diverse portfolio of clients across multiple industries including banking, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and telecom. The company's commitment to fostering innovation, leveraging cutting\-edge technology, and maintaining a customer\-centric approach has established it as a trusted partner for organizations seeking to accelerate their digital journeys. HCLTech's global presence and diverse talent pool enable it to deliver scalable and customized solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses worldwide.
   

  

**About The Role**
 HCLTech is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Google Cloud Solutions Engineer / Architect to join our dynamic team. This role is pivotal in driving solution design and engineering initiatives aimed at accelerating the adoption of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) at an enterprise level. The successful candidate will lead complex cloud migration, modernization, data engineering, and AI\-driven automation projects across various industry verticals. They will collaborate closely with global sales teams, technical architects, and partners to craft compelling go\-to\-market strategies, develop innovative solutions, and secure customer wins. The role offers an exciting opportunity to work on cutting\-edge cloud technologies, including data engineering, AI, and machine learning, to help clients achieve their digital transformation objectives.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 The ideal candidate will possess a strong educational background in computer science, information technology, or related fields, with a minimum of 5 to 7 years of overall IT experience. At least 2\-3 years of hands\-on experience working specifically with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is essential. Candidates should demonstrate deep proficiency in GCP core services such as Compute, Storage, and Networking, along with high\-level expertise in Data Engineering tools like BigQuery and Looker. A foundational understanding of AI/ML platforms, including Vertex AI and Gemini Enterprise, as well as familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs), is preferred. Proven experience working with GSI partners, developing joint solutions, and aligning with enterprise sales targets is highly desirable. Candidates should also possess excellent communication skills, executive presence, and the ability to translate technical concepts into business value.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with global sales teams and Google Cloud Architects to respond to RFIs/RFPs and proactively address customer requirements, ensuring solutions align with client business goals.
* Develop ROI models and hyperscale funding strategies that optimize Google Cloud consumption and demonstrate TCO benefits to clients.
* Design and facilitate technical workshops, creating reference architectures for data center migration, modernization, and cloud adoption initiatives.
* Architect Google Cloud Native applications and enterprise\-grade Data Engineering stacks utilizing services such as BigQuery, Looker, and Vertex AI to enable data\-driven decision\-making.
* Ideate and design AI solutions, including Gemini Enterprise Agentic AI and Generative AI (GenAI), to enhance enterprise IT managed services, cloud operations, and automation processes.
* Work closely with GSI partners to develop joint go\-to\-market solutions, scaling solutions, and expanding market reach.

 HCLTech offers a competitive compensation package along with comprehensive benefits including health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off. Employees have access to continuous learning opportunities, certifications, and professional development programs to enhance their skill sets. The company fosters a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages innovation and growth. Additionally, employees will have the opportunity to work on high\-impact projects with leading global clients, gaining exposure to the latest cloud technologies and industry best practices. HCLTech also promotes work\-life balance and provides various employee wellness initiatives to support overall well\-being.
   

  

 Equal Opportunity
   

  

 HCLTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We value diversity and do not discriminate based on race, religion, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our ability to innovate and serve our clients effectively. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected status, and we are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for growth and development within our organization.

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Solution Architect \- Consulting**
**10 \-12 Years Of Experience (M1/M2\)**
**Job Purpose:**
 EY is looking for inspired, result oriented and quality focused professional with strong consulting and technical skills to provide consulting services and execute on various Digital Transformation projects for our clients across the MENA region and industry sectors.
   

  

 The candidate may need to contribute and involve in Go\-To\-Market activities including sales, pre\-sales, business development for the firm and actively engage in responding to RFPs, Oral presentations to clients and negotiations.
   

  

 The candidate will be expected to effectively leverage the global capabilities and resources of EY, its alliance partners, technology and digital service providers, vendors and provide best\-in\-class consulting services on Solution/Enterprise architecture, and technology solutions to complex business problems to enable digital transformation journey of the client.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Provide advice on long term Solution / Enterprise architecture decisions to Client’s senior management of their Business and IT streams.
* Build and develop the Solution / Enterprise Architecting capability through pro\-active engagement with EY practice teams, partners, and clients.
* Perform sales, pre\-sales, business development for the firm and actively engage in responding to RFPs /RFI’s, Oral pitches and negotiations.
* Plan and run workshops for Client’s Business and Technology Executives and involving client partners and vendors, on Solution Architecture exclusively, driving Transition of applications and solutions from incumbent vendors of clients, or as part of Digital Transformation, addressing Business, Digital and IT Strategy and objectives of the client.
* Work closely with professionals spanning strategy, business, application, infrastructure security and data architecture disciplines to accelerate our clients’ enterprise architecture maturity definition and transformation journey, leveraging internal capabilities and tapping into an ecosystem of partners and technology vendors and service providers.
* Develop technical and commercial business cases for clients to invest in technology, tools, infrastructure, and people capabilities, and present it at various levels of client organization in line with their enterprise architecture roadmap.
* Engage with various technology vendors, technology start\-ups and service providers to evaluate them on behalf of clients and provide recommendations.
* Anticipate and understand major technology changes and digital trends to enable the client to succeed in a competitive landscape.
* Setup and actively develop and contribute to Architecture CoE covering EA, Business Architecture, Solutions Architecture, Application Architecture, Infrastructure Architecture, Security Architecture and Data Architecture
* Interface and communicate with the various onsite and/or offshore stakeholders and coordinators on a regular basis to ensure smooth execution of responsibilities and demonstrate value.
* Timely completion of assigned tasks, within budget and at highest quality and provide regular status reporting to clients, managers, and leadership.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* BTech/MCA from a reputed Institution
* Extensive consulting experience in Big\-4s, IT Industry Majors or Management Consulting firms
* Experience in performing the role of technical owner/ co\-owner for large IT transformation projects.
* At least 5 years in Architecting and leading the implementation of medium/large solutions of Cloud solutions (Azure / GCP), Microsoft Technologies, UI Frameworks (React /Angular), Micro Services
* Good understanding and exposure to large platforms and systems, including major ERPs, CRMs, Digital, Cloud and Big Data Platforms and Channels, Service Management Platforms like ServiceNow/BMC Remedy, SAAS, PAAS, IAAS providers, leading Core Banking Systems, Intelligent Automation technologies including RPA and AI
* Possess good understanding and exposure to SOA, Agile delivery, DevOps and industry standard delivery and quality frameworks.
* Possess excellent people interfacing, negotiation and management skills.
* Excellent team player who can reach out and collaborate very effectively with geographically distributed technology, business function and support teams to deliver to the client.
* Open to travelling extensively to MENA region and work directly with EY clients on projects.
* Experience in creating and conducting impactful client presentations and articulate the technical and non\-technical deliverables to clients at various levels.
* Experience in running physical and virtual workshops independently and well versed with tools and technologies to enable the same.
* Demonstrable professional technical writing expertise, visual representation, and language skills.
* Experienced in productivity and diagramming tools like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio
* Experience in working with clients in MENA GCC countries desirable.
* Enterprise Architecture Certification desirable
* Experience in enterprise architecture tools desirable


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

5a85a281.title: Senior Solution Engineer
5a85a281.description:
**Location:** 
 Kolkata, India
   

  

**Function:** 
 DEAI Hitachi Vantara
   

  

**Requisition ID:** 
 R0136284
   

  

**Our Company**
 We're Hitachi Vantara, the data foundation trusted by the world's innovators. Our resilient, high\-performance data infrastructure means that customers \- from banks to theme parks \- can focus on achieving the incredible with data. If you've seen the Las Vegas Sphere, you've seen just one example of how we empower businesses to automate, optimize, innovate \- and wow their customers. Right now, we're laying the foundation for our next wave of growth. We're looking for people who love being part of a diverse, global team \- and who get excited about making a real\-world impact with data.
   

  

**The Team**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and adaptable
 **Solutions Engineer** 
 to bridge the gap between complex cloud infrastructure technologies and real\-world customer solutions. In this role, you will design, build, and implementation\-test cutting\-edge platform architectures that blend traditional virtualization with modern cloud\-native ecosystems.
   

  

 You will work closely with engineering teams and enterprise customers to architect, automate, and deploy resilient infrastructure stacks across bare\-metal, virtualized, and containerized environments.
   

  

**The Role**
**Architecture \& Deployment:** 
 Design and implement robust infrastructure solutions leveraging both container orchestration (Kubernetes) and traditional cloud computing platforms (OpenStack).
   

  

**Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** 
 Automate the provisioning, configuration, and management of complex environments using Terraform and Ansible to ensure repeatable, error\-free deployments.
   

  

**Hybrid Virtualization:** 
 Bridge the gap between legacy VMs and modern containers by deploying and managing KVM and Kube\-virt solutions.
   

  

**Automation \& Scripting:** 
 Write clean, maintainable Python and Bash scripts to automate routine tasks, build internal tools, and integrate disparate systems.
   

  

**Infrastructure Management:** 
 Optimize and troubleshoot core compute resources, storage architectures, and networking layers to ensure high availability and performance.
   

  

**Technical Consultation:** 
 Act as a trusted technical advisor to stakeholders, translating complex infrastructure requirements into scalable engineering designs.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
 Containerization \& Virtualization
   

  

**Kubernetes:** 
 Deep, production\-grade experience with K8s orchestration, architecture, and ecosystem tools.
   

  

**OpenStack:** 
 Proven track record of deploying, configuring, and managing OpenStack components.
   

  

**KVM \& Kube\-virt:** 
 Strong understanding of kernel\-based virtual machines (KVM) and experience running traditional virtual machines inside Kubernetes clusters using Kube\-virt.
   

  

 Automation \& IaC
   

  

**Scripting:** 
 Proficiency in
 **Python** 
 and
 **Bash** 
 for system automation and tool development.
   

  

**Infrastructure as Code:** 
 Hands\-on experience with
 **Terraform** 
 (for provisioning) and
 **Ansible** 
 (for configuration management).
   

  

 Core Infrastructure
   

  

**Compute:** 
 In\-depth knowledge of physical/virtual compute resource management and optimization.
   

  

**Storage:** 
 Strong understanding of storage technologies, including
 **Storage Area Networks (SAN)** 
 and
 **local disk technologies** 
 (NVMe, SSD, RAID configurations).
   

  

**Networking:** 
 Solid foundation in networking concepts, specifically
 **Layer 2 (L2\)** 
 and
 **Layer 3 (L3\)** 
 protocols, switching, routing, and software\-defined networking (SDN).
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 Relevant certifications (e.g., CKA/CKAD, OpenStack Professional, AWS/GCP/Azure Architect).
   

  

 Experience in a customer\-facing technical role (Pre\-sales, Solutions Architecture, or Professional Services).
   

  

 Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to debug complex, distributed systems.
   

  

**About Us**
 We're a global team of innovators. Together, we harness engineering excellence and passion for insight to co\-create meaningful solutions to complex challenges. We turn organizations into data\-driven leaders that can make a positive impact on their industries and society. If you believe that innovation can inspire the future, this is the place to fulfil your purpose and achieve your potential.
   

  

**Fostering innovation through diverse perspectives**
 Hitachi is a global company operating across a wide range of industries and regions. One of the things that sets Hitachi apart is the diversity of our business and people, which drives our innovation and growth.
   

  

 We are committed to building an inclusive culture based on mutual respect and merit\-based systems. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and safe to express themselves, they do their best work.
   

  

**How We Look After You**
 We help take care of your today and tomorrow with industry\-leading benefits, support, and services that look after your holistic health and wellbeing. We're also champions of life balance and offer flexible arrangements that work for you (role and location dependent). We're always looking for new ways of working that bring out our best, which leads to unexpected ideas. **The Role**
