 **Architect** 
 to design and implement complex systems and software architectures across multiple platforms. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in systems architecture, software engineering, cloud technologies, and team leadership. You will be responsible for translating business requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions and guiding development teams through implementation.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Design, plan, and manage cloud architectures leveraging AWS, Azure, and GCP, ensuring alignment with business objectives and industry best practices.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate cloud services and emerging technologies to enhance system performance, scalability, and security.
* Lead the development and integration of software solutions using a variety of programming languages (Java, .NET, Python, Golang, etc.).
* Develop and maintain automated solutions for cloud provisioning, governance, and lifecycle management, utilizing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform and Ansible.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, translate business needs into technical specifications, and deliver robust cloud\-native solutions.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, translate business needs into technical specifications, and deliver robust cloud\-native solutions.
* Guide and mentor development teams, enforcing architectural standards, coding best practices, and technical excellence.
* Provide expert consultation to internal and external stakeholders, offering recommendations on cloud migration, modernization, and optimization strategies.
* Ensure compliance with security, regulatory, and cost management policies across cloud environments.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices, proactively introducing innovations to the organization.


**Required Skills And Professional Experience**
* 10\+ years of experience in software architecture, including significant experience with cloud infrastructure and hyperscaler platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Deep expertise in at least one hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with working knowledge of the others.
* Strong programming skills in multiple languages (Java, C\#, Node, JavaScript, .NET, Python, Golang, etc.).
* Experience with services/micro\-services development and relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, etc.)
* Expertise in open\-source technologies and NoSQL/RDBMS such as Couchbase, Elasticsearch, RabbitMQ, MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis, etc.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Knowledge in Project Management tools and Agile Methodologies.
* Certification in AWS or Azure is preferred.


**Your future at Presidio**
 Joining Presidio means stepping into a culture of trailblazers—thinkers, builders, and collaborators—who push the boundaries of what’s possible. With our expertise in AI\-driven analytics, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and next\-gen infrastructure, we enable businesses to stay ahead in an ever\-evolving digital world.
   

  

 Here, your impact is real. Whether you're harnessing the power of Generative AI, architecting resilient digital ecosystems, or driving data\-driven transformation, you’ll be part of a team that is shaping the future.
   

  

**Ready to innovate? Let’s redefine what’s next—together.**
**About Presidio**
 At Presidio, speed and quality meet technology and innovation. Presidio is a trusted ally for organizations across industries with a decades\-long history of building traditional IT foundations and deep expertise in AI and automation, security, networking, digital transformation, and cloud computing. Presidio fills gaps, removes hurdles, optimizes costs, and reduces risk. Presidio’s expert technical team develops custom applications, provides managed services, enables actionable data insights and builds forward\-thinking solutions that drive strategic outcomes for clients globally.
 **For more information, visit www.presidio.com** 
**.**
 Presidio is committed to hiring the most qualified candidates to join our amazing culture. We aim to attract and hire top talent from all backgrounds, including underrepresented and marginalized communities. We encourage women, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans to apply for open roles at Presidio. Diversity of skills and thought is a key component to our business success.
   

  

***Recruitment Agencies, Please Note:***
 Presidio does not accept unsolicited agency resumes/CVs. Do not forward resumes/CVs to our careers email address, Presidio employees or any other means. Presidio is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/CVs.

4cb62c58.title: Tech Infrastructure Program Manager, AWS Data Center Planning & Delivery
4cb62c58.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low\-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.  

Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ?  

If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Telengana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on\-time and at\-cost.  

You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering with strong urge to learn will be essential.  

Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in India. They manage 10\+ projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on\-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity.  

The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region\-wide knowledge and monitoring of in\-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.  

A successful TPM must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts  

  

About the team  

Diverse Experiences:  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

Work/Life Balance:  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

Inclusive Team Culture:  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship and Career Growth:  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical infrastructure management experience
* Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)
* Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with large scale infrastructure

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

LIGHT has completed more than a decade of growth and has emerged as a major new product development and sustaining engineering team for Lam’s global engineering footprint.

**Minimum Qualifications**
**Who we’re looking for**

* Design and implement automation solutions using:

* 4 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role.
* Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms.
* Experience building full\-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 4 years of experience in software development, systems architecture, or a highly technical customer\-facing role with proficiency in one of more general\-purpose programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go).
* Experience managing the technical pre\-sales cycle, from initial scoping and architecture design to the successful delivery of integrated PoVs.
* Deep experience with cloud\-native application development.
* Demonstrated experience designing and building AI applications.


**About the job** 
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the deep technical bridge between customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer Proof\-of\-Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. You will keep the final production end\-state in mind from day one, advocate for AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead deep\-dive technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape, designing comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end\-state in mind.
* Move seamlessly from high\-level architecture to low\-level implementation, actively coding, building, and deploy cloud systems, ensuring technical designs translate into functional, integrated realities.
* Architect and engineer enterprise\-grade AI solutions such as agentic workflows, Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and applied foundation models, backed by highly scalable, cloud\-native infrastructure including event\-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.
* Engineer functional PoV products that integrate into the customer's as\-is systems to demonstrate true business value, ensuring all builds adhere strictly to engineering best practices, security standards, and scalability guidelines to ensure a smooth transition to production.

682bf3e0.title: Data Architect
682bf3e0.description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**
 At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting\-edge digital solutions and next\-generation AI. We empower businesses \- and their internal customers \- to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.
   

  

**The Role**
 The Architect for Data Practice will lead the design, architecture and implementation of scalable, secure, cost\-effective cloud solution across major hyperscaler’s like AWS, Azure and GCP etc., This role is required the dynamic of professional who is willing to explore emerging technologies, programming languages with strong consulting and stakeholder management skills.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Ability to understand the business requirements and to decompose for further analysis
* Proven track record in architecting performant and highly\-scalable Data Platform
* Ability to understand customer’s business outcomes and to guide the customer through a Data workshop
* The aptitude and attitude needed to be a Trusted Advisor to the customer
* Understanding of various architectural patterns in Big Data
* Ability to operate in an agile environment
* Ability to actively seek out optimization approaches for Data Platform
* Ability to understand and articulate a problem
* Proven track record on Presales engagements


**Required Skills And Professional Experience**
* Data Modeling: Design and develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models that define data storage, processing, and access patterns. Ensure models support current and future business needs and align with data governance standards.
* Data Integration: Architect solutions to integrate data from diverse sources, enabling unified and consistent data access across the organization. Ensure seamless data flow between systems including legacy and modern platforms.
* Data Warehouse and Data Lake Architecture: Design scalable, efficient, and secure data warehouse and data lake/lakehouse architectures that support analytics and reporting requirements. Implement best practices in dimensional and normalized modeling for data warehouses.
* Cloud Data Platform Modernization: Lead migration and modernization efforts from legacy on\-premises databases (e.g., Informix) to cloud\-native or hybrid cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. Develop detailed migration plans ensuring data integrity, security, and minimal downtime.
* Proficiency in Databricks/Snowflake: Utilize Databricks or Snowflake for building modern data platforms, including data processing, storage, and analytics. Optimize performance and scalability of these platforms.
* Relational and Non\-Relational Database Expertise: Manage and optimize relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, CosmosDB, DocumentDB) as part of the data architecture.
* Data Security and Governance: Establish and enforce data governanc frameworks, data quality standards, and security policies to ensure compliance and protect sensitive information.
* Performance Optimization: Monitor and tune database and data platfor performance to meet business SLAs and optimize costs, including scaling and replication strategies in cloud environments.
* Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Work closely with business analysts data engineers, data scientists, and IT teams to align data architecture with organizational goals and ensure smooth implementation.
* Technology Selection and Strategy: Evaluate and select appropriate technologies and tools for data storage, processing, and analytics that align with business needs and future scalability.
* Documentation and Continuous Improvement: Maintain architecture design documents, update standards, and stay current with emerging data technologies to continuously improve data solutions.
* Experience with Lakehouse Architectures: Knowledge of combining data lake flexibility with data warehouse performance in lakehouse solutions to support diverse analytics workloads.
* ETL/ELT Design and Automation: Design and implement efficient extract transform\-load processes and automation for data ingestion and processing pipelines.
* Cloud Certifications: Certifications in AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform that validate cloud architecture skills and best practices.


**Preferred Skills And Professional Experience**
* Cost\-Benefit Analysis and ROI Assessment: Ability to assess financial and operational impacts of data platform choices and migrations to optimize investment.
* Leadership and Project Management: Lead teams and projects involving multiple stakeholders, manage deadlines, and facilitate testing and deployment phases.
* Data Visualization and Reporting: Support creation of dashboards and reports that provide actionable insights from data architectures.
* Security Implementation: Hands\-on experience with implementing advanced security measures such as threat\-driven security settings, SSL certificates, and access controls.
* Support for Multi\-Cloud and Hybrid Environments: Design architectures that function seamlessly across multiple cloud providers and on\-premises systems.


**Your future at Presidio**
 Joining Presidio means stepping into a culture of trailblazers \- thinkers, builders, and collaborators \- who push the boundaries of what's possible. With our expertise AI\-driven analytics, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and next\-gen infrastructure, we enable businesses to stay ahead in an ever\-evolving digital world.
   

  

 Here, your impact is real. Whether you're harnessing the power of Generative AI, architecting resilient digital ecosystems, or driving data\-driven transformation, you'll be part of a team that is shaping the future.
   

  

**Ready to innovate? Let's redefine what's next\-together.**
**About Presidio**
 Presidio is committed to hiring the most qualified candidates to join our amazing culture. We aim to attract and hire top talent from all backgrounds, including underrepresented and marginalized communities. We encourage women, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans to apply for open roles at Presidio. Diversity of skills and thought is a key component to our business success.
   

  

 At Presidio, speed and quality meet technology and innovation. Presidio is a trusted ally for organizations across industries with a decades\-long history of building traditional IT foundations and deep expertise in AI and automation, security, networking, digital transformation, and cloud computing. Presidio fills gaps, removes hurdles, optimizes costs, and reduces risk. Presidio's expert technical team develops custom applications, provides managed services, and enables actionable data insights and builds forward\-thinking solutions that drive strategic outcomes for clients globally. For more information visit
   

  

*Applications will be accepted on a rolling basis.*
*Presidio has a strong commitment to the community we serve and our employees. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we strive to have a workforce that includes the community we serve.*
***Recruitment Agencies, Please Note:***
 Presidio does not accept unsolicited agency resumes/CVs. Do not forward resumes/CVs to our career's email address, Presidio employees or any other means. Presidio is not responsible for any feeds related to unsolicited resumes/CVs.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Excellent ability to influence without authority and drive consensus across engineering, product, and UX.
* Exceptional communication skills, articulating complex topics to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Skilled in navigating ambiguity, proactively identifying and mitigating risks, and managing dependencies.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem.
   

  

 As a Technical Program Manager (TPM) in the gUP TSI Program Management Office (PMO), you will lead and drive the execution of complex, cross\-functional programs critical to gUP's top priorities. You will take ownership of significant initiatives, potentially spanning areas like the Generative AI\-powered help guide, enhancing User Voice feedback systems, or refining engineering operations and governance frameworks.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Product Management, and UX teams to define program scope, develop detailed execution plans, manage dependencies, mitigate risks, and ensure on\-time delivery. This role requires a strong ability to manage ambiguity, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and make sound technical judgments. You will be responsible for driving alignment across teams, communicating progress effectively, and proactively solving problems to keep high\-impact programs on track. We are looking for an experienced TPM who can operate independently and contribute to improving program management practices within TSI.
   

  

 In gTech Users and Products (gUP), our mission is to advocate for Google’s users by creating helpful and trusted experiences across the product ecosystem. We achieve this by meeting partners and consumers where they are with support and help, representing their needs with our product partners and proposing fixes and features that elevate their engagement with Google's diverse product ecosystem. Additionally we provide a range of product services that ensure our products are optimized for every user, no matter where they are in the world (e.g., localization, digitization, partner integration and more).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive and own the delivery of complex, high\-impact programs, from technical scoping and design through global launch, landing, and maintenance.
* Apply deep technical understanding to proactively identify and resolve complex system\-level blockers, guiding technical decisions within Generative AI architecture, prompt engineering, and data pipelines.
* Influence and align cross\-functional teams (Engineering, Product, UX) and stakeholders on program goals, technical approaches, and priorities, driving consensus and unblocking progress.
* Contribute to product and program strategy by identifying opportunities, defining clear project goals, and ensuring alignment with broader gUP objectives.
* Design, implement, and drive adoption of scalable frameworks, best practices, and data\-driven OKRs to improve program execution, monitor health, and enhance communication with leadership.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. 928b253c.title: Tech Infrastructure Program Manager, AWS Data Center Planning & Delivery
928b253c.description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Amazon Web Service (AWS) is a comprehensive, evolving, and growing business unit within Amazon.com. Since early 2006, AWS has provided a highly reliable, scalable, low\-cost cloud infrastructure platform that empowers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries to innovate and invent.
   

  

 Do you have the business background, complex cross functional program management experience, financial expertise, legal/regulatory comprehension and technical understanding? Can you communicate effectively, find clarity in ambiguity, and simplicity in complexity ?
   

  

 If yes, then come and explore this exciting role. This role in Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (ADSIPL) Telengana builds infrastructure that hosts AWS cloud services. It delivers AWS cloud infrastructure in a challenging, high growth, fast paced and customer focused work environment. In this role, you will lead cross functional teams to deliver usable data center capacity. You will partner with senior stakeholders to develop, document, manage and deliver infrastructure designs, implementation schedules and budgets. You will earn trust of your partners in your ability to solve complex issues and steer teams in right direction to deliver results, on\-time and at\-cost.
   

  

 You must be an exceptionally strong communicator (both written and verbal), and possess relevant experience in managing technical and strategic programs. If you bring past experience in data center deployment programs, great. If not, then having a background in program and project management, architecture/design, mechanical/electrical engineering, software/hardware engineering with strong urge to learn will be essential.
   

  

 Come Join us, have fun, and create history!!
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Infrastructure TPM owns delivery of new DC across one or more availability zones in India. They manage 10\+ projects at any time. They bridge internal customers, business functions, (Planning, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Policy, Operations), and functional delivery teams (Construction, Commissioning, Controls, Fiber and Network) to enable on\-time and right sized delivery of new DC capacity.
   

  

 The scope begins with early expansion planning, which includes a feasibility analysis to approve expansion plans and associated build timelines. They evaluate multiple factors prior to approving a new plan of record, including owned/leased/collocated DC supply, utility delivery (power, water, and fiber), and long lead equipment (LLE) availability. It requires region\-wide knowledge and monitoring of in\-flight projects, major risks, and remediation efforts to ensure DC delivery is not only on track to meet supply commitments but also to meet customer demand, which is constantly changing.
   

  

 A successful TPM must be capable of managing a combination of metrics, tools, and mechanisms to remain aware of ongoing risks or issues that require their action, decision, mitigations, or effort to identify alternative solutions communicating up, down, and across the organization to align direction, gain support and drive remediation efforts
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences:
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

**Work/Life Balance**
 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**Inclusive Team Culture**
 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

**Mentorship And Career Growth**
 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

**Preferred Qualifications**

57f8a55b.title: Solutions Architect -AWS
57f8a55b.description:
**About Us**
 At Rhythm, our values form the foundation of our business. We are passionate about customer success, innovation, and our employees. They guide our actions, decisions, and interactions, ensuring that we consistently make a positive impact on the world around us.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Position Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a rare, highly skilled hybrid AWS Solutions Architect \& Software Developer to join our core product engineering team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between high\-level cloud architecture and hands\-on backend development. You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and code\-authoring the robust cloud infrastructure that powers our data core.
   

  

 The primary focus of this position is architecting and developing the high\-throughput pipelines that process raw "fleet exhaust data" (noise) in AWS and funnel actionable summaries (signals) into our enterprise presentation layer. You will heavily focus on complex data orchestrations and integrations across AWS, Salesforce Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and critical third\-party fleet compliance ecosystems.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 As a hybrid Architect and Developer, your responsibilities will span architectural design, core systems programming, and cross\-platform ecosystem integration:
   

  

 Cloud Architecture \& Strategy
   

  

* Design \& Scale: Architect and optimize secure, scalable, and cost\-effective cloud infrastructures capable of ingesting massive, high\-velocity streaming data environments.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop and maintain production\-ready CloudFormation or Terraform templates to ensure fully automated, repeatable environment deployments.
* CI/CD Leadership: Establish and govern standardized CI/CD pipelines that continuously decrease time\-to\-production for new backend features while enforcing rigorous quality and testing gates.
* Security \& Trust: Design and implement a robust Cloud Trust Architecture ensuring compliance with stringent data protection best practices and role\-based access control.


 Backend Software Engineering
   

  

* Write Robust Backend Code: Write clean, highly performant, and scalable code (primarily utilizing Python or Node.js) to build core AWS backend services, APIs, and microservices.
* Data Processing \& AI: Program state\-of\-the\-art serverless workflows utilizing AWS Lambda, EventBridge, and Amazon Bedrock to compute derived risk indicators (e.g., speeding minutes per 100 miles, trend slope tracking).
* Database \& Knowledge Lake Management: Optimize structured and unstructured data persistence strategies across Amazon S3, RDS instances, and managed Vector Databases.
* Testing \& Quality Assurance: Author and run extensive unit and integration tests for AWS\-based applications, lead code reviews, and aggressively improve core data processing algorithms.


 Multi\-Platform Ecosystem Integration
   

  

* Ecosystem Orchestration: Architect the ingestion paths for high\-velocity telematics and IoT data, isolating massive volume processing in AWS before translating relevant indicators to executive CRM workflows.
* Telematics \& Compliance Integration: Build and maintain direct API data pipelines integrating heavy enterprise platforms and third\-party systems including:
+ Telematics Infrastructure: Deep integration with providers like Verizon Connect (VZC) to ingest real\-time engine diagnostics, GPS, and harsh event data.
+ Regulatory Compliance: Integrations with FMCSA API systems (including SAFER, SMS, A\&I, and DataQs datasets).
+ Risk \& Personnel Platforms: Synchronized identity management pipelines with Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) monitoring and Learning Management Systems (LMS) such as Samba Safety, Sentix, or related Risk Cloud environments.

* Salesforce \& MuleSoft Collaboration: Partner closely with application teams to orchestrate end\-to\-end event\-driven flows using MuleSoft for bidirectional Roster CRUD logic, linking the AWS Knowledge Lake cleanly with Salesforce Data Cloud and AgentForce.


**Requirements**
 What We're Looking For
   

  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Experience:
+ Minimum of 5–7 years of proven hands\-on software development experience writing clean production code.
+ Minimum of 2 years of dedicated experience acting as an AWS Solutions Architect designing complex, multi\-system integration topographies.

* AWS Certifications: Valid AWS Certifications are strongly preferred (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS Certified Developer – Associate).
* Technical Proficiency:
+ Languages: Advanced proficiency in Python or Node.js.
+ AWS Infrastructure: Deep knowledge of AWS S3, Lambda, EventBridge, Amazon Bedrock, Lex, Connect, SES, and native database layers (RDS, DynamoDB, or Vector DBs).
+ Integration Tech: Exceptional familiarity with building and consuming web services across API, REST, and RPC architectures.
+ Containers: Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes environments for containerized compute deployment.

* Domain Context: Prior experience writing applications that parse telematics data, cellular/IoT streams, geographic spatial boundaries, or government/compliance API interfaces is a significant advantage.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a dedicated approach to data\-driven technical execution and clear, transparent team communication.

1630b1f3.title: Solution Architect - SAP Sustainability Control Tower (ESG)
1630b1f3.description:
About the job
 



  





**WHO YOU ARE** 




  





 We are looking for a Solution Architect to join us in shaping and evolving how IKEA delivers value to our customers and ensures our solutions remain scalable, compliant, and future\-ready.
 



  





 Our diverse team is growing, and we would love to speak with you if you recognize yourself in some of the following:
 



  




* Passion for designing robust, scalable enterprise architectures that translate complex ESG and sustainability requirements into practical, compliant, and reliable solutions.
* Strong experience in SAP Sustainability Control Tower (SCT) and SAP Disclosure Management (DM), with a solid understanding of how these integrate within the broader SAP ecosystem.
* Proven ability to take end\-to\-end ownership of architecture decisions, ensuring alignment with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and measurable outcomes.
* Hands\-on experience designing and delivering enterprise solutions across SAP SCT, SAP Datasphere, and SAP DM, including data models, integrations, workflows, and reporting layers.
* Experience working with statutory reporting, ESG reporting, or financial/non\-financial regulatory reporting frameworks.
* Comfortable operating in complex, cross\-functional, and international environments, collaborating effectively with Finance, Sustainability, and Technology stakeholders.
* Strong collaboration mindset, actively building relationships across teams and contributing to knowledge sharing and collective success.
* Curious and self\-driven, with a continuous learning mindset and the ability to adapt in a fast\-moving regulatory and technology landscape.



  





 This is our wish list! If you don’t recognize yourself in all these points, you might still be an excellent candidate for the role.
 



  





 The must\-haves we see for this role is though:
 



  




* Extensive SAP architecture experience, including hands\-on expertise with SAP Sustainability Control Tower and SAP Disclosure Management.
* Proven track record in designing and delivering enterprise\-scale data and reporting solutions within ESG, sustainability, or statutory reporting domains.
* A relevant degree in IT, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience, combined with strong capabilities in data architecture, integration design, and enterprise system thinking.



  





 At IKEA culture our values are central to how we work every day. We believe they shape how we collaborate, make decisions, and grow together. To thrive here, it’s important that you share these values.
 



  





 You can read more about life and culture at IKEA on our website www.ikea.com.
 



  





  





  





**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US** 




  





 You'll own the end\-to\-end architecture of our statutory and ESG reporting landscape, playing a key role in IKEA's transformation towards a more data\-driven and compliant organization. Working closely with colleagues across Finance, Sustainability, and Technology, you'll ensure our reporting solutions are scalable, resilient, and ready to meet evolving regulatory requirements.
 



  





 In practice, you will:
 



  




* Design and continuously evolve the end\-to\-end solution architecture across SAP Sustainability Control Tower (SCT), SAP Datasphere, and SAP Disclosure Management (DM), ensuring scalability, performance, and compliance by design.
* Partner with business, Finance, and Sustainability stakeholders to translate regulatory requirements—including CSRD, ISSB, and future reporting standards—into practical, well\-structured technology solutions.
* Define and govern architecture principles, development standards, and best practices across SAP applications, data flows, integrations, and reporting implementations, while providing technical leadership throughout delivery.
* Drive continuous improvement by evaluating new SAP capabilities and identifying opportunities to enhance automation, data quality, reporting performance, and operational efficiency.
* Stay ahead of the evolving ESG and statutory reporting landscape, ensuring IKEA is well positioned to respond quickly to new regulations and business needs.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects, platform teams, and delivery teams to ensure solutions align with the broader enterprise architecture and digital strategy.



  





  





**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 




  





 We’re the ones who make it possible for people to have a smarter life at home and a hassle\-free and rewarding shopping experience. Together we work to find new digital solutions for every business need to help make IKEA a great and efficient place to work. We like to think of ourselves as innovative and modern, and we believe that nothing would actually work without us.

-----------------

39f5a92c.description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

**Role Overview**


Support, maintain, and enhance reservoir engineering functionalities and integrated reservoir\-to\-surface workflows within ForCFR, a digital platform integrating reservoir performance, production forecasting, and carbon footprint (GHG emissions) assessment for field development decision\-making. Ensure reliable data integration, workflow automation, and continuous improvement of engineering workflows across affiliates.

**Key Responsibilities:**


1\. Own and support the integration of reservoir engineering workflows within ForCFR, ensuring seamless data exchange between reservoir simulation tools (INTERSECT/GAP) and the digital platform.


2\. Validate, test, and troubleshoot automated workflows and export processes to guarantee accurate, reliable, and efficient transfer of technical data across engineering applications.


3\. Conduct reservoir engineering analyses and sensitivity studies, supporting production forecasting, field development evaluations, and operational decision\-making.


4\. Ensure data quality and consistency by validating engineering inputs, workflow outputs, and integration results used by reservoir and production engineers.


5\. Gather business needs and define functional improvements, translating reservoir engineering requirements into digital solution enhancements that improve user efficiency and workflow performance.


6\. Provide technical and functional support to affiliates and end users, helping engineering teams adopt and effectively utilize ForCFR capabilities.


7\. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and HQ stakeholders to develop, test, and deploy new functionalities, integrations, and workflow enhancements.


8\. Drive continuous improvement of integrated reservoir\-to\-surface workflows, promoting best practices in automation, data management, and digital reservoir engineering.


9\. Act as a bridge between reservoir engineering and digital product development, ensuring engineering requirements are effectively translated into practical and scalable digital solutions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Degree in Petroleum or Reservoir Engineering.
* 8\+ years of Process Engineering experience.

2dffad6d.description:
**Job Title:** 
 Senior IT Solutions Architect
   

  

**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 IT Director
   

  

**About Ceres India**
 At Ceres India Private Limited, we support initiatives that help communities recover, rebuild, and strengthen resilience. As part of the Ceres Global network of companies, we contribute to disaster recovery, infrastructure restoration, environmental services, and critical response operations through engineering, technology, innovation, and operational excellence. From India, we help enable faster decisions, stronger delivery, and meaningful outcomes where they matter most. The purpose is at the core of what we do. We are building an environment where talent can do meaningful work, take ownership, grow with the business, and be part of something larger than themselves.
   

  

**Driven by Purpose, Powered by People**
 At Ceres India, we believe you’re more than just an employee; you’re part of a team with a purpose and a meaningful mission. Every team member plays a vital role in restoring hope, helping communities recover and rebuild.
   

  

 We value initiative, respect diversity, and give our people the freedom to lead. We offer competitive pay, growth opportunities, travel, and a culture built on resilience and teamwork. If you show up with compassion, share the commitment, react with urgency, and deliver solutions, you’ll fit right in. We don’t just respond to challenges; we rise to them.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 We are seeking a Senior IT Solutions Architect to help design and build a next\-generation, field\-first technology platform that supports Ceres’ expanding operations in forestry, infrastructure, and disaster response. This role will be instrumental in bridging business needs with scalable, secure, and modern technology solutions. Must have experience designing and building software business applications.
   

  

 This is a highly hands\-on role focused on building real\-world systems. Projects will include mobile and web applications that integrate data from drones, sensors, LiDAR, AI, and rugged field equipment. The ideal candidate will operate across architecture and execution, working closely with both technical teams and field operations to ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and effective in remote and offline environments.
   

  

 Success in the first 12 months will include defining core system architecture, leading initial product builds, and delivering solutions that are actively used by field teams.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Design and develop end\-to\-end solution architectures that align with business objectives, scalability, and long\-term growth.
* Lead the design and development of mobile and web applications supporting field operations and data collection.
* Evaluate and select appropriate technologies, platforms, and tools to meet functional and non\-functional requirements.
* Build systems that integrate data from multiple sources, including LiDAR, sensors, drones, and real\-time field inputs.
* Ensure systems are designed for offline and low\-connectivity environments with reliable data synchronization.
* Guide teams through design, development, testing, deployment, and post go\-live support.
* Serve as a technical subject matter expert across cloud, infrastructure, application, and integration domains.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code assessments, and technical risk evaluations.
* Partner with business stakeholders to translate operational workflows into scalable technical solutions.
* Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
* Take ownership of project delivery, ensuring architectural alignment throughout implementation.
* Mentor and support engineering teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field.
* 12\+ years of experience in solutions architecture, system design, or enterprise engineering with a track record of building applications.
* Proven experience designing and building software applications (web, mobile, or enterprise platforms).
* Strong experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred).
* Experience with APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and modern DevOps practices.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, databases, and system integration patterns.
* Experience building systems that operate in offline or low\-connectivity environments.
* Experience integrating AI or data\-driven systems into production environments.
* Strong communication, leadership, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to travel to remote field locations as needed.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working with LiDAR, GIS systems, sensors, or real\-time data capture technologies.
* Knowledge of forestry, environmental services, or field\-based operations.
* Experience with Microsoft development environments and low\-code platforms (e.g., OutSystems).


**What To Expect**
 This role blends architecture, hands\-on development, and real\-world problem solving. You will work closely with both technical teams and field personnel, requiring adaptability and a willingness to operate in evolving and sometimes ambiguous environments.
   

  

**Expect To**
* Collaborate across business, operations, and engineering teams
* Engage with field crews to understand workflows and system needs
* Design and build systems that function in rugged, real\-world conditions
* Travel occasionally to support product design, testing, and deployment


**Physical Requirements And Environment**
 Ceres provides reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities and to applicants with sincerely held religious beliefs, as required by law. The physical requirements listed below reflect the essential functions of this role. If you need accommodation to perform these functions, please inform us during the application process.
   

  

**Why Join Ceres India?**
 At Ceres India, you won’t just have a job, you’ll have a mission. Your work will directly impact the speed and strength of community recovery after disasters.
   

  

**We Offer**
* A collaborative, mission\-driven culture.
* Opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* The chance to make a lasting difference for communities.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience managing the technical pre\-sales cycle, from initial scoping and architecture design to the successful delivery of integrated PoVs.
* Deep experience with cloud\-native application development.
* Demonstrated experience designing and building AI applications.


**About the job** 
 When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem\-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
   

  

 As an Applied Solutions Architect within the Google Cloud Go\-To\-Market (GTM) team, you will act as the deep technical bridge between customers' business challenges and Google’s engineering capabilities. You will work closely with customers to uncover their needs, architect scalable systems, and write code and build real\-world applications.
   

  

 You will not be building in a vacuum. Your core objective is to engineer Proof\-of\-Value (PoV) products designed to integrate seamlessly into a customer’s existing, "as\-is" systems. You will keep the final production end\-state in mind from day one, advocate for AI and cloud\-native solutions to not only look great on a whiteboard but function flawlessly in their actual enterprise environment.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead deep\-dive technical discovery sessions to understand customer requirements and their current technology landscape, designing comprehensive system architectures and run iterative workshops with stakeholders to lock in project scope, always architecting with the final end\-state in mind.
* Move seamlessly from high\-level architecture to low\-level implementation, actively coding, building, and deploy cloud systems, ensuring technical designs translate into functional, integrated realities.
* Architect and engineer enterprise\-grade AI solutions such as agentic workflows, Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) systems, and applied foundation models, backed by highly scalable, cloud\-native infrastructure including event\-driven microservices, containerized workloads, and serverless compute.
* Engineer functional PoV products that integrate into the customer's as\-is systems to demonstrate true business value, ensuring all builds adhere strictly to engineering best practices, security standards, and scalability guidelines to ensure a smooth transition to production.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

 The Solution Architect will partner with business stakeholders, product owners, enterprise architecture, data and analytics teams, cybersecurity, legal, compliance, delivery teams, and external vendors to translate business needs into practical Enterprise AI solutions. * Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics and security best practices.
* Familiarity with industry\- or vertical\-specific solutions (preferred).
* Communication \& Leadership
* Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options and drive stakeholder alignment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and executive audiences.
* Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead discussions, influence decision\-making and advocate for best practices.
* High proficiency in English.
* Strategic Thinking \& Problem Solving
* Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations and drive customer transformation.
* Provide data\-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.

* Ability to configure and optimize these features to meet business needs.
* Data Management \& Integration
* Proficient in designing and managing data models, relationships (lookup/master\-detail), validation rules and data governance best practices.
* Experience with data import/export strategies, deduplication, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware (MuleSoft, Informatica) and third\-party connectors.
* Secure \& Scalable Architecture
* Expertise in role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets and security configurations.
* Proven ability to design scalable, high\-performance architectures aligned with Salesforce best practices, including Large Data Volume (LDV) considerations.
* Skilled in identifying and resolving common anti\-patterns, including inefficient SOQL queries, improper bulk processing, excessive DML operations and suboptimal sharing and security model configurations.
* Salesforce Development
* Hands\-on experience with APEX programming, Visualforce and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
* Ability to develop and optimize custom triggers, controllers, batch jobs and asynchronous processing.
* Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.
* System Integration \& Extensibility
* Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware and event\-driven architectures.
* Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects and tools like Salesforce Connect and Event Relay.

8aa41a1e.title: ServiceNow-Service Now Architect - ITOM-Manager
8aa41a1e.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**EY\-ServiceNow – Manager \- ITOM Technical Architect**
 As part of our EY GDS\-ServiceNow team, you will work to solve client problems using the ServiceNow platform, specifically focusing on IT Operations Management (ITOM). You will get an opportunity to work with a high\-quality team and build innovative solutions that address complex enterprise challenges.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for a Technical Architect with expertise in ServiceNow ITOM architecture and implementation to join the EY GDS ServiceNow team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in driving ITOM transformation and platform strategy for global clients.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the architecture, design and implementation of ServiceNow ITOM solutions including Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, and Cloud Management
* Define and implement scalable CMDB architecture, governance frameworks, and data models
* Drive end\-to\-end ITOM strategy, aligning ServiceNow capabilities with enterprise IT operations and business goals
* Architect and deliver event correlation, observability, and AIOps solutions using ServiceNow Event Management and integrations
* Design and implement Service Mapping solutions for business services and applications
* Lead Discovery implementation, including MID Server setup, credential management, and troubleshooting
* Drive integration architecture using REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, and third\-party monitoring tools
* Provide technical leadership and mentoring to development and implementation teams
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical and architectural specifications
* Ensure adherence to platform best practices, governance, and security standards
* Support performance tuning, scalability optimization, and platform upgrades
* Drive DevOps and Agile delivery practices across ITOM implementations
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture governance


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong expertise in ServiceNow ITOM modules: Discovery, Service Mapping, Event Management, CMDB, Cloud Management
* Deep understanding of CMDB data modeling, CSDM framework, and data governance
* Experience in AIOps, event correlation, and monitoring tool integrations (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace, SolarWinds)
* Knowledge of infrastructure technologies: servers, networks, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Strong JavaScript, Glide scripting, and ServiceNow platform development skills
* Experience with REST/SOAP integrations and IntegrationHub
* Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field
* Approximately 8–12 years of IT experience, with significant exposure to ServiceNow ITOM
* Proven experience as a Technical Architect or Lead in ServiceNow ITOM implementations
* ServiceNow CSA certification (mandatory)
* ServiceNow CIS – Discovery / Service Mapping (mandatory)
* ITIL Foundation certification (preferred)


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience with CSDM adoption and enterprise CMDB strategy
* Exposure to multi\-cloud environments and cloud discovery
* Knowledge of latest ServiceNow releases and features


**What We Look For**
* A team of people with strong technical expertise, consulting mindset, and innovation\-driven approach
* Individuals passionate about digital transformation and IT operations modernization
* Ability to work in a collaborative, fast\-paced global environment
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

 A day in the life of an Infoscion

* You will review the proposals prepared by consultants, provide guidance, and analyze the solutions defined for the client business problems to identify any potential risks and issues.

* You would be a key contributor in unit\-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high\-quality, value\-adding consulting solutions to customers adhering to the guidelines and processes of the organization. If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!
* Experience in contract governance for infrastructure managed services, Cross Functional Services, SIAM, service management, or multi\-vendor operating models.

* Strong knowledge of contract change management including change request assessment, impact analysis, pricing coordination, approval tracking, documentation, and implementation governance.
* Experience in commercial management including billing validation, invoice support, effort/cost tracking, forecast alignment, consumption reporting, chargeability tracking, and financial governance.
* Ability to coordinate with legal, finance, procurement, delivery, PMO, transition, service management, tower teams, and client stakeholders for contract\-related decisions and escalations.

496bb04a.description:
**Job Requirements**
**Job Title:** 
 Data Quality Delivery Lead
   

  

**Department/Function:** 
 Operations
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 You will be part of the Data Operations team at IDFC First Bank. The individual will manage Data Quality Issue Management lifecycle through various stages until closure. This requires good understanding of Indian Banking industry, data sources, Regulatory Reporting and Compliance along with best practices of data definitions, mapping, process documentation, business requirement documentation.
   

  

 The person will coordinate, facilitate meetings, discussion for root cause analysis of issues, and role assignment to resolution and ensure tracking of SLA/TAT for timely closure of Data Quality Issues. Metrics reporting of issue progress and other critical data quality reporting to support Data Operations function. The role expects end to end ownership of all Data Operations related quality issues across banking source systems as well as downstream reporting applications.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities:**
* Participate in the definition of functional requirements for the Data Quality Rules and draft the reporting process documents as well as data mapping of Reporting Data Elements (RDEs).
* Handle all Data Quality Business Rules, default profiling and identify exception reporting using tools like SAS Data Flux/Enterprise Guide.
* Develop documentation to support the effective on\-boarding and SME/Business knowledge transfer to Data Operations team members.
* Liaison with Tech to ensure remediation of data cleansing at source as well as for flow data.
* Connect business users with data owners to ensure data structures, definitions and uses are comprehensively understood.
* Document processes and procedures for resolution, develop strategies for effective data analysis and reporting.
* Lead upfront analysis of Data Quality Issue management and various metrics reporting.
* End to end understanding of banking data life cycle in Indian banking scenario is a plus.
* The individual will also help layout the Data Quality roadmap ownership with technology teams to ensure we can capture all data quality exceptions, results and issue reporting capabilities.
* Basic SQL skills, DQ tools knowledge(optional)
* Prepare Data Quality reports for multiple sources.
* Quickly define and deconstruct problems, identify patterns, identify root causes, manage risk, proposes solution paths. Controls and innovation mind\-set.
* Superior organizational and project management skills
* Excellent issue resolution and negotiation skills


**Educational Qualifications:**
 Graduation: Bachelor of Commerce (B.com) / Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) / Bachelor of Arts (BA) / Bachelor of Business \& Insurance (BBI) / Bachelor of Management Studies (BMS)
   

  

 Post\-Graduation: Master of Business Administration (MBA) / Master of Commerce (M.com) / Master of Arts (MA)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 5 \- 10 years of relevant experience
