bef48775.title: Technical Program Manager [T500-28242]
bef48775.description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.** 




**About Brink’s:** 




 Brink’s is a global leader in secure logistics and cash management, operating in more than 50 countries. As the company evolves into a technology\-enabled, data\-driven organization, Brink’s is transforming how work is delivered across functions to create greater scale, consistency, and efficiency.
 



 At Brink’s, you will be part of a global team focused on driving operational excellence and supporting enterprise transformation. You will have the opportunity to build critical skills, collaborate with experienced professionals, and contribute to work that has real impact across the business. Brink’s is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people can grow, contribute, and build meaningful careers.
 



  





**About Global Shared Services Center, India:** 




 Brink’s Global Shared Services Center (GSS) in Hyderabad is a critical enabler of the company’s global transformation and operating model evolution. The center brings together specialized capabilities across Human Resources, Finance, Technology, and other enterprise functions to deliver integrated, end\-to\-end services that support global business priorities.
 



 The center is designed to enable standardized processes, scalable service delivery, and stronger cross\-functional collaboration. Teams in GSS partner closely with global stakeholders to drive efficiency, improve quality, design and scale next generation services, and deliver consistent outcomes across markets.
 



 Hyderabad offers the opportunity to work on complex, high\-impact initiatives, build global exposure, and contribute to the continued evolution of Brink’s operating model.
 



  





**Business Unit Description:** 




 This role sits within HR Operations, a team that plays a key role in supporting Brink’s global workforce and advancing enterprise HR priorities.
 



 The function is responsible for delivering efficient, scalable HR services and ensuring consistent execution of core people processes, partnering across global HR, Centers of Excellence, and business leaders to deliver seamless employee experiences and reliable HR operations at scale.
 



 As part of Brink’s global operating model, the team helps drive consistency, efficiency, and service excellence, enabling the business to operate more effectively and support employees across the full lifecycle.
 



  





**How You’ll Succeed (Roles \& Responsibilities):** 




 Success in this role requires both strong execution and the ability to operate effectively in a global, evolving environment. You will:
 


* Define program scope and roadmap
* Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies
* Align cross\-functional teams
* Drive delivery outcomes
* Report on progress to leadership
* Translate business priorities into structured requirements, plans, test strategies, or delivery roadmaps that support high\-quality execution.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholders to manage scope, risks, dependencies, issues, and delivery milestones.
* Support UAT, testing, release readiness, adoption, and post\-implementation stabilization as appropriate for the role.
* Use data, feedback, and delivery metrics to identify risks, improve quality, and strengthen execution discipline.
* Communicate progress, decisions, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders at the right level of detail.
* Set priorities, manage workplans or team routines, and ensure commitments are delivered with quality and accountability.
* Coach, guide, or influence team members and partners to build capability, improve execution, and reinforce a service\-oriented culture.



  





**Experience:** 



* \~7\+ years of relevant experience with demonstrated ownership of processes, services, projects, platforms, or stakeholder outcomes.
* Experience supporting technology projects, program delivery, business analysis, QA/testing, release readiness, or portfolio execution.
* Experience operating in Agile, SDLC, or structured delivery environments with cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Leading large technology programs
* Managing global or cross\-functional teams
* Bachelor’s degree



  





**Who You Are (Skills / Qualifications):** 




**Must Have Skills:** 



* Program management
* Risk management
* Stakeholder alignment
* Communication
* Execution focus
* Requirements, project/program, QA/testing, SDLC, Agile, delivery management, or release readiness skills.
* Strong coordination, facilitation, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and follow\-through capability.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving capability.
* Clear written and verbal communication with the ability to tailor messages to different audiences.
* Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively across functions, regions, and time zones.
* High attention to detail with a strong quality, compliance, and control mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, follow through on commitments, and operate in a fast\-paced transformation environment.



  





**Good to Have Skills:** 



* PMP, PRINCE2, Agile/Scrum, ISTQB, QA automation, ALM, Jira, Azure DevOps, or ServiceNow experience.
* Experience supporting multi\-country or enterprise\-wide technology implementations.
* Experience working in a shared services, GBS, captive, MSP, or outsourced delivery model.
* Exposure to global transformation, operating model change, transition, or service modernization initiatives.
* Process improvement experience, including Lean, Six Sigma, automation, or continuous improvement methods.
* Experience creating executive\-ready materials, dashboards, process documentation, or stakeholder updates.



  





**What Brink’s Offers:** 




 At Brink’s, your goals are a priority. We build on your strengths and ambitions to create opportunities that help you grow and succeed professionally.
 


* Competitive compensation and performance\-based incentives
* Comprehensive benefits and wellbeing support programs
* Opportunities for career progression and continuous learning
* Exposure to global teams and large\-scale transformation initiatives
* A collaborative work environment that values inclusion, ownership, and innovation



  





**Privacy:** 




 By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained, and disclosed by Brink’s and its affiliates as described in the Candidate Privacy Statement.

0680fe18.title: Technical Program Manager, AI Data
0680fe18.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 5 years of experience managing cross\-functional or cross\-team projects.
* Experience with large\-scale data management.
* Experience with quantitative analysis and cost\-effectiveness assessment techniques.
* Familiarity with AI model training, testing, evaluation, and tuning processes.
* Knowledge of data quality metrics and KPIs for AI products.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 Mission of the team: The ML Data organization was formed at the beginning of 2024 with a focus on improving ML data operations, governance, and responsible practices across Google. Our ML Data teams collaborate with other teams such as Cloud, Core, Google DeepMind, Google Research, gTech, Knowledge and Information (K\&I) and Labs.
   

  

 As larger models become crucial to Google's success, the development of ML is becoming more data\-centric. Our teams have been working on the critical paths for all recent and upcoming LLM launches at Google, including Bard, Gemini, Magi, and Cloud.
   

  

 In this role, you will collaborate with cross\-functional teams and product leadership to harness data and data systems to accelerate the development of extensive ML models. You will provide easy access to high\-quality data for any AI task, whether it's human, synthetic, licensed, or Google native. You will secure AI models with tamper\-proof lineage, transparent approvals and secured storage for accelerated, accountable product and model launches. You will also evaluate, track, remediate, and prevent the recurrence of safety risks.
   

  

 The Cloud Applied AI (AAI) powers business growth with Gemini Enterprise. Our portfolio includes Gemini Enterprise for Customer Experience (Shopping Agent, CX Agent Studio, Agent Assist, Vertex AI Search \- Commerce, Customer Experience Insights), along with other vertical and domain packaged solutions. We enable high adoption and speed to value by building solutions that are quickly deployed, delivering new 0\-to\-1 capabilities with startup agility. Team members operate at the forefront of AI, collaborating directly with model builders with unprecedented speed. Join us to work on cutting\-edge projects and shape the future of AI in a fast\-paced, collaborative, and impactful environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead program execution: Lead programs for tamper\-proof lineage, transparent approvals and secured storage. Additionally, you may lead programs in evaluation of safety risks and data acquisition.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams: Work with engineering, product management, and other partners to define all workstreams, requirements, schedules, resources, and milestones.
* Communicate effectively: Provide project status updates to various audiences, including cross\-functional teams and executives.
* Prioritize and align: Drive feature planning and build cohesion and alignment across stakeholders.
* Exhibit technical leadership: Demonstrate technical knowledge and thought leadership to enhance project efficiency.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

c8ef99a5.title: Pre-Sales Consultant
c8ef99a5.description:
About HavStrategy

HavStrategy is a performance\-driven digital marketing agency partnering with D2C, ecommerce, fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands to drive growth through data\-backed marketing strategies.

Role Overview

We're looking for a detail\-oriented Pre\-Sales Consultant to bridge the gap between business development and delivery — understanding prospective clients' needs, crafting tailored solutions, and building compelling proposals and pitches that help HavStrategy win new business among consumer and D2C brands.

Key Responsibilities

* Partner with the business development team to understand prospective client requirements, business goals, and challenges.
* Conduct discovery calls and needs analysis to translate client requirements into tailored service solutions.
* Design and build customized pitch decks, proposals, and scopes of work for performance marketing, social media, SEO, content, and influencer marketing engagements.
* Develop pricing structures and service recommendations in collaboration with strategy and account leadership.
* Respond to RFPs/RFIs with well\-structured, persuasive, and accurate proposals.
* Coordinate with strategy, creative, and performance marketing teams to ensure proposals are feasible, accurate, and aligned with delivery capabilities.
* Support the sales team in client\-facing presentations, solution walkthroughs, and pitch meetings.
* Conduct competitor and market research to strengthen proposal positioning and differentiation.
* Maintain a repository of case studies, proposal templates, and reusable pitch content.
* Track proposal status and win/loss data in the CRM to refine future pitches.
* Stay updated on market trends, competitor offerings, and industry developments in the D2C/ecommerce space.

Requirements

* 1–3 years of experience in pre\-sales, solution consulting, business development, or a related client\-facing role (agency/digital marketing background preferred).
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred, not mandatory).
* Solid understanding of digital marketing services and how they apply to D2C/ecommerce brands.
* Proven track record of building proposals or solutions that convert into closed business.

Core Skills Needed

**Pre\-Sales \& Consulting Skills**

* Needs analysis and solution design
* Proposal, SOW, and pitch deck creation
* RFP/RFI response management
* Pricing and commercial structuring support
* Pipeline and CRM tracking (win/loss analysis)

**Communication \& Interpersonal Skills**

* Strong verbal and written communication
* Persuasive presentation and storytelling skills
* Active listening and requirement gathering
* Cross\-functional coordination and relationship\-building

**Industry/Domain Knowledge**

* Understanding of digital marketing channels (SEO, SEM, social media, performance marketing, influencer marketing)
* Familiarity with D2C/ecommerce business models and growth challenges
* Awareness of market trends in fashion, beauty, and lifestyle sectors

**Analytical \& Technical Skills**

* Basic data analysis to identify client needs and shape solutions
* Proficiency with MS Office/Google Workspace (Excel, PowerPoint/Slides for proposals)
* Familiarity with CRM tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce) and proposal/document tools
* Understanding of basic marketing metrics (ROAS, CAC, CTR, conversion rates) to speak credibly with clients

**Soft Skills**

* Self\-motivation and attention to detail
* Resilience and comfort working to deadlines
* Time management and multitasking
* Team collaboration (working closely with sales, creative, and strategy teams)
* Adaptability in a fast\-paced, evolving agency environment

Perks \& Growth

* Fast\-paced, high\-growth work environment
* Exposure to leading consumer and D2C brands
* Strong career growth and learning opportunities
* Direct mentorship from senior sales/marketing leadership
* Pay: ₹25,000\.00 – ₹45,000\.00 per month
* Work Location: In person

6d19b32e.title: Solutions Architect
6d19b32e.description:
**Job Summary**
 We are looking for a Solutions Architect to own the journey from client discovery to signed scope to successful go\-live.
   

  

 This role sits between Sales, Product, Engineering, and Delivery. You will work with prospects and customers to understand their real requirements, define what can be delivered, write clear Scopes of Work, and ensure the implementation is shipped successfully.
   

  

 You will be the person who turns a complex client ask into a clear, realistic, and buildable plan.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead discovery and scoping conversations with prospects and customers to identify business goals, data sources, workflows, compliance needs, and success metrics.
* Translate client requirements into clear Scopes of Work, solution documents, workflow maps, architecture diagrams, and implementation plans.
* Define deliverables, assumptions, dependencies, timelines, acceptance criteria, out\-of\-scope items, and change\-control processes for each engagement.
* Partner with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Delivery to ensure client commitments are realistic, commercially sound, and technically feasible.
* Configure client environments across connectors, user roles, approval flows, brand rules, knowledge context, reporting needs, and deployment settings.
* Manage implementation readiness, testing, user acceptance, issue resolution, and go\-live coordination with the client.
* Capture recurring customer asks, integration gaps, delivery risks, and market patterns to inform product roadmap decisions.


**Required Prerequisites**
* 4–8 years of experience in solutions architecture, pre\-sales, implementation, technical account management, delivery, sales engineering, or a similar customer\-facing technical role.
* Prior experience working with SaaS, platform, enterprise software, martech, adtech, analytics, AI, or data\-heavy products.
* Proven ability to write clear Scopes of Work, solution documents, requirement documents, or implementation plans.
* Strong technical understanding of APIs, OAuth, data integrations, account access, user permissions, cloud deployment, and system architecture.
* Experience working directly with enterprise customers, senior stakeholders, sales teams, product teams, and engineering teams.
* Ability to manage scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and change requests across complex client implementations.


**Core Competencies \& Skills**
* Strong discovery skills with the ability to identify what the client truly needs beyond the stated ask.
* Ability to simplify complex technical and business requirements into clear, signed, buildable scopes.
* Strong customer\-facing communication with the confidence to manage senior stakeholders and push back when needed.
* Practical understanding of AI products, including model limitations, usage cost, approval flows, governance, and reliability risks.
* Ability to quickly create solution prototypes, workflow diagrams, mockups, demos, or proof\-of\-concepts based on customer requirements.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, v0, Replit, or similar tools for prototyping, documentation, and solution design.
* Strong understanding of integrations across ad platforms, analytics tools, attribution systems, CRM systems, and internal business data sources.
* Commercial awareness to connect scope, pricing, timeline, delivery effort, and change requests.
* Strong documentation skills across SOWs, proposals, architecture diagrams, workflow maps, implementation plans, and UAT checklists.
* Comfort working across multiple industries, including regulated or compliance\-heavy environments.
* Ability to work with partner\-led deals, white\-label requirements, embedded deployments, and enterprise procurement processes.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to follow through from first scoping call to successful go\-live.

### **Description \& Requirements**

**Introduction: A Career at HARMAN Automotive**


We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast\-track your career.


* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience.
* Combine ingenuity, in\-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence.
* Advance in\-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment.

**About the Role**


In this role, you will report to the Manager – Cloud Operations. As a Principal Specialist \- Cloud, you will lead architecture and engineering across multiple cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), defining secure, scalable, and cost\-effective cloud platforms and reference architectures for the Corporate division. You will partner closely with infrastructure and development teams to accelerate delivery through AI\-enabled capabilities and automation, while ensuring strong GRCSP (governance, risk, compliance, security, and privacy) by design.

**What You Will Do**

* Own and evolve multi\-cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP), including target\-state designs, reference architectures, and platform standards.
* Drive cloud engineering decisions across providers: landing zones, networking, identity, compute, storage, observability, resiliency, and service catalog patterns.
* Act as a business liaison for cloud: translate business objectives into technical roadmaps, and align stakeholders across infrastructure, application development, and security teams.
* Work with business leaders and teams in executing business related projects primarily with the focus on technical and cloud infrastructure and implementing new services and functionalities as required by business projects.
* Enable AI and modern platform capabilities (e.g., data/AI services, MLOps patterns, secure access to foundation models) in collaboration with product and engineering teams.
* Lead automation strategy and implementation for Cloud Operations using Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD (e.g., Terraform/CloudFormation/Bicep), policy\-as\-code, and self\-service workflows.
* Design and enforce GRCSP guardrails: governance frameworks, risk management, compliance requirements, security baselines, and privacy controls across all cloud platforms.
* Establish cloud security architecture patterns (identity, encryption, network segmentation, secrets management) and partner with SOC, GRC, vulnerability management, and application teams to remediate findings.
* Lead architecture reviews for new initiatives and major changes; ensure designs meet non\-functional requirements (availability, performance, security, compliance, operability, and cost).
* Drive cost management and FinOps practices: tagging/chargeback models, unit economics, rightsizing, commitment programs, and architectural tradeoffs.
* Partner with IT Operations on reliability and incident learnings (post\-incident reviews, problem management), driving platform improvements and preventive controls.
* Create and maintain cloud standards, blueprints, and documentation; provide guidance, workshops, and coaching to engineering teams to accelerate adoption.
* Define and track a cloud architecture roadmap and key outcomes (security posture, compliance adherence, automation coverage, platform reliability, and cost efficiency) across the Corporate division.
* Evaluate cloud services, security tooling, and automation platforms; make recommendations and guide implementation with a focus on standardization and reuse.
* Manage infrastructure, network, and security services such as VPC/VNet, VWAN/TGW, WAF, ELB/AppGw, IAM, S3, EC2, EBS, and other AWS, Azure, and GCP native cloud services.
* Manage multiple, simultaneous, fast\-paced projects including infrastructure incident management, installations, patching, upgrades, etc.
* Collaborate with the Cloud Operations team and multiple infrastructure, security, and application teams to deploy and manage cloud resources in a multi\-cloud environment.
* Build and report cloud posture metrics (GRCSP controls, audit readiness, security remediation progress, cost optimization, and automation maturity) to support decision\-making.
* Collaborate with a diverse, globally distributed team and communicate architecture decisions clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences.

**What You Need to Be Successful**

* Master’s degree or Bachelor’s degree with relevant experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* 7\+ years of experience in cloud engineering and architecture, with proven delivery on at least two major cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Strong knowledge of cloud and platform architecture fundamentals: networking, DNS, load balancing, identity and access management, compute/container platforms, storage, and resilience patterns.
* Hands\-on experience designing for GRCSP: governance and policy controls, risk management, security architecture, privacy\-by\-design, and audit/compliance readiness in cloud environments.

 **Bonus Points if You Have**

* Proficiency with AI integration with automation and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep) and CI/CD practices; scripting skills (PowerShell, Python, or similar) preferred.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to bridge business needs and technical execution across infrastructure, development, and security teams.

**What Makes You Eligible**

* 10% travel might require.
* Willingness to work in a HARMAN office located in Bengaluru India
* Successfully completing a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment

**What We Offer**

* HARMAN Flex Connect Program, offering a flexible hybrid work environment that fosters stronger collaboration, meaningful connections, and innovation through a minimum of three in\-office days per week.
* Access to employee discounts on world\-class Harman and Samsung products (JBL, HARMAN Kardon, AKG, etc.)
* Extensive training opportunities through our own HARMAN University
* Competitive wellness benefits

aff2ff42.title: Principal Solution Architect (Payments & Banking) - Mumbai
aff2ff42.description:
**Position:** 
 Principal Solution Architect (Payments \& Banking)
   

  

**Department:** 
 Technology / Technical Sales \& Solution Engineering
   

  

**Location:** 
 Chennai, Mumbai and Delhi
   

  

**Compensation:** 
 upto18 LPA
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
   

  

**Company Overview:\-**
 iServeU is a modern banking infrastructure provider in APAC region, empowering financial enterprises with embedded fintech solutions for their customers. iServeU is one of the few certified partners with National Payment Corporation of India (NPCI), VISA for various products. iServeU also provides a cloud\-native, micro services\-enabled, distributed platform with over 5000 possible product configurations with a low code/no code interface to banks, NBFCs, Fintech, and other regulated entities.
   

  

* We process around 2500 transactions per second by levering distributed \& auto scale technology like K8\.
* Our core platform combines of 1200\+ micro services.
* Our customer list includes Fintech start\-ups, top tier private banks to PSU bank. We operate in five countries and help customers constantly change the way financial institutions operate and innovate.
* Our solutions currently empowers over 20 banks and 250\+ enterprises across India and abroad.
* Our platform seamlessly manages the entire transaction lifecycle, including withdrawals, deposits, transfers, payments, and lending through various channels like digital, branch, agents.


 Our team of 500\+ employees, with over 80% in technology roles is spread across offices in Bhubaneswar. Bangalore and Delhi. We have raised $8 million in funding to support our growth and innovation.
   

  

 For more details visit: www.iserveu.in
   

  

**Role Overview:\-**
 We are seeking a high\-caliber, deeply technical
 **Principal Solution Architect** 
 to drive technical customer engagement, product evangelism, and solution architecture for our enterprise banking clients. Based out of our
 **Chennai** 
 office, you will be the definitive technical voice of our product ecosystem. Your mission is two\-fold: maintain absolute mastery over the complex, fast\-evolving Indian payments landscape, and act as a trusted technical advisor to leadership teams at major commercial, retail, and cooperative banks. You will bridge the gap between core engineering and executive banking clients— delivering deep\-dive technical demonstrations, articulating feature differentiation, and instilling absolute confidence that our architecture can flawlessly handle mission\-critical transaction volumes.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities:\-**
* Technical Customer Evangelism \& Value Demonstration
* High\-Impact Technical Demos: Lead end\-to\-end technical product demonstrations for C\-suite executives, IT heads, and chief architects at prospective banks.
* Feature Differentiation: Clearly articulate how our platform stands out from legacy systems in terms of throughput, low latency, microservices architecture, automated failover mechanisms, and total cost of ownership (TCO).
* Instilling Banking Confidence: Address complex architectural, infrastructure, and deployment queries on the spot. Proactively mitigate risk concerns to convince highly risk\-averse banking committees that our product will scale seamlessly to their needs.
* Proof of Concept (PoC) Ownership: Scrutinize RFP/RFI requirements from banks, design tailored technical solution blueprints, and oversee execution lines for high\-stakes PoCs.
* Payment Lifecycle \& Architecture Mastery
* End\-to\-End Lifecycle Ownership: Maintain an authoritative understanding of the full lifecycle of Indian payment rails—including transaction switching, routing matrices, authorization loops, real time clearing, multi\-party settlement, automated reconciliation, and dispute/chargeback management frameworks.
* Technical Protocols: Demonstrate deep familiarity with payment messaging standards (ISO 8583, ISO 20022, JSON/RESTful APIs), cryptographic hardware integrations (HSMs), and database management systems optimized for heavy transaction concurrency.
* Compliance \& Regulatory Alignment
* Indian Financial Guardrails: Ensure all solution architectures proposed to client banks perfectly align with the latest Reserve Bank of India (RBI) mandates and National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) procedural guidelines.
* Data \& Security Mandates: Guide clients through our product's native compliance frameworks, including PCI\-DSS, data localization laws, card tokenization rules, and strict access control guidelines.


**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile \& Experience Blueprint:\-**
* Mandatory Industry Pedigree
* Payments Tech Background: You must have a proven track record of working on the technical/engineering side of an established Indian payments technology company. Direct experience at organizations providing payment switch/core\-banking solutions is mandatory.
* Banking Domain Trust: Minimum 5\-8 years of core technical experience, with at least 3\+ years in a client\-facing technical sales, solution engineering, or advisory role directly facing Indian banks.
* Deep Transactional Expertise


 Extensive technical familiarity with the deployable life cycles of core Indian transaction products is required:
   

  

* Real\-Time Retail Payments: UPI (Unified Payments Interface), IMPS, and AePS (Aadhar Enabled Payment System).
* High\-Value \& Batch Rails: NEFT, RTGS, and direct integrations with the RBI’s E\-Kuber system.
* Value\-Added Systems: BBPS (Bharat Bill Payment System), NACH, and comprehensive Card/POS/ATM switching ecosystems.
* Exceptional Interpersonal \& Communication Skills
* The "Engine Room to Boardroom" Translator: Ability to debate low\-level database deadlocks or API structures with engineering teams in one hour, and deliver a polished, business\-value driven presentation to a Bank MD in the next.
* High\-Trust Consultant Mentality: A patient, educational approach to customer success. You do not just sell features—you educate banking stakeholders on the structural evolution of modern fintech infrastructure.

* We are seeking an astute and enthusiastic individual who has a **strong technical foundation** with the **additional ability to be hands\-on** with the Professional Services team as part of the development/deployment cycle, and deep knowledge of industry best practices, with the ability to lead and implement independently working with both the platform, and the solution teams.

**Scope:**

* The Professional services team within Blue Yonder operates globally and is growing rapidly.
* Blue Yonder Enterprise Technical Architect (Planning) will be responsible for services delivery of product implementation and related integration.
* This role will provide the associate to be hands\-on with the Professional Services team as part of the development/deployment cycle, and deep knowledge of industry best practices, with the ability to implement them working with both the platform, and the solution teams.
* Core responsibilities include Strategy, Architecting, Design/Development (along with counterparts, customer, and Architects) and leading the technical team on projects and delivery initiatives catered around Supply Chain Planning solution and capabilities implementation.

**Desired skills and experience:**

* Knowledge on
* OS – Windows, Unix
* DB – RDBMS Concepts, Oracle, MS SQL Server, SQL/ PL SQL
* Implementation experience using SCPO Platform or any other relevant enterprise planning product and platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture frameworks certifications or awareness is an added advantage.
* Next Gen Skills \- Data Science, Data Analytics, Agile, Python, AI/ML, Cloud Fun, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, Databases/Data Platforms(emerging) – Snowflake, MongoDB, NoSQL, etc
* Reporting Skills – MS PowerBI
* Professional Attributes:
* Excellent communication, Inter\-personal, Stakeholder management, Analytical and Problem\-solving skills
* Excellent organization and project documentation skills
* Meticulous planning with attention to detail and multi\-tasking skills
* Domain knowledge: Understanding of Supply Chain Planning and how it integrates with other systems. Any industry specific experience is a big plus.

**What you’ll do:**

* Lead and mentor team of technical associates on Solution implementation, enhancement, managed services, integration, custom projects either at the customer site or offshore.
* Estimate the workload of implementation activities that are within the scope of their skills; assess business needs that fall outside the standard solution, assess integration complexity, architecture.
* Able to work and own initiatives for the technical planning team (Professional Services) and demonstrate good skills in leading the strategy and contribute towards complex customer assessment and sales cycle.
* Collaborate with Global Team/Partners and Customers or internal stakeholders.
* Conduct technical analysis sessions with customers and/or the project team to understand the functional and technical needs of the customer and develop technical solutions to meet those needs. Configure and implement Blue Yonder software solutions according to the client's specific requirements.
* Documentation Support \- Technical aspects of Blue Yonder Solutions, including technical specifications, configuration details, and user manuals.
* Implementation and steady state support, contribute on internal development projects and activities.
* Contribute to the growth of the technical professional services practice by developing and maintaining practice aids, databases, best\-practice collateral, assets, and accelerators.
* Continuously upskill Blue Yonder’ s product suite and technology innovation to convey relationships and touchpoints to the customer. Incumbent should be up to date on the Product Roadmap and strategy and need to have a synergy with cross functional team(s).
* Ready to travel to customer sites based on business needs.
* Identify areas of improvement and scope of automation on routine tasks or activities
* Handle activities with a diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors.
* Accelerate Time\-to\-Value for customer by iteratively delivering in short cycles.
* Recognize and highlight incremental revenue opportunities within existing customer projects.
* Ensures compliance with the internal and external company policies and procedures.

**What we are looking for:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree and **15\+ years** of experience in Software industry; ideally a candidate who has started as a Consultant and has worked his/her way to leading the technical team on 5\+ complete implementation cycles.
* Demonstrable understanding of software engineering fundamentals and design principles
* Experience working with large customers in challenging environments and having design/implemented enterprise application solutions and integration architectures.
* Demonstrable experience leading, building, deploying and maintenance of enterprise solutions (cloud or on\-premises)
* Excellent communication, Inter\-personal, Analytical and Problem\-solving skills
* Strong programming experience and problem\-solving skills
* Supply Chain Planning Industry Experience
* Expertise on performance tuning techniques and ability to assist other team members with benchmarking and sizing exercises.
* Possess technical expertise on emerging technologies and integration with different database and scripting languages like Python, SQL/PLSQL, Linux, etc
* Good understanding of Web Technologies and API fundamentals
* Strong understanding on Cloud and Architectural design (Azure or equivalent, Microservices Architecture, Multi\-Tenant)
* Demonstrable experience with Blue Yonder SCPO Platform.
* Hands\-on development skills; should not have moved away from development activities.
* Passionate about working with new and emerging technologies, products and demonstrates the ability to learn quickly, and have good interpersonal \& communication

**Our Values**

  

If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Job Summary
  
  

OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE
  
As an SAP BTP Architect at HCLTech, you will play a pivotal role in designing and implementing SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) solutions that support the digital transformation journeys of our clients. You will leverage your expertise to architect scalable, secure, and high\-performing SAP BTP landscapes, ensuring alignment with business objectives and industry best practices. This role is crucial in enabling clients to harness the full potential of cloud\-based SAP technologies, fostering innovation and operational excellence.
  
DETAILED RESPONSIBILITIES
  
* Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of end\-to\-end SAP BTP solutions, including integration with on\-premise and cloud systems.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, and technical teams to gather requirements and translate them into robust BTP architectures.
* Develop technical blueprints, solution architectures, and documentation for SAP BTP projects.
* Provide thought leadership on SAP BTP capabilities, advising clients on technology adoption, migration strategies, and best practices.
* Ensure security, scalability, and performance of SAP BTP environments through proactive risk assessments and optimization.
* Guide and mentor development teams during solution build, deployment, and support phases.
* Stay updated with the latest SAP BTP innovations and incorporate relevant advancements into client solutions.
* Participate in pre\-sales activities, including solution demonstrations, proposal development, and effort estimation.


SKILL REQUIREMENTS
  
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in SAP architecture, with at least 3 years focused on SAP BTP (formerly SAP Cloud Platform).
* Deep understanding of SAP BTP services (e.g., SAP Cloud Integration, SAP Extension Suite, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP HANA Cloud).
* Proven experience in designing and implementing cloud\-native applications and integrations using SAP BTP.
* Strong knowledge of SAP security concepts, data modeling, API management, and DevOps processes within the SAP ecosystem.
* SAP certification(s) in SAP BTP or related areas preferred.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work in a global, multicultural team environment.


OTHER REQUIREMENTS (OPTIONAL)
  
* Experience with hyperscale cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) in conjunction with SAP solutions.
* Familiarity with agile methodologies and project management frameworks.
* Prior involvement in large\-scale SAP S/4HANA migrations or digital transformation initiatives.
* Experience mentoring or leading technical teams.


Key Responsibilities
  
1\. To architect\| design and develop \[through team] solution for product / sustenance delivery.
  
2\. To train and develop team so as to ensure that there is an adequate supply of trained manpower in the said technology and delivery risks are mitigated.
  
3\. To ensure knowledge up\-gradation and work with new technologies so that the solution is current and meets quality standards and the client requirements.
  
4\. To gather specifications and deliver solutions to the client organization based on understanding of a domain or technology.

03613ccb.title: Solution Architect – DevOps
03613ccb.company: TekIT Software Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (India & USA)
03613ccb.description:
Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a hands\-on
 **Solution Architect – DevOps / Kubernetes Platform** 
 to lead the modernization of our infrastructure and application deployment ecosystem.
   

  

 The role will focus on migrating services from standalone containers to a
 **production\-grade Kubernetes platform** 
 , while establishing standardized automation, infrastructure, observability, and deployment practices.
   

  

 You will work closely with engineering and service owners to create a
 **“Golden Path”** 
 that enables reliable, repeatable, and self\-service application deployments.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the migration of persistent data services and ephemeral applications from standalone containers to Kubernetes.
* Design and implement scalable Kubernetes platform architecture across on\-premises/virtualized infrastructure.
* Drive infrastructure and configuration automation using Ansible as the primary automation framework.
* Develop and maintain standardized Helm charts and deployment templates.
* Design and implement GitOps\-based CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure deployments.
* Define and maintain infrastructure state using Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices; Terraform knowledge is an advantage.
* Troubleshoot complex Linux OS, networking, storage, and containerization issues using advanced CLI tools.
* Design and manage Kubernetes components including networking, storage classes, workloads, scheduling, security, and lifecycle management.
* Build and maintain centralized monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability solutions.
* Establish platform standards, best practices, and reusable automation frameworks.
* Work directly with developers and service owners to assess applications and define their Kubernetes migration strategy.
* Identify platform bottlenecks and continuously improve reliability, scalability, security, and deployment efficiency.
* Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance across DevOps and platform engineering initiatives.


**Required Technical Skills**
* 9 years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or Solution Architecture.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Kubernetes in production environments.
* Advanced knowledge of Kubernetes primitives including:
* Networking
* Services \& Ingress
* Storage Classes \& Persistent Volumes
* ConfigMaps \& Secrets
* Deployments, StatefulSets \& DaemonSets
* Scheduling \& lifecycle management
* Strong expertise in Linux administration and troubleshooting, particularly on bare\-metal or on\-premises environments.
* Expert\-level Linux CLI / shell skills.
* Extensive experience with Ansible and configuration management.
* Strong knowledge of Docker / containerization and container migration.
* Hands\-on experience with Helm and Kubernetes deployment standardization.
* Experience implementing GitOps practices and pipelines.
* Knowledge of Terraform / Infrastructure\-as\-Code is a plus.
* Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability platforms.
* Strong understanding of networking, storage, OS\-level troubleshooting, and infrastructure architecture.


 Solution Architecture Expectations
   

  

* Ability to translate application requirements into scalable and production\-ready platform designs.
* Strong understanding of on\-premises infrastructure architecture and Kubernetes platform design.
* Ability to define migration patterns for both stateful and stateless workloads.
* Experience creating technical standards, reference architectures, and reusable platform components.

7002ad68.title: Delivery Manager
7002ad68.description:
Please note that we will only be able to accept candidates who have the appropriate rights and documentation for employment in India.


**Who We Are.**



Axi is a leading global provider of margin and deliverable Foreign Exchange, Contracts for Difference (CFDs), and Financial Spread betting. Our business has evolved into a world\-class, multifaceted brokerage with offices in six regions. With heavy investment in the latest trading technology, Axi seeks to offer the most comprehensive end\-to\-end trading experience available, servicing traders of all levels from beginners to institutional\-level clients.


**Let's talk about the cool stuff you will do at Axi!**



We are looking for an experienced **Delivery Manager** to drive the successful delivery of strategic technology initiatives across our global engineering teams. You will be responsible for owning the delivery lifecycle from planning through execution, ensuring projects are delivered on time, at the highest quality, and with predictable outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast\-growing fintech organization where you'll lead transformation initiatives, partner with cross\-functional stakeholders across global regions, and leverage modern technologies and AI\-driven tools to continuously improve delivery excellence.


**Your EDGE Assignment / You Will**


**Delivery Cadence**

* Define, document, and continuously improve the team's delivery cadence — sprint/iteration length, ceremony schedule (planning, refinement, review, retro), and reporting rhythm.
* Ensure the cadence is followed: ceremonies happen on schedule, with the right people, producing real decisions. ·
* Adapt cadence to the needs of different workstreams (e.g., a fast\-moving feature team vs. a compliance\-heavy workstream) without fragmenting the organisation into inconsistent processes.


**Stage Gate Ownership**

* Own the criteria for moving work between stages (e.g., Discovery Ready for Build In Progress Review Release) and enforce them consistently.
* Act as the checkpoint before work advances: confirm acceptance criteria are met, dependencies are cleared, risk/compliance sign\-offs are in hand, and Definition of Done is completed.
* Act when something is not ready and explain exactly what is missing and what is needed to pass the gate.
* Track and report exceptions/waivers when a gate is bypassed and ensure it is a deliberate decision.


**Delivery Planning**

* Build delivery plans grounded in real data: backlog sizing (story points/estimates), team velocity history, known dependencies, and risk.
* Convert scope and velocity into realistic timelines and communicate them as ranges with clear assumptions and confidence levels.
* Re\-forecast the plan on a regular cadence (e.g., every sprint) as scope, velocity, or risk changes, and proactively flag slippage.
* Maintain visibility tools (burnup/burndown, roadmap views, RAID logs) that let stakeholders self\-serve status.


**Cross\-Team Coordination \& Reporting**


* Be the primary point of contact for delivery status to leadership and stakeholders — translating team\-level detail into a clear picture of progress, risk, and trade\-offs.
* Identify and actively manage cross\-team dependencies, blockers, and resourcing conflicts before they hit the critical path.
* Facilitate trade\-off conversations (scope vs. time vs. quality) with data.


**Process Ownership \& Continuous Improvement**


* Own the delivery process documentation (workflow stages, gate criteria, estimation method, ceremony structure) and keep it current, e.g. in Confluence.
* Run retrospectives that produce real process changes.
* Balance rigor with pragmatism — add process where it removes risk or ambiguity and remove process if not needed.


**Are you the one?**


* 8\+ years in a Delivery Manager, Scrum Master, Program Manager, or Technical Project Manager role, ideally spanning multiple teams or workstreams.
* Demonstrated experience running Agile/Scrum (or Kanban/hybrid) delivery cadences end\-to\-end — not just attending ceremonies but designing and improving them.
* Hands\-on experience with story\-point estimation, velocity tracking, and forecasting delivery timelines from that data.
* Proven ability to hold a line on process/quality gates under deadline pressure, with the communication skill to do so without becoming a bottleneck or being seen as purely a blocker.
* Strong stakeholder management — comfortable presenting status, risk, and trade\-offs to senior leadership.
* Fluency with delivery tooling (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent) and building reporting views (burnup/burndown, roadmaps, dashboards) that reduce manual status\-chasing.
* Hands\-on exposure to tools such as Postman and Datadog, with an interest in leveraging AI to improve delivery and operational efficiency.
* Proven experience delivering technology transformation initiatives, including system migrations, process transitions, or Global Capability Centre (GCC) setup and transition projects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to turn ambiguous, fast\-moving work into a clear plan and a clear narrative.

  


**Preferred Skills**


* Experience in \[industry — e.g., fintech, trading platforms, regulated environments], particularly where compliance/risk sign\-off is part of the stage\-gate process.
* Certification such as CSM, PSM, SAFe, or PMP (useful signal, not a substitute for hands\-on experience).
* Experience introducing or maturing a delivery process in an organization that didn't previously have one.


**Axi's bag of delights**


* Competitive and attractive compensation.
* Extensive learning opportunities including professional certifications and soft\-skills development.
* 18 annual leave days and 12 sick leave days per year.
* Public holidays as declared by local government.
* Maternity leave as per law.
* Health insurance coverage.


**Axi's interview journey**


* **Talent Acquisition Round – 45 Minutes**
* **Hiring Manager Interview – 1 Hour**
* **Final Interview – 1 Hour**


Please note that our organization works with recruitment agencies on a pre\-approved basis only. A recruitment agency that wishes to submit candidate profiles or resumes for consideration must obtain prior written consent from our talent acquisition team. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, and we will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Should we receive an unsolicited resume from a recruitment agency that does not have prior written consent, we will not be responsible for the payment of any fees related to the recruitment of the candidate represented in the unsolicited resume.



At Axi, we prioritize creating a workplace that upholds fairness and respect for all. We encourage every individual within our community to contribute towards a culture where everyone feels a sense of belonging and is treated with the dignity they deserve. We make all employment\-related decisions—whether in hiring, compensation, training, performance reviews, or termination—based on merit and without bias, ensuring equal opportunities for everyone. We consciously work to identify and overcome any unconscious biases, with a commitment to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee and candidate feels genuinely welcomed and valued.

**Roles \& Responsibilities** 




**Solutioning** 



* Understand customer billing models and configure Zenskar contracts, pricing, metering, and invoicing accurately.
* Translate complex business requirements into clear, structured Zenskar workflows and setups.
* Design solutions for complex B2B SaaS products, focused on outcomes rather than features.



**Pre\-Sales \& Technical Discovery** 



* Run technical discovery with finance, RevOps, and engineering stakeholders. Understand their billing model, usage data, source systems, and rev rec requirements before anyone talks about features.
* Partner with Sales on live demos, sandbox setups, and RFP responses. Build demos tied to the prospect's real scenario, not a generic tour: set up metered plans, show usage ingestion and rated invoices, and point to where revenue is recognized.
* Design the integration. Map how usage flows from Postgres, Snowflake, or a warehouse into Zenskar, and flag idempotency, late\-arriving events, and reconciliation risks before they become implementation problems.
* Own the technical win. Qualify the deal, separate champion from economic buyer, multi\-thread to the CFO, and de\-risk the build so nothing falls apart post\-sale.



**Business Case \& Enablement** 



* Prepare business case documents and fill RFPs. Tie capability to a dollar saved or a risk removed, not a feature list.
* Create customer\-specific solution documentation and clear handoff references when transitioning deals.
* Communicate clearly, simple enough for a CXO, precise enough for technical teams.



**Internal Coordination** 



* Act as the voice of the customer internally, feeding structured patterns from discovery back to Product and Engineering.
* Raise and follow through on time\-sensitive issues so momentum is never lost.



  





**Key qualifications** 



* 5\+ years total experience, with meaningful time in a hands\-on technical role: solutions or sales engineering, forward\-deployed engineering, data engineering, or backend and integrations work. Actual building, not support tickets.
* You can write real SQL comfortably (group by, window functions, date logic) and have built or debugged REST API integrations. You understand the difference between an API and a webhook without having to think about it.
* Vendor\-side B2B SaaS product experience, ideally billing, payments, fintech, ERP, or data\-infrastructure adjacent.
* You've been client\-facing in a technical capacity: discovery, PoCs, demos, or implementation calls with real customers.
* Comfortable supporting enterprise\-grade deal cycles and multi\-stakeholder buying processes, with US or international customers.
* You can hold a credible conversation with a CFO and with an engineer on the same day.
* CS or engineering degree, or demonstrable equivalent shipped work.
* Experience at a small company (under 100 people, seed to Series A) is a plus, not a must.
* Willing to work US\-overlap hours, roughly 6:00 PM to 2:00 AM IST to cover US afternoons, on weekdays.
* A sense of humor and the ability to not take yourself too seriously. We're building something hard, and that's more fun with people who can laugh at the chaos.

The role focuses on producing accurate drawings, coordinated BIM models, and supporting design teams in delivering high\-quality construction documentation.

Drafting \& Documentation  

* Prepare detailed architectural drawings, including plans, sections, elevations, and detailing.
* Develop construction drawings and GFC documentation.
* Modify and update drawings based on design changes and review comments.
* Ensure all drawings comply with project standards, codes, and company guidelines, Revit/BIM Modelling.
* Create and maintain accurate 3D BIM models using Autodesk Revit.
* Extract 2D drawings, schedules, and quantities from BIM models.
* Develop and use Revit families, templates, and libraries.
* Update BIM models throughout the project lifecycle as per revisions and coordination inputs.


Coordination  

* Coordinate with architects, MEP, and structural teams for integrated model development.
* Assist in clash detection and issue resolution during design development.
* Incorporate consultant inputs into the model, ensuring accurate and coordinated outputs.


Quality \& Compliance  

* Perform quality checks (QC) on drawings and models for accuracy and completeness.
* Follow BIM standards, naming conventions, and project protocols.
* Maintain proper documentation and revision records.


Support to Design Team  

* Assist architects in translating concepts into detailed drawings.
* Support preparation of presentation drawings and 3D views.
* Provide input on constructability and detailing aspects.

Technical Skills  

* Expert in Autodesk Revit (modeling \+ documentation).
* Good knowledge of AutoCAD and BIM workflows.
* Understanding of construction drawings, detailing, and standards.
* Experience in model coordination and clash resolution tools (e.g., Navisworks).
* Knowledge of materials, detailing, and building systems.


Functional Skills  

* Strong documentation and detailing skills.

* Ability to handle large, complex drawing sets.


Soft Skills  

* Good team coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to work under deadlines and manage multiple tasks.

 Are you passionate about driving digital manufacturing transformation, designing scalable MES architectures, and leading the implementation of enterprise manufacturing solutions that enable operational excellence?
 



 An experienced Solution Architect Manager \- Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) to define, govern, and evolve enterprise MES architecture while actively contributing to solution design, development, implementation, and technical leadership. This role serves as the critical link between business requirements, solution architecture, and technical delivery, ensuring manufacturing technology platforms are scalable, standardized, secure, and aligned with global business objectives.
 



 The ideal candidate combines deep MES expertise, strong solution architecture capabilities, hands\-on technical experience, and leadership skills to drive successful manufacturing digitalization initiatives across global operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Solution Architecture \& Technology Strategy** 



* Define, maintain, and evolve the enterprise Manufacturing Execution System (MES) architecture roadmap.
* Establish architecture standards, design principles, development guidelines, and reusable solution patterns.
* Ensure consistency and standardization across manufacturing sites, integrations, applications, and deployments.
* Evaluate business requirements and assess their impact on the overall solution architecture.
* Drive solution governance and technical decision\-making across MES initiatives.
* Ensure architecture solutions align with enterprise manufacturing and digital transformation strategies.



**MES Development \& Technical Leadership** 



* Actively participate in MES configuration, development, customization, and technical implementation activities.
* Design and develop complex solution components and proof\-of\-concept initiatives.
* Provide technical leadership during system implementation, upgrades, and enhancement projects.
* Troubleshoot and resolve critical application, integration, and production issues.
* Conduct architecture, design, and code reviews to ensure quality and compliance with standards.
* Establish development best practices, coding standards, and technical governance processes.
* Mentor and guide development teams, technical consultants, and integration partners.



**Product \& Template Management** 



* Contribute to the evolution of global MES templates and manufacturing solution frameworks.
* Ensure solutions remain scalable, maintainable, reusable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Support global deployment and rollout initiatives.
* Lead evaluations of new capabilities, enhancements, and technology opportunities.
* Drive continuous improvement of MES products and manufacturing technology platforms.



**Integration \& Enterprise Connectivity** 



* Design and support integrations between MES, manufacturing systems, enterprise platforms, databases, and external applications.
* Ensure reliable communication across plant\-floor and enterprise\-level systems.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, integration, and application teams to maintain end\-to\-end solution integrity.
* Support API, database, and system interface design and optimization.



**Delivery \& Implementation Leadership** 



* Partner with Business Analysts and stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Support functional and technical design activities and ensure solution requirements are fully understood.
* Create technical solution designs, implementation approaches, and development work packages.
* Break down business requirements into detailed technical specifications, user stories, and delivery tasks.
* Participate in Agile planning, sprint execution, prioritization, and delivery activities.
* Ensure consistent interpretation and implementation of technical requirements across development teams.



**Vendor \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Provide technical leadership to both internal teams and third\-party implementation partners.
* Review, challenge, and validate technical proposals and solution designs from vendors and system integrators.
* Collaborate with external product and support organizations to address complex technical challenges.
* Ensure external resources adhere to enterprise architecture, development, and security standards.
* Build strong relationships with manufacturing leaders, IT teams, architects, and business stakeholders.



**Knowledge Management \& Capability Building**

fb7ac038.title: Solution Architect – Intelligent Automation, Infrastructure & Agentic AI
fb7ac038.description:
**Company Description** 
 United Business Group, established in 2000, is a leading provider of IT Infrastructure Management and Technical Support Services in Kuwait. The organization focuses on delivering cost\-effective, reliable IT solutions that address the evolving needs of its customers. By combining deep technical expertise with modern technology assets, United Business Group supports clients in optimizing and securing their IT environments. Team members work in a dynamic setting with opportunities to engage in complex infrastructure and automation projects. The company values innovation, customer focus, and continuous improvement in its services.
 



  





**Location:** 
  Kochi,Kerala
 



**Market Coverage:** 
  Middle East
 



**Experience Required:** 
  Minimum 5 years
 



**Function:** 
  Presales and Solution Architecture
 



**Employment Type:** 
  Full\-time
 



 Position Overview
 

 We are seeking an accomplished 
 **Solution Architect – Intelligent Automation, Infrastructure \& Agentic AI** 
  to design enterprise\-grade automation and AI solutions for customers across the Middle East.
 



 The successful candidate will combine strong solution\-architecture capabilities with hands\-on expertise in infrastructure and hardware sizing, RPA platforms, cloud and on\-premises deployment models, and Agentic AI solutions.
 



 Based in Saudi Arabia, the Solution Architect will work closely with sales, business\-development, delivery, infrastructure, and partner teams. The role will be responsible for understanding customer requirements, designing scalable solutions, preparing technical and commercial inputs, conducting demonstrations, and enabling the sales team to achieve its revenue targets.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 

 Solution Architecture and Presales
 
* Engage with customers to understand their business objectives, technical environment, workloads, security requirements, and transformation priorities.
* Translate business requirements into secure, scalable, resilient, and commercially viable solution architectures.
* Support the complete presales lifecycle—from opportunity qualification and discovery through solution design, proposal submission, technical evaluation, proof of concept, and deal closure.
* Guide sales professionals during customer engagements and ensure that proposed solutions address the customer’s business and technical requirements.
* Lead technical presentations, discovery workshops, solution demonstrations, architecture reviews, and proof\-of\-concept activities.
* Prepare solution blueprints, architecture diagrams, bills of materials, scope documents, effort estimates, technical proposals, and responses to RFPs, RFIs, and tenders.
* Clearly communicate solution value, business outcomes, implementation approach, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and total cost of ownership.
* Coordinate with OEMs, technology partners, cloud providers, delivery teams, and customer stakeholders.
* Maintain reusable solution templates, sizing models, reference architectures, and presales documentation.



 Hardware and Infrastructure Sizing
 
* Perform detailed infrastructure and hardware sizing based on process volumes, transaction loads, user concurrency, bot workloads, data growth, availability requirements, and expected future expansion.
* Recommend appropriate CPU, memory, storage, network, database, server, and GPU configurations.
* Design solutions for on\-premises, private cloud, public cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Develop architectures covering development, testing, staging, production, and disaster\-recovery environments.
* Design for high availability, load balancing, scalability, backup, disaster recovery, performance, security, and business continuity.
* Estimate capacity requirements for automation control rooms, bot runners, application servers, databases, AI workloads, vector databases, and integration components.
* Evaluate hardware and cloud\-service options while balancing performance, scalability, security, and cost.
* Work with infrastructure and security teams to validate ports, protocols, firewalls, identity services, network connectivity, access controls, and environment readiness.



 Intelligent Automation and RPA
 

 The candidate must have practical solution\-design exposure to the following platforms:
 


* UiPath
* Blue Prism
* Microsoft Power Automate
* Automation Anywhere



 Responsibilities will include:
 


* Designing enterprise automation platforms and deployment architectures.
* Sizing attended and unattended automation environments.
* Understanding bot licensing, orchestration, credential management, scheduling, monitoring, queues, logging, and workload distribution.
* Designing integrations with ERP, CRM, databases, APIs, web applications, virtual environments, document\-management systems, and enterprise applications.
* Advising customers on automation governance, security, operating models, and Centres of Excellence.
* Supporting process assessment and identifying suitable automation opportunities.
* Incorporating process mining, document understanding, intelligent document processing, OCR, workflow automation, and analytics where appropriate.
* Comparing technology options objectively and recommending the most suitable platform for each customer environment.



 Agentic AI Solution Architecture
 

 The candidate must possess deep knowledge of 
 **Agentic AI and generative AI solutions** 
 , including:
 


* Autonomous and human\-supervised AI agents
* Multi\-agent architectures and agent orchestration
* Large language models and small language models
* Retrieval\-Augmented Generation
* Embeddings and vector databases
* Prompt engineering and context management
* Tool use, API calling, planning, reasoning, and workflow execution
* Enterprise data and application integration
* AI gateways, model hosting, observability, evaluation, and monitoring
* Responsible AI, security, governance, privacy, and human oversight



 The Solution Architect will be expected to:
 


* Identify practical Agentic AI use cases across customer service, finance, procurement, human resources, sales, supply chain, IT operations, and other enterprise functions.
* Design Agentic AI solutions that securely connect with RPA platforms, enterprise applications, databases, APIs, and workflow systems.
* Select suitable models, orchestration frameworks, integration patterns, infrastructure, and deployment options.
* Size CPU, memory, storage, and GPU requirements for AI workloads where applicable.
* Evaluate on\-premises, cloud\-hosted, and hybrid AI deployment approaches.
* Design security controls covering identity, permissions, data protection, auditability, model access, guardrails, and human approval.
* Explain complex AI concepts in clear business language to executives and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Convert AI opportunities into realistic roadmaps, solution designs, implementation plans, and measurable business outcomes.



 Candidate Requirements
 
* Minimum 
 **5 years of relevant experience** 
  in solution architecture, presales consulting, infrastructure design, intelligent automation, enterprise applications, AI, or digital transformation.
* Proven experience performing infrastructure capacity planning and hardware sizing.
* Strong technical exposure to UiPath, Blue Prism, Microsoft Power Automate, and Automation Anywhere.
* Deep knowledge of Agentic AI, generative AI, enterprise AI architecture, and AI\-enabled automation.
* Experience designing on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid enterprise solutions.
* Ability to develop high\-level and low\-level solution designs.
* Experience preparing technical proposals, bills of materials, RFP responses, architecture diagrams, and effort estimates.
* Strong understanding of APIs, databases, operating systems, networks, cloud platforms, cybersecurity, integration patterns, and enterprise applications.
* Experience supporting sales teams in complex enterprise opportunities.
* Ability to manage multiple customer engagements and presales priorities simultaneously.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, presentation, documentation, and stakeholder\-management capabilities.
* Ability to engage confidently with C\-level executives, business leaders, enterprise architects, security teams, and technical specialists.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Relevant RPA, cloud, infrastructure, or AI certifications would be advantageous.
* Excellent written and spoken English; Arabic language capability would be an advantage.
* Must be based in Kochi or willing to relocate.



 Preferred Experience
 

 Preference will be given to candidates with:
 


* Experience working with enterprise or government customers in Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East.
* Knowledge of regional data\-residency, cybersecurity, and compliance requirements.
* Exposure to GPU\-based AI infrastructure and enterprise model\-hosting platforms.
* Experience integrating automation and AI solutions with SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, ServiceNow, or similar enterprise platforms.
* Experience leading a small presales or technical\-consulting team.
* A strong record of supporting successful enterprise deal closures.



 Key Performance Indicators
 

 Performance will be measured through:
 


* Technical win rate and sales opportunities successfully supported
* Quality, accuracy, and timeliness of solution designs
* Accuracy of hardware sizing, effort estimates, and bills of materials
* Successful completion of demonstrations and proofs of concept
* Contribution to sales pipeline and revenue achievement
* Effectiveness in enabling and supporting the sales team
* Reduction of technical, delivery, and commercial risks before deal closure



 Important Candidate Clarification
 

 This is not a purely operational infrastructure role or a standalone software\-development position. We are looking for a 
 **customer\-facing presales Solution Architect** 
  who can:
 


* Perform accurate infrastructure and hardware sizing
* Design enterprise automation and Agentic AI solutions
* Communicate effectively with business and technical stakeholders
* Guide sales teams throughout complex opportunities
* Develop credible, competitive, and commercially viable proposals
* Help convert qualified opportunities into successful business

088fc25b.title: Solution Engineer (Post Sales)
088fc25b.description:
**Hevo Data** 




**Solution Engineer (Post\-sales)** 




**About Hevo** 




 DoorDash, Footlocker, Arhaus, Santander, and thousands of other data\-driven companies have one thing in common. They all use Hevo Data’s fully managed Automated Pipelines to consolidate their data from multiple sources like Databases, Marketing Applications, Cloud Storage, SDKs, Streaming Services, etc.
 



 We are a San Francisco, Bangalore, and Pune\-based company with 2000\+ customers spread across 45\+ countries in e\-commerce, financial technology, and healthcare. Strongly backed by marquee investors like Sequoia Capital, we have raised $42 Million to date and are looking forward to our next phase of hyper\-growth!
 



**Why do we exist?** 




 At Hevo, our mission is to enable every company to be data\-driven. We started on this journey 9 years back, and as the first step in this direction, we built our first product – “Data Pipeline” or simply “Pipeline”.
 



 Hevo Pipeline is a no\-code platform that helps companies connect all their sources of data within the company to get a unified view of their business. The platform offers integrations with 150\+ data sources such as Databases, SaaS applications, Advertising Channels, etc.
 



 Today, we enable close to 2000 companies across more than 40\+ countries to be more data\-driven. Our aim is to make the technology so simple that anyone should be able to solve their data problems and not be limited due to their lack of technical skills.
 



**The Role** 




 We are growing into mid\-market and enterprise accounts where the technical bar \- and the stakes \- are higher. To win and retain these customers, we are building the technical depth in our post\-sale motion to match.
 



 Enterprise buyers are not just buying a product. They are making architectural decisions. The CTOs, data architects, and engineering leads we work with at this level need a technical counterpart.
 



 As a Solution Engineer, you are that person. You are not the first point of contact, and you are not handling tickets.
 



 You are the expert our Account Managers bring in when a customer conversation goes beyond relationship management \- a quarterly architecture review, a complex integration challenge, a strategic expansion decision, or simply when a CTO wants to talk to someone who really knows data.
 



**What You Will Do** 



* Be the senior technical specialist that Account Managers call on for complex customer conversations \- architecture reviews, expansion discussions, and senior\-level technical engagements.
* Engage credibly with CTOs, senior engineers, and data architects as a genuine thought partner: understand their architecture, challenge assumptions, co\-design pipelines, and offer a credible point of view.
* Lead technical discovery and solution design for enterprise customers evaluating new use cases, migrations, or architectural changes involving Hevo.
* Translate complex customer requirements into actionable guidance \- both for the customer and, where needed, and for Hevo's internal engineering team.
* Build and maintain deep expertise in the modern data stack: cloud data warehouses, orchestration, transformation, and the broader ecosystem Hevo operates within.
* Identify expansion opportunities through technical engagement and hand them off to the AM with enough context to move the conversation forward commercially.
* Contribute to internal knowledge \- documenting patterns, building reference architectures, and raising the technical bar across the post\-sales team.



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




**Required** 



* 6\+ years of experience in a technical, customer\-facing role \- Solutions Engineering, Data Engineering, or a technical post\-sale or consulting function.
* Deep, broad knowledge of data engineering: ETL/ELT pipelines, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks), orchestration, and the modern data stack.
* Hands\-on experience with data integration tools, CDC, event streaming, or warehouse\-native transformation (dbt, etc.).
* Demonstrable ability to engage at the architectural level \- not just explain a product, but understand and speak to a customer's data infrastructure.
* Strong communication skills: you can make complex technical ideas clear to both engineers and executives, and you are confident pushing back when a customer's approach is suboptimal.
* Comfort working in an ambiguous, fast\-moving environment with a small team and high autonomy.



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience in a pre\-sales or post\-sales SE role at a data infrastructure or SaaS company.
* Exposure to enterprise data governance, compliance, or security requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA).
* Prior experience in a startup or high\-growth B2B SaaS environment.



  





**What You Will Not Be Doing** 




 This is not a support role, a ticket\-handling role, or a general customer success role. You will not be measured on ticket volume or response SLAs. You will be measured on whether enterprise customers trust Hevo at the technical level \- and whether that trust translates into deeper, longer, larger relationships.
 



**What We Offer** 



* Competitive compensation and/or equity.
* Direct access to leadership and real influence on how the post\-sale function is built.
* A collaborative, high\-trust environment where technical depth is valued and rewarded.

Morgan and Chase brands. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.
