5831bc40.description:
**Overview**
 With a vision to "Build and sell Microsoft AI, Cloud applications, services, and devices with partners, empowering people and organizations to achieve more," SME\&C Channel Partner Sales (CPS) is responsible for driving revenue outcomes with partners through innovative solutions–at scale. The Global Channel Partner Sales team delivers SME\&C growth and market share across AI Business Solutions, Cloud \& AI Platforms, and Security within GPS by capturing total addressable market (TAM) and accelerating cloud growth at scale through our top Channel Sales partner. Our approach is grounded in Cloud Solution Provider acceleration, co\-sell precision, and performance accountability—executed consistently across all solution areas and every stage of the MCEM Win Formula. We are committed to delivering on our segment and revenue accountabilities by aligning execution with measurable impact, fostering partner transformation, and enabling scalable, outcome\-driven growth.
   

  

 As a Cloud Solution Architect, you will guide the development of business solutions, provide deep technical insights, and accelerate the growth of Microsoft Tech priorities. You will work closely with partners to understand their technical requirements and business objectives, and guide them through architectural design sessions, developing proof of concepts, and help them transition from legacy systems to modern cloud environments, ensuring that their solutions are optimized for performance and cost\-efficiency.
   

  

 Join our team as a Cloud Solution Architect and play a pivotal role in guiding our most significant partners to designing and implementing innovative scalable, secure, and efficient cloud architectures that meet market needs. By leveraging your skills in technical leadership, cloud computing, software development, problem solving and systems architecture, you will drive business impact by enabling digital transformation, optimizing performance, and driving innovation through the effective use of cloud technologies.
   

  

 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 As a Partner Cloud Solution Architect (CSA), you will serve as the deep technical SME to partners’ technical force \& own the partner’s technical strategy plan for their Cloud Solution Area (CSA). Withing your responsibilities are:
   

  

* Guide Solution Development \& Activation \- You’ll lead the development and activation of new or enhanced partner offerings that align with Microsoft Cloud priorities. Your focus will be on ensuring these solutions are robust, scalable, secure, and tailored to meet evolving customer needs.
* Empower Innovation \- You’ll run technical innovation workshops, tech briefings, and envisioning sessions to build technical intensity across partner teams. By collaborating with engineering and product teams, you’ll help accelerate the adoption of emerging technologies and shape partner offerings that align with both business goals and technical requirements.
* Strategic Sales Enablement \- You’ll play a key role in activating transformational deals by providing architectural guidance, resolving technical blockers, and enhancing solution design. Your work will directly contribute to workload consumption and revenue impact.
* Champion Technical Excellence \- You’ll guide partners through architecture design sessions, proof\-of\-concepts, and MVP builds. You’ll ensure that solutions follow Microsoft’s Cloud and AI best practices and are optimized for performance, scalability, and security.
* Thought Leadership \& Stakeholder Management \- You’ll build long\-term engagements with strategic partners, influencing their adoption of Microsoft technologies. You’ll develop deep technical relationships with CXOs and foster executive alignment to support joint success.
* Partner Enablement \& Business Acumen \- You’ll coach broader partner technical teams to ensure pre\-sales, deployment, and consumption are embedded in solution development. You’ll help partners build resilience to technical challenges, navigate competitive landscapes, and translate technical concepts into business value.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or related field AND 4\+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting
* Proven experience in cloud architecture, solution design, and partner enablement, particularly in large\-scale or global engagements
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical innovation workshops, architecture reviews, and build\-to\-consume engagements with partners
* 6\-10\+ years of related experience in technology IP solutions or services development, with a deep understanding of digital transformation business drivers, cloud platforms, and emerging cloud trends like generative AI (ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE) and SaaS (Software as a Service) services
* Strong background and in\-depth knowledge of cloud technologies, with a focus on Microsoft's cloud offerings (Azure)
* Azure Data services, Fabric, SQL Server, Cosmos DB,
* Security, governance, and data access best practices
* Adoption and Change management (Prosci)
* Additional depth on Databricks on Azure, Github, Github Copilot, Apps Framework


**Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**
* 4\+ years experience working in a customer\-facing role (e.g., internal and/or external)
* 4\+ years experience working on technical projects
* Technical Certification in Cloud (e.g., Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google, security certifications

82b946a4.title: Delivery Manager
82b946a4.description:
Please note that we will only be able to accept candidates who have the appropriate rights and documentation for employment in India.
   

  

**Who We Are.**
 Axi is a leading global provider of margin and deliverable Foreign Exchange, Contracts for Difference (CFDs), and Financial Spread betting. Our business has evolved into a world\-class, multifaceted brokerage with offices in six regions. With heavy investment in the latest trading technology, Axi seeks to offer the most comprehensive end\-to\-end trading experience available, servicing traders of all levels from beginners to institutional\-level clients.
   

  

**Let's talk about the cool stuff you will do at Axi!**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Delivery Manager** 
 to drive the successful delivery of strategic technology initiatives across our global engineering teams. You will be responsible for owning the delivery lifecycle from planning through execution, ensuring projects are delivered on time, at the highest quality, and with predictable outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast\-growing fintech organization where you'll lead transformation initiatives, partner with cross\-functional stakeholders across global regions, and leverage modern technologies and AI\-driven tools to continuously improve delivery excellence.
   

  

**Your EDGE Assignment / You Will**
**Delivery Cadence**
* Define, document, and continuously improve the team's delivery cadence — sprint/iteration length, ceremony schedule (planning, refinement, review, retro), and reporting rhythm.
* Ensure the cadence is followed: ceremonies happen on schedule, with the right people, producing real decisions.
* Adapt cadence to the needs of different workstreams (e.g., a fast\-moving feature team vs. a compliance\-heavy workstream) without fragmenting the organisation into inconsistent processes.


**Stage Gate Ownership**
* Own the criteria for moving work between stages (e.g., Discovery → Ready for Build → In Progress → Review → Release) and enforce them consistently.
* Act as the checkpoint before work advances: confirm acceptance criteria are met, dependencies are cleared, risk/compliance sign\-offs are in hand, and Definition of Done is completed.
* Act when something is not ready and explain exactly what is missing and what is needed to pass the gate.
* Track and report exceptions/waivers when a gate is bypassed and ensure it is a deliberate decision.


**Delivery Planning**
* Build delivery plans grounded in real data: backlog sizing (story points/estimates), team velocity history, known dependencies, and risk.
* Convert scope and velocity into realistic timelines and communicate them as ranges with clear assumptions and confidence levels.
* Re\-forecast the plan on a regular cadence (e.g., every sprint) as scope, velocity, or risk changes, and proactively flag slippage.
* Maintain visibility tools (burnup/burndown, roadmap views, RAID logs) that let stakeholders self\-serve status.


**Cross\-Team Coordination \& Reporting**
* Be the primary point of contact for delivery status to leadership and stakeholders — translating team\-level detail into a clear picture of progress, risk, and trade\-offs.
* Identify and actively manage cross\-team dependencies, blockers, and resourcing conflicts before they hit the critical path.
* Facilitate trade\-off conversations (scope vs. time vs. quality) with data.


**Process Ownership \& Continuous Improvement**
* Own the delivery process documentation (workflow stages, gate criteria, estimation method, ceremony structure) and keep it current, e.g. in Confluence.
* Run retrospectives that produce real process changes.
* Balance rigor with pragmatism — add process where it removes risk or ambiguity and remove process if not needed.


**Are you the one?**
* 8\+ years in a Delivery Manager, Scrum Master, Program Manager, or Technical Project Manager role, ideally spanning multiple teams or workstreams.
* Demonstrated experience running Agile/Scrum (or Kanban/hybrid) delivery cadences end\-to\-end — not just attending ceremonies but designing and improving them.
* Hands\-on experience with story\-point estimation, velocity tracking, and forecasting delivery timelines from that data.
* Proven ability to hold a line on process/quality gates under deadline pressure, with the communication skill to do so without becoming a bottleneck or being seen as purely a blocker.
* Strong stakeholder management — comfortable presenting status, risk, and trade\-offs to senior leadership.
* Fluency with delivery tooling (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent) and building reporting views (burnup/burndown, roadmaps, dashboards) that reduce manual status\-chasing.
* Hands\-on exposure to tools such as Postman and Datadog, with an interest in leveraging AI to improve delivery and operational efficiency.
* Proven experience delivering technology transformation initiatives, including system migrations, process transitions, or Global Capability Centre (GCC) setup and transition projects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to turn ambiguous, fast\-moving work into a clear plan and a clear narrative.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience in \[industry — e.g., fintech, trading platforms, regulated environments], particularly where compliance/risk sign\-off is part of the stage\-gate process.
* Certification such as CSM, PSM, SAFe, or PMP (useful signal, not a substitute for hands\-on experience).
* Experience introducing or maturing a delivery process in an organization that didn't previously have one.


**Axi's bag of delights**
* Competitive and attractive compensation.
* Extensive learning opportunities including professional certifications and soft\-skills development.
* 18 annual leave days and 12 sick leave days per year.
* Public holidays as declared by local government.
* Maternity leave as per law.
* Health insurance coverage.


**Axi's interview journey**
* Talent Acquisition Round – 45 Minutes
* Hiring Manager Interview – 1 Hour
* Final Interview – 1 Hour


 Please note that our organization works with recruitment agencies on a pre\-approved basis only. A recruitment agency that wishes to submit candidate profiles or resumes for consideration must obtain prior written consent from our talent acquisition team. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, and we will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Should we receive an unsolicited resume from a recruitment agency that does not have prior written consent, we will not be responsible for the payment of any fees related to the recruitment of the candidate represented in the unsolicited resume.

We encourage every individual within our community to contribute towards a culture where everyone feels a sense of belonging and is treated with the dignity they deserve. We make all employment\-related decisions—whether in hiring, compensation, training, performance reviews, or termination—based on merit and without bias, ensuring equal opportunities for everyone. We consciously work to identify and overcome any unconscious biases, with a commitment to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee and candidate feels genuinely welcomed and valued.

364c4b27.title: Salesforce Delivery Manager
364c4b27.description:
What You'll Do:
   

  

 Criteo Internal IT is looking for an Agile Squad Team Lead to manage and grow Salesforce delivery teams based in India.
   

  

 This role is primarily focused on people leadership, team development, and partner management, within a global Agile organization led from France.
   

  

 You will be accountable for building strong, autonomous \& self organized teams, ensuring the right staffing and skills are in place, and acting as a key point of contact between India\-based teams, external partners, and the global product organization.
   

  

 People Management \& Team Leadership
   

  

* Lead, coach, and support Salesforce engineers and QA profiles within Agile squads
* Own career management activities: onboarding, performance feedback, development plans, and skill progression
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high\-performance team culture
* Ensure team engagement, stability, and retention in a competitive local market


 Staffing \& Sourcing
   

  

* Contribute actively to sourcing and hiring of new team members in collaboration with HR and the IIT Director
* Participate in interviews and assess both technical potential and behavioral fit
* Support workforce planning and anticipate staffing needs in line with roadmap evolution


 Partner \& Offshore Management
   

  

* Act as the primary point of contact for offshore delivery partners in India and Poland
* Ensure clear expectations, roles, and ways of working with partners
* Drive assertive communication and escalation when quality, staffing, or engagement issues arise
* Contribute to continuous improvement of the partner model


 Collaboration in a Global Agile Organization
   

  

* Work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, and
* Tech Leads based in France
* Ensure alignment on ways of working, team organization, and Agile standards
* Provide regular visibility on team health, staffing, and people\-related risks


 Who You Are:
   

  

 You are a hands\-on, people\-oriented leader who enjoys growing and enabling engineering teams
   

  

 You are comfortable operating with a high level of autonomy and ownership
   

  

 You demonstrate assertiveness and professionalism when interacting with external partners
   

  

 You are pragmatic, structured, and solution\-oriented
   

  

 You thrive in international environments and cross\-cultural collaboration
   

  

 And last but not least, you enjoy building strong teams and seeing people succeed
   

  

 Experience:
   

  

* 8–12 years of experience in IT environments, with demonstrated people management responsibilities
* Proven experience managing engineers and/or QA profiles in Agile team setups
* Experience working with offshore or external delivery partners is a strong plus
* Prior exposure to Salesforce platforms is highly valued (technical depth not mandatory)


 Skills \& Background
   

  

* Strong understanding of Agile ways of working (Scrum, Kanban, squad\-based organizations)
* Solid experience in managing IT careers and team development
* Excellent communication skills in an international, English\-speaking environment
* Ability to work independently with limited day\-to\-day supervision
* Experience in global organizations or captive centers is a strong advantage


 We acknowledge that many candidates may not meet every single role requirement listed above. If your experience looks a little different from our requirements but you believe that you can still bring value to the role, we’d love to see your application!
   

  

 Who We Are:
   

  

 We’re Criteo, the Commerce Intelligence Platform. Criteo helps businesses turn shopper signals into commerce outcomes while delivering more relevant experiences for shoppers. We use proprietary commerce intelligence and AI decisioning to drive relevance for shoppers and performance for businesses.
   

  

 At Criteo, our culture is as unique as it is diverse. From our offices across the globe or from the comfort of home, our 3,600 Criteos collaborate together to build an open, impactful, and forward\-thinking environment.
   

  

 We foster a workplace where everyone is valued, and employment decisions are based solely on skills, qualifications, and business needs—never on non\-job\-related factors or legally protected characteristics.
   

  

 What We Offer:
   

  

 🏢 Ways of working – Our hybrid model blends home with in\-office experiences, making space for both.
   

  

 📈 Grow with us – Learning, mentorship \& career development programs.
   

  

 💪 Your wellbeing matters – Health benefits, wellness perks \& mental health support.
   

  

 🤝 A team that cares – Diverse, inclusive, and globally connected.
   

  

 💸 Fair pay \& perks – Attractive salary, with performance\-based rewards and family\-friendly policies, plus the potential for equity depending on role and level.
   

  

 Additional benefits may vary depending on the country where you work and the nature of your employment with Criteo.

**Location:** 
 Kochi (Work From Office)
 


**About Xpress Health** 

 Xpress Health is a fast\-growing healthcare workforce technology company transforming healthcare staffing through innovative technology and operational excellence. Working with healthcare providers across Ireland, we build scalable workforce solutions that improve healthcare delivery and operational efficiency.
 



 We are looking for exceptional talent to help drive high\-impact business initiatives and support our next phase of growth.
 


**Role Overview** 

 We are seeking a highly driven
 **Program Manager** 
 to lead strategic initiatives, manage cross\-functional programs, and drive business execution across the organization.
 



 This role requires exceptional analytical thinking, structured problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and the ability to execute complex projects in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 You will work closely with senior leadership to deliver initiatives that directly influence business growth and operational excellence.
 


**Key Responsibilities** 
* Lead end\-to\-end execution of strategic programs and cross\-functional projects.
* Drive business\-critical initiatives aligned with organizational objectives.
* Collaborate with Operations, Product, Recruitment, Finance, and Leadership teams.
* Develop project plans, timelines, milestones, and execution roadmaps.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and implement scalable solutions.
* Track program performance through dashboards, reports, and KPIs.
* Manage stakeholders and ensure timely delivery of project objectives.
* Identify risks, remove blockers, and ensure seamless program execution.
* Prepare executive reports, presentations, and leadership updates.
* Develop SOPs, workflows, and operational frameworks to improve efficiency.

 in Program Management, Strategy, Business Operations, Consulting, Project Management, or related roles.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple high\-priority initiatives simultaneously.
* High ownership and execution\-oriented mindset.

* Experience working in startups, consulting, or high\-growth environments is preferred.

* Work directly with senior leadership on high\-impact strategic initiatives.

 Kochi (Work From Office)

 3–6 Years

 Full\-Time

aed8f006.title: Client Engagement Manager
aed8f006.description:
**Client Relationship Management**
* Be the primary point of contact for assigned clients, building and nurturing strong, long\-term relationships
* Understand clients' business goals, challenges, and market landscape to provide sharp, strategic recommendations — ideally informed by a strong grounding in brand and media strategy
* Conduct regular meetings and check\-ins to ensure client satisfaction and address concerns promptly


**Client Advisory and Engagement**
* Comprehend clients' needs and priorities within the delivery team, ensuring their feedback and inputs are heard and expectations are met
* Educate clients on industry trends, best practices, and emerging opportunities to strengthen their digital presence and achieve business goals
* Offer strategic guidance and innovative solutions — bringing a brand and media strategy lens to recommendations — to drive business growth through upsell and cross\-sell opportunities


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Facilitate seamless communication and collaboration among internal teams (Paid Media, Organic Growth, Analytics, Social Media, ORM, CRO, Marketing Automation, Influencer Marketing, etc.) to deliver a unified client experience
* Lead cross\-functional meetings to align strategies, share insights, and coordinate efforts for maximum impact
* Bridge gaps between teams to ensure a cohesive approach to client projects and campaigns


**Strategic Planning and Execution**
* Work closely with clients to define marketing objectives and translate them into actionable, brand\-led strategies
* Collaborate with internal teams to develop comprehensive marketing and media plans aligned with clients' business objectives
* Monitor campaign performance, analyze key indicators, and provide insights to optimize strategy and achieve desired outcomes


**Performance Monitoring**
* Define KPIs and metrics aligned with clients' goals and objectives
* Monitor campaign performance, track KPIs, and prepare regular reports showcasing results and ROI
* Provide data\-backed insights and recommendations to optimize campaign performance and drive continuous improvement


**Requirements**
* 5–8 years of experience in client servicing, account management, or client engagement roles (agency or brand\-side)
* Experience in brand strategy or media strategy strongly preferred — candidates with a background in brand positioning, media planning, or integrated campaign strategy will have an edge
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work cross\-functionally across specialist teams and translate strategy into execution

289f4f4d.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
289f4f4d.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Leverage your deep technical expertise and leadership to guide cutting\-edge projects, fostering growth and innovation in a dynamic environment.
  

  

As a Lead Technical Program Manager in Commercial \& Investment Bank, you will drive the successful delivery of complex technology projects and programs that will help reaching business goals across the firm. Leveraging your deep knowledge of technical principles, practices, and theories is essential for developing innovative solutions, while simultaneously effectively managing resources, budgets, and high\-performing teams. Your strong analytical reasoning and adaptability skills will enable you to navigate through ambiguity and change, ensuring that technology initiatives align with business goals. With advanced communication and stakeholder management abilities, you will foster productive working relationships and influence decision\-making to achieve mutually beneficial outcomes. As a subject matter expert, you will contribute to the development of operational plans and risk management strategies, ensuring the highest quality and professionalism in service delivery.




**Job Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute comprehensive project plans, incorporating technical requirements, resource allocation, and timelines to ensure on\-time delivery of technology solutions
* Uses enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate program planning and risk synthesis (e.g., consolidating inputs into integrated plans, RAID, and executive\-ready updates), validating outputs and handling data according to sensitivity requirements.
* Identify and mitigate risks, proactively addressing potential roadblocks and implementing contingency plans to maintain project and program momentum
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, product, and business stakeholders, to define program scope, objectives, and deliverables, ensuring alignment with overall business goals
* Utilize advanced analytical reasoning to assess program performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement data\-driven optimizations to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
* Champion agile delivery practices and continuous improvement, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation within the team

Promotes reuse\-first, AI\-assisted practices for program governance and reporting, ensuring human review and alignment to delivery standards.  
* 

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 5\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in technical program management, leading complex technology projects and programs in a large organization
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise\-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support program management workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to review and validate AI\-assisted plans, risks, and recommendations before use, escalating when uncertain and following data handling expectations.
* Advanced expertise in stakeholder management, with the ability to establish productive working relationships and influence decision\-making across cross\-functional teams and clients
* Proven track record of effectively managing resources, budgets, and high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced, agile environment

Demonstrated proficiency in applying analytical reasoning and problem\-solving techniques to break down business, technical, or operational objectives into manageable tasks and activities  
* 

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Familiarity with modern front\-end technologies
* Exposure to cloud technologies

  



**ABOUT US**

2d8393b8.title: Program Manager
2d8393b8.description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking an experienced and strategic Program Manager to lead our Data \& Analytics initiatives. This role is pivotal in driving the successful delivery of complex, cross\-functional data projects. You will be responsible for overseeing the entire program lifecycle, from initial conception to final deployment, ensuring that our data solutions align with business objectives and drive data\-driven decision\-making across the organization. You will work in a dynamic environment that leverages cutting\-edge technologies, including Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Databricks, Tableau, and Anaplan.
 



**RESPONSIBILITIES** 



* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of large\-scale data and analytics programs, ensuring they are on time, within budget, and meet the highest quality standards.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for all program\-related communications, effectively engaging with stakeholders at all levels, from technical teams to executive leadership, to ensure alignment and transparency.
* Collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and business leaders to define the program roadmap, strategy, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for our data and analytics initiatives.
* Facilitate seamless collaboration between various teams, including data engineering, data science, business intelligence, and IT, to ensure cohesive and integrated project execution.
* Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate program risks and issues, developing contingency plans to ensure program success.
* Manage program resources, including budget, personnel, and technology, to optimize efficiency and effectiveness.
* Drive continuous improvement in our program management processes, methodologies, and tools to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of our data and analytics delivery.



**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in program management, with a proven track record of successfully delivering complex, technical projects.
* Strong understanding of the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment and support.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and negotiate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders.
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast\-paced, agile environment.



**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Experience working in a data\-centric environment with a strong understanding of data warehousing, data modeling, and business intelligence concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms, preferably
 **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**
* Familiarity with big data technologies such as
 **BigQuery** 
 and
 **Databricks** 
 for data engineering and machine learning.
* Experience with data visualization tools, particularly
 **Tableau** 
 , for creating insightful and actionable dashboards.
* Knowledge of enterprise performance management solutions like
 **Anaplan** 
 for business planning and modeling.
* PMP, Agile, or other relevant project management certifications.



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.   
 




 C
 

 andidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled
 

 in accordance with
 

 our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to
 

 assist
 

 our team in evaluating qualifications.

b3bbd98e.title: SAP - Presales Solution Architect - Senior Manager
b3bbd98e.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**Position Title:** 
**CNS \- SAP Solution Architect \- Manager**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
* Prior Experience of bid and delivery solutioning as well as core delivery must in the relevant technology area
* Expertise in SAP S/4 HANA
* Experience in more than one of the functional workstream (EWM, FICO, SD, SF, Ariba, Customer, IBP) or over\-all solution architect
* Should have worked with onsite teams in business development or delivery.
* Proficient in MS Office products (Project, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)


**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Demonstrate deep knowledge of SAP solutions and appropriate industries to maintain credibility with prospective customers. Provide proof points with relevant customer stories.
* Support RFx completion in support of customer proposals.
* Engaging with Clients in understanding their requirements, scoping, discovering, and defining solutions, explaining business benefits and use cases and a roadmap to meet their goals.
* Creating innovative solution designs that utilise our extensive service offerings.
* Understand client requirements (RFP/ RFI), build synopsis, and have an ability to articulate the customer ask.
* Participation in meetings with internal/external stakeholders (Delivery managers, Account managers and client partners) and Vertical \& Horizontal teams.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong verbal and written communication with out of box thinking abilities.
* Ability to understand Methodologies (Activate, Agile, SDLC, SCRUM) and other industry business fundamentals and ability to showcase a quick learning curve.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Worked on implementation RFPs as a solution architect responsible for designing solutions end to end


**What We Look For**
* Prior BD experience (at least 2 Year, overall, 11\-14 years) with exposure to SAP Delivery.
* A strong understanding of SAP and integration with other applications/systems in an IT landscape


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
   

  

 EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi\-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

6bb7495c.title: Solution Architect
6bb7495c.description:
**About us**

  

At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living and a net\-zero future. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

  

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower\-emissions technologies.

  

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about **our What and our Why** and how we canwork **together**.

**ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India**
------------------------------------

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates have offices in India in Bengaluru, Mumbai and the National Capital Region.

  

ExxonMobil’s affiliates in India supporting the Product Solutions business engage in the marketing, sales and distribution of performance as well as specialty products across chemicals and lubricants businesses. The India planning teams are also embedded with global business units for business planning and analytics.

  

ExxonMobil’s LNG affiliate in India supporting the upstream business provides consultant services for other ExxonMobil upstream affiliates and conducts LNG market\-development activities.

  

The Global Business Center \- Technology Center provides a range of technical and business support services for ExxonMobil’s operations around the globe.

  

ExxonMobil strives to make a positive contribution to the communities where we operate, and its affiliates support a range of education, health and community\-building programs in India. Read more about our Corporate Responsibility Framework.

  

To know more about ExxonMobil in India, visit ExxonMobil India and the Energy Factor India.

**What role you will play in our team**
---------------------------------------

  

We are looking for a dynamic, creative, and resourceful Solution Architect to join our team at ExxonMobil’s Bengaluru office. This role is ideal for a hands\-on professional who combines deep technical expertise with strong communication and collaboration skills. You will be responsible for architecture that aligns with organizational goals, scalability, security, and performance standards in ExxonMobil’s Upstream business.

**What you will do**
--------------------

 **Core Responsibilities**

  

* Builds and manages groups of systems and/or integrated solutions within a business or technology capability
* Focuses on solution/product enablement by leveraging existing reference architectures, technology strategies, business capabilities, and gaps to deliver optimal solutions based on intentional prioritization  

Maintains an end\-to\-end view of any connected systems
* Works with other architects/product management roles to define the solution/product direction to meet current and future requirements (strategy and roadmaps)
* Works mostly across conceptual \& logical architecture levels; creates the logical reference architecture diagrams
* Partner with, delivery teams and new initiatives to drive alignment of solutions to reference architectures and strategies (includes guiding technology evaluations and prototype development)
* Engages and influences vendors to identify, learn and socialize emerging product capabilities to meet business needs
* Support technical details required for Procurement and S\&C processes
* Evaluates the existing operating environment to determine effectiveness and suggest changes to meet organizational requirements along with identification of redundant/ineffective systems
* Applies technical expertise to craft feature solutions that abide within the architectural guidelines established by the Enterprise / BDAT Architects
* Ensures enablement work is prioritized for the product
* Serves as technical mentor / leader for program and product teams
* Generally supports multiple delivery teams
* Not expected to take on multiple roles within the organization
* Partners with Product Management roles to identify and prioritize enabler work

 **Other Expectations**

  

* Serves as a technical leader for one IT delivery team
* Expected to be the architect role with the most depth of knowledge for the Solutions within their scope
* Not expected to take on multiple roles within the organization, although it will fill in the System Architect role
* Acts as Cloud Subscription Owner for the systems within their scope, but they may delegate custodianship to a team member
* Architects solutions for MSP's to implement. Validates implementations and the quality of technical outcomes from MSP's
* May take on the Project Lead Architect role for specific projects
* May implement (hands\-on) the foundational architectural components of a technical solution, or PoC them
**About you**
-------------

 **Skills and Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Minimum 4 years of hands\-on as Architect.
* Minimum 7 years of overall experinece.
**Your benefits**
-----------------

  

An ExxonMobil career is one designed to last. Our commitment to you runs deep: our employees grow personally and professionally, with benefits built on our core categories of health, security, finance and life. We offer you:

  

* Competitive compensation
* Medical plans, maternity leave and benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment benefits
* Retirement benefits
* Global networking \& cross\-functional opportunities
* Annual vacations \& holidays
* Day care assistance program
* Training and development program
* Tuition assistance program
* Workplace flexibility policy
* Relocation program
* Transportation facility

  

Please note benefits may change from time to time without notice, subject to applicable laws. The benefits programs are based on the Company’s eligibility guidelines.

**Stay connected with us**
--------------------------

  

* Learn more about ExxonMobil in India, visit **ExxonMobil India**and **Energy Factor India****.**
* Follow us on**LinkedIn** **and** **Instagram**
* Like us on **Facebook**
* Subscribe our channel at **YouTube**
**EEO Statement**
-----------------


ExxonMobil is an Equal Opportunity Employer:

  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin or disability status.

**Business solicitation and recruiting scams**
----------------------------------------------

  

ExxonMobil does not use recruiting or placement agencies that charge candidates an advance fee of any kind (e.g., placement fees, immigration processing fees, etc.). Follow the LINK to understand more about recruitment scams in the name of ExxonMobil.

**Functional Skills**
---------------------


Cloud Security
IT Vendor Lifecycle Strategy \& Optimization
Cloud Computing  

Nothing herein is intended to override the corporate separateness of local entities. Working relationships discussed herein do not necessarily represent a reporting connection, but may reflect a functional guidance, stewardship, or service relationship.

  

Exxon Mobil Corporation has numerous affiliates, many with names that include ExxonMobil, Exxon, Esso and Mobil. For convenience and simplicity, those terms and terms like corporation, company, our, we and its are sometimes used as abbreviated references to specific affiliates or affiliate groups. Abbreviated references describing global or regional operational organizations and global or regional business lines are also sometimes used for convenience and simplicity. Similarly, ExxonMobil has business relationships with thousands of customers, suppliers, governments, and others. For convenience and simplicity, words like venture, joint venture, partnership, co\-venturer, and partner are used to indicate business relationships involving common activities and interests, and those words may not indicate precise legal relationships.

Our practice addresses the continuum of opportunities in business intelligence \& visualization, data management, performance management and next\-generation analytics and technologies, including big data, cloud, cognitive and machine learning.

  



**Work Profile**


* Lead and manage multiple consulting engagements for Government and Public Sector clients in the renewable energy sector.
* Provide PMU support for large\-scale renewable energy and energy transition programs, ensuring effective planning, execution, monitoring, and reporting.
* Conduct policy, regulatory, market, and data analytics to support informed decision\-making and the implementation of renewable energy initiatives.
* Develop policy papers, analytical reports, regulatory assessments, implementation frameworks, and strategic recommendations for government clients.
* Coordinate with Central and State Government departments, regulatory authorities, public sector enterprises, utilities, industry stakeholders, and development partners to facilitate project implementation.
* Design and implement project governance frameworks, monitoring mechanisms, performance dashboards, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Manage project timelines, budgets, risks, and quality to ensure successful delivery of client engagements.
* Lead client interactions, facilitate workshops, and present findings and recommendations to senior government officials and executive stakeholders.
* Mentor and develop consulting teams by providing technical guidance, project oversight, and performance coaching.
* Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities, preparing proposals, developing client presentations, and supporting practice growth initiatives.
* Stay abreast of emerging trends, policy developments, regulatory reforms, and technological advancements in the renewable energy sector.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Energy Management, Public Policy, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 3\-4 years of relevant experience in management consulting, government advisory, renewable energy, power, infrastructure, or public policy.
* Demonstrated experience in managing PMU assignments and multi\-stakeholder government consulting engagements.
* Strong understanding of renewable energy policies, power sector regulations, electricity markets, and clean energy transition initiatives.


**Skills**


* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder and client relationship management skills.

* Proven project management and team leadership experience.

b41f3aea.description:
FEQ427R107


As a Solutions Architect, you will shape the future of the Data \& AI landscape by working with the most sophisticated data engineering and data science teams in the world. You will be a technical advisor internally to the sales team, and work with the product team as an advocate of your customers in the field. You will help our customers to achieve tangible data\-driven outcomes through the use of our Databricks Lakehouse Platform, helping data teams complete projects and integrate our platform into their enterprise Ecosystem. You'll grow as a leader in your field, while finding solutions to our customers' biggest challenges in big data, analytics, data engineering and data science problems


Reporting to the Field Engineering Manager, you will collaborate with our most strategic prospects and customers, work directly with product and engineering to drive the Databricks roadmap forward, and work with the broader customer\-facing team to develop architectures and solutions using our platform. You will guide customers through the competitive landscape, best practices, and implementation, and develop technical champions along the way.


This is a Hybrid role, based in Delhi.


**The impact you will have:**


* You will partner with the sales team and provide technical leadership to help customers understand how Databricks can help solve their business problems.
* You will work directly with the sales team to develop your book of business, define account strategies, and execute those strategies to help your customers and prospects solve their business problems with Databricks.
* Consult on Big Data architectures, implement proof of concepts for strategic projects, spanning data engineering, data science and machine learning, and SQL analysis workflows. As well as validating integrations with cloud services, home grown tools, and other 3rd party applications
* Collaborate with your fellow Solutions Architects, using your skills to support each other and our users
* Become an expert in, promote, and recruit contributors for Databricks inspired open\-source projects (Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow) across the developer community.

**What we look for:**


* 8\+ years in a data engineering, data science, technical architecture, or similar pre\-sales/consulting role
* 8\+ years of experience with Big Data technologies, including Apache Spark™, AI, Data Science, Data Engineering, Hadoop, Cassandra, and others
* Strong consulting / customer facing experience , working with external clients across a variety of industry markets
* Coding experience in Python, R, Java, Apache Spark™ or Scala
* Experience building distributed data systems
* Have built solutions with public cloud providers such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Available to travel to customers in your region
* Nice to have: Databricks Certification

**About Databricks**


Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT\&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data \+ AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

0f0ab5a8.title: Solutions Architect (Power BI)
0f0ab5a8.description:
Marlabs, a global AI and Digital Solutions Consulting firm, delivers intelligent solutions across AI, data, analytics, and product engineering. Since 2000, we have partnered with some of the largest healthcare, life sciences, financial services, and government organizations worldwide. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we have an exciting opportunity for a highly skilled Solutions Architect (Power BI) to join our innovative and dynamic team.  

  



**Solutions Architect (Power BI) \| About You**


As a Solutions Architect (Power BI), you will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting enterprise business intelligence solutions that deliver actionable insights across the organization. You will leverage Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, and data warehousing technologies to build scalable reporting and analytics solutions, transform complex data into meaningful business intelligence, and ensure a high\-quality user experience. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in data analytics and visualization with the ability to collaborate closely with business stakeholders, data teams, and architects to deliver impactful reporting solutions.


**Solutions Architect (Power BI) \| Day\-to\-Day**

  

* Design, develop, and support enterprise Power BI dashboards, reports, and KPI scorecards that provide actionable insights for business stakeholders.
* Build and maintain data integration and transformation processes, including loading and transforming data from SAP BW and other enterprise systems into Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse environments.
* Develop complex SQL queries, datasets, and analytical models to support reporting, performance tracking, and business intelligence initiatives.
* Partner with business users, stakeholders, and technical teams to gather reporting requirements and deliver scalable analytics solutions aligned with business objectives.
* Collaborate with SAP Data Warehouse and data engineering teams to design and optimize data models, data flows, and reporting architectures.
* Provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and support to junior developers while promoting reporting standards, best practices, and continuous improvement.


**Solutions Architect (Power BI) \| Skills \& Experience**

  

* 3\+ years of experience developing enterprise reporting and analytics solutions, with strong expertise in Power BI development, dashboard design, and data visualization.
* Advanced proficiency in Power BI, DAX, Power Query (M), and SQL, including data modeling, performance optimization, and complex query development.
* Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory (ADF), and data integration technologies, including ETL/ELT development and data transformation from multiple sources.
* Strong understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, and designing scalable reporting solutions using SQL databases and enterprise data platforms.
* Experience developing dashboards for web, mobile, and tablet platforms, with excellent stakeholder communication skills and the ability to translate business requirements into impactful BI solutions.

23d85da1.description:
**Overview**
* Leading AI\-driven Global Supply Chain Solutions Software Product Company and one of Glassdoor’s “Best Places to Work”
* We are seeking an astute and enthusiastic individual who has a strong technical foundation with the additional ability to be hands\-on with the Professional Services team as part of the development/deployment cycle, and deep knowledge of industry best practices, with the ability to lead and implement independently working with both the platform, and the solution teams.


**Scope**
* The Professional services team within Blue Yonder operates globally and is growing rapidly.
* Blue Yonder Enterprise Technical Architect (Planning) will be responsible for services delivery of product implementation and related integration.
* This role will provide the associate to be hands\-on with the Professional Services team as part of the development/deployment cycle, and deep knowledge of industry best practices, with the ability to implement them working with both the platform, and the solution teams.
* Core responsibilities include Strategy, Architecting, Design/Development (along with counterparts, customer, and Architects) and leading the technical team on projects and delivery initiatives catered around Supply Chain Planning solution and capabilities implementation.


**Desired Skills And Experience**
* Knowledge on
* OS – Windows, Unix
* DB – RDBMS Concepts, Oracle, MS SQL Server, SQL/ PL SQL
* Implementation experience using SCPO Platform or any other relevant enterprise planning product and platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture frameworks certifications or awareness is an added advantage.
* Next Gen Skills \- Data Science, Data Analytics, Agile, Python, AI/ML, Cloud Fun, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, Databases/Data Platforms(emerging) – Snowflake, MongoDB, NoSQL, etc
* Reporting Skills – MS PowerBI
* Professional Attributes:
* Excellent communication, Inter\-personal, Stakeholder management, Analytical and Problem\-solving skills
* Excellent organization and project documentation skills
* Meticulous planning with attention to detail and multi\-tasking skills
* Domain knowledge: Understanding of Supply Chain Planning and how it integrates with other systems. Any industry specific experience is a big plus.


**What You’ll Do**
* Lead and mentor team of technical associates on Solution implementation, enhancement, managed services, integration, custom projects either at the customer site or offshore.
* Estimate the workload of implementation activities that are within the scope of their skills; assess business needs that fall outside the standard solution, assess integration complexity, architecture.
* Able to work and own initiatives for the technical planning team (Professional Services) and demonstrate good skills in leading the strategy and contribute towards complex customer assessment and sales cycle.
* Collaborate with Global Team/Partners and Customers or internal stakeholders.
* Conduct technical analysis sessions with customers and/or the project team to understand the functional and technical needs of the customer and develop technical solutions to meet those needs. Configure and implement Blue Yonder software solutions according to the client's specific requirements.
* Documentation Support \- Technical aspects of Blue Yonder Solutions, including technical specifications, configuration details, and user manuals.
* Implementation and steady state support, contribute on internal development projects and activities.
* Contribute to the growth of the technical professional services practice by developing and maintaining practice aids, databases, best\-practice collateral, assets, and accelerators.
* Continuously upskill Blue Yonder’ s product suite and technology innovation to convey relationships and touchpoints to the customer. Incumbent should be up to date on the Product Roadmap and strategy and need to have a synergy with cross functional team(s).
* Ready to travel to customer sites based on business needs.
* Identify areas of improvement and scope of automation on routine tasks or activities
* Handle activities with a diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors.
* Accelerate Time\-to\-Value for customer by iteratively delivering in short cycles.
* Recognize and highlight incremental revenue opportunities within existing customer projects.
* Ensures compliance with the internal and external company policies and procedures.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree and 15\+ years of experience in Software industry; ideally a candidate who has started as a Consultant and has worked his/her way to leading the technical team on 5\+ complete implementation cycles.
* Demonstrable understanding of software engineering fundamentals and design principles
* Experience working with large customers in challenging environments and having design/implemented enterprise application solutions and integration architectures.
* Demonstrable experience leading, building, deploying and maintenance of enterprise solutions (cloud or on\-premises)
* Excellent communication, Inter\-personal, Analytical and Problem\-solving skills
* Strong programming experience and problem\-solving skills
* Supply Chain Planning Industry Experience
* Expertise on performance tuning techniques and ability to assist other team members with benchmarking and sizing exercises.
* Possess technical expertise on emerging technologies and integration with different database and scripting languages like Python, SQL/PLSQL, Linux, etc
* Good understanding of Web Technologies and API fundamentals
* Strong understanding on Cloud and Architectural design (Azure or equivalent, Microservices Architecture, Multi\-Tenant)
* Demonstrable experience with Blue Yonder SCPO Platform.
* Hands\-on development skills; should not have moved away from development activities.
* Passionate about working with new and emerging technologies, products and demonstrates the ability to learn quickly, and have good interpersonal \& communication


**Our Values**
 If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

 Architect role for an MNC requiring extensive experience in Azure Databricks and Azure Machine Learning within media and entertainment domains delivering scalable hybrid cloud data and AI solutions optimizing content workflows and enabling advanced analytics while collaborating with cross functional teams in a day shift hybrid work model supporting global stakeholders.

* Design end to end data and AI architectures using Azure Databricks and Azure Machine Learning to support advanced analytics and predictive capabilities for media and entertainment content workflows
* Develop optimized data pipelines and reusable components in Azure Databricks to process large scale structured and unstructured media datasets with high reliability and performance
* Define reference architectures and patterns for ingestion processing storage and consumption of media data ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and compliance requirements

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are seeking a Cloud Security Engineer to implement and optimize of cloud security tooling and governance across multi\-cloud environments. This role sits at the intersection of cloud security engineering, policy\-as\-code, and DevSecOps, driving measurable improvements in cloud risk posture and compliance maturity.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

ea4f46fc.title: Technical Architect - Lead Architect
ea4f46fc.description:
**National Consulting Services**


The National Office, a key Strategic Enabler in our new model, is comprised of professionals with various areas of focus that collectively provide mission critical services to support Deloitte’s overall success. Whether focused on project financial, quality and risk management, methods and tools, sales excellence, talent, leadership support, or other activities these professionals ensure that our Firm operates efficiently, and our people are able to effectively serve clients every day.

**Position Summary**

**Level: Manager**


As a Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise\-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross\-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery of solutions.

**Work You’ll Do**


As a Product Architect, you will play a pivotal role in designing and overseeing the architecture of our products, ensuring they meet the highest standards of performance, scalability, and reliability. You will leverage your expertise in Generative AI, Agentic AI, and cloud technologies to drive the development of innovative solutions. Your experience with tools like ArgoCD, AWS, Azure, and Kubernetes will be critical in shaping our product strategy and execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**


Define and communicate the overall product architecture and technical vision.
Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure alignment of architecture with business goals.
Design and implement scalable and reliable product architectures using Generative AI and Agentic AI technologies.
Utilize cloud platforms (AWS, Azure) to build and maintain robust infrastructure.
Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines using ArgoCD.
Oversee the deployment and orchestration of containerized applications using Kubernetes.
Ensure best practices in security, performance, and scalability are followed.
Provide technical leadership and mentorship to development teams.
Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends to drive innovation.**The team**


Our Deloitte Innovations and Technology teams are working on delivering innovate cloud\-based solutions across a range of domains and industries (e.g. supply chain management, banking/insurance, CPG, retail, etc.). It is a fast\-paced, innovative and exciting environment. Our teams are following an agile development approach and work with the latest technologies across a wide range of cloud technologies, commercial options and open source. We are building and bringing solutions to market which we are hosting and operating for our clients.

**Qualifications:**

**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications**


Minimum of 8\-12 years of experience in product architecture or a similar role.
Strong expertise in Generative AI and Agentic AI technologies.
Proficiency with cloud platforms, specifically AWS and Azure.
Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools, particularly ArgoCD.
Deep understanding of containerization and orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes.
Proven track record of designing and implementing scalable and reliable product architectures.
Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work in a fast\-paced environment.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications**


Experience with additional AI technologies and frameworks.
Knowledge of security best practices in cloud and AI environments.
Certification in AWS, Azure, or Kubernetes.**Education:**


Minimum of a bachelor’s degree (3 Year) within a technical field.
**Location:**


Hyderabad/ Bengaluru/ Kolkata/ Chennai/Pune  


**Our purpose**  


Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
**Our people and culture**  


Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
**Professional development**  


At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

92d72fc2.description:
**Solutions Consultant** 




**Location:** 
 Pune (On Site)
 



**Time:** 
 Day or Night Shift
 



**CTC: Upto 7LPA** 




**(Master or Graduation from abroad)** 




**Years of Exp: 2\+ Years** 




  





**Role Overview** 




 You're the bridge between a patient's confusion and clarity. Someone lands on CureMeAbroad with a question—"Can I get quality orthopedic surgery abroad for half the cost?"—and you're the person who transforms that into a real plan.
 



 As a Solutions Consultant, you're the first trusted voice in the patient journey. You qualify leads, understand their medical needs, research the right hospitals and surgeons across our 350\+ partner network, and line up treatment consultations (TCs) with the best fit. You're not just gathering information, you're building confidence and trust.
 



**Your core mission:** 
 Move qualified leads from "exploring" to "ready for conversation with a doctor."
 



  





**What You'll Actually Do (Day\-to\-Day)Lead Qualification \& Intake** 



* Jump into WhatsApp/chat and understand what patients actually need (their medical history, budget, timeline, fears, priorities)
* Use our AI tools and clinical database to assess case viability
* Identify red flags early (cases we shouldn't pursue) and handle with care and clarity
* Navigate objections and build rapport especially with US and international clients who may be skeptical about offshore care



 Research \& Treatment Planning
 


* Dig into our hospital \+ surgeon database to match patients with the right providers
* Review credentials, outcomes, specializations, pricing models
* Build personalized treatment \+ cost scenarios so patients understand options
* Present luxury\-level service mentality in every interaction (these clients expect excellence)



 TC Coordination
 


* Line up doctor consultations with partner hospitals
* Prepare patients for conversations (what to expect, what to ask, what docs need to know)
* Manage timezones, language preferences, documentation flows
* Handoff to Account Success Lead with everything organized and relationship warm



 Patient Communication
 


* Own the entire pre\-sales conversation across channels (chat, WhatsApp, email, calls)
* Explain complex medical \+ logistical info in a way that feels approachable, not intimidating
* Address objections, manage expectations, build trust
* Make small talk feel natural—these conversations aren't transactional, they're relationship\-building
* Keep detailed notes so handoff is seamless



 Analytics \& Optimization
 


* Track your qualification rates, TC conversion, average time\-to\-TC
* Spot patterns (which hospitals convert best, which procedures have questions)
* Help the team refine processes based on what you're learning



  





 What We're Looking ForRequired:
 


* 2\+ years in customer\-facing roles with US or international clients (sales, customer success, patient advocacy, support—something where you own the relationship)
* Experience with luxury or premium service environments (high\-net\-worth clients, exclusive services, concierge roles)—this is how we position ourselves
* Ability to understand medical/clinical info quickly (you don't need an MD, but you need to learn fast)
* Natural conversationalist—you can make small talk feel genuine, build rapport over chat/call, make people feel heard
* Obsessive about detail and follow\-up (patients' lives depend on this)
* Comfortable with ambiguity—you'll often be finding answers to questions you've never seen before
* Ability to communicate complex ideas simply (your mom should understand your explanations)
* Comfortable with data and tracking your own metrics
* Timezone flexibility (we serve US, UK, Australia, Germany primarily)



 Nice to Have:
 


* Medical tourism, healthcare, or international patient experience
* Exposure to healthcare systems or medical procedures
* Fluency in languages beyond English (German, Spanish, Turkish especially helpful)
* Founder mentality—you don't wait to be told what to do, you find what needs doing
* Experience explaining medical/financial concepts to skeptical audiences



  





 Why Join CureMeAbroad?
 


* **CureMeAbroad** 
 is a global medical tourism tech based discovery platform facilitating patients from high\-cost markets like the US, UK, Germany, and Australia find, compare, and connect with verified hospitals and surgeons across India, Turkey, Thailand, Mexico, and Spain.
* Be part of a fast\-scaling global medical tourism brand
* High\-ownership role with real learning and growth opportunities
* Work directly with the founding team on live deals, real markets, and actual growth targets
